examples.sentence: Hicieron el negocio a cucucho para que nadie se enterara y evitar problemas legales.
examples.translation: They did the deal on the sly so that no one would find out and avoid legal problems.

examples.sentence: Juan siempre trabaja a cucucho para que sus jefes no lo vean y lo regañen.
examples.translation: Juan always works secretly so his bosses don't see him and scold him.

examples.sentence: El informe fue entregado a cucucho, sin que los otros miembros del equipo supieran nada.
examples.translation: The report was handed in secretly, without the other team members knowing anything.

definitions: Treated with lavish comfort, luxury, and attentive care; given privileges and amenities associated with high status.

examples.sentence: Durante su visita al hotel, los invitados fueron tratados a cuerpo de rey con comidas exquisitas y habitaciones lujosas.
examples.translation: During their visit to the hotel, the guests were treated like royalty with exquisite meals and luxurious rooms.

examples.sentence: El anciano recibió atención médica a cuerpo de rey, con enfermeros disponibles las 24 horas y terapia personalizada.
examples.translation: The elderly man received medical care like a king, with nurses available 24 hours and personalized therapy.

examples.sentence: Para su cumpleaños, le prepararon una fiesta a cuerpo de rey con música en vivo y un banquete impresionante.
examples.translation: For his birthday, they prepared a royal-style party with live music and an impressive banquet.

examples.sentence: El equipo fue alojado a cuerpo de rey en un resort exclusivo durante el campeonato.
examples.translation: The team was accommodated like royalty in an exclusive resort during the championship.

definitions: Living in great comfort and opulence; enjoying a life of luxury.

examples.sentence: Desde que consiguió el nuevo trabajo, vive a cuerpo de rey y no le falta nada.
examples.translation: Since he got the new job, he lives like a king and lacks nothing.

examples.sentence: No quiero vivir a cuerpo de rey, prefiero una vida sencilla y tranquila.
examples.translation: I don't want to live in luxury; I prefer a simple and peaceful life.

examples.sentence: Después de ganar la lotería, empezaron a vivir a cuerpo de rey en la ciudad.
examples.translation: After winning the lottery, they started living like royalty in the city.

definitions: By hitchhiking; traveling by soliciting lifts from passing motorists.

examples.sentence: Cuando era estudiante, viajaba a dedo para ahorrar en transporte y conocer gente nueva.
examples.translation: When I was a student, I hitchhiked to save on transport and meet new people.

examples.sentence: ¿Alguna vez has ido a dedo por la carretera? Es una aventura interesante pero puede ser riesgoso.
examples.translation: Have you ever hitchhiked on the road? It's an interesting adventure but it can be risky.

examples.sentence: Nos fuimos de vacaciones a dedo porque no queríamos gastar mucho en gasolina.
examples.translation: We went on vacation hitchhiking because we didn't want to spend much on gas.

definitions: Selected or appointed personally, often without open competition; handpicked, frequently implying favoritism or arbitrary choice.

examples.sentence: El director nombró a dedo al nuevo gerente sin consultar al equipo, lo que generó descontento.
examples.translation: The director handpicked the new manager without consulting the team, which caused discontent.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que los cargos públicos se asignen a dedo porque falta transparencia.
examples.translation: I don't like that public positions are assigned arbitrarily because it lacks transparency.

examples.sentence: El jefe escogió a dedo a sus colaboradores favoritos para el proyecto especial.
examples.translation: The boss personally selected his favorite collaborators for the special project.

definitions: By use of the finger; indicated or pointed out with a finger.

examples.sentence: Me señaló a dedo la casa que queríamos visitar durante el tour por el barrio.
examples.translation: He pointed out to me with his finger the house we wanted to visit during the neighborhood tour.

examples.sentence: Los niños aprendieron a señalar a dedo los objetos que formaban parte del juego.
examples.translation: The children learned to point with their fingers at the objects that were part of the game.

examples.sentence: ¿Podrías indicar a dedo cuál es tu favorito entre estos cuadros?
examples.translation: Could you point with your finger which one is your favorite among these paintings?

examples.sentence: El guía turístico les indicó a dedo el lugar exacto donde se encontraba la estatua antigua.
examples.translation: The tour guide pointed out with his finger the exact place where the ancient statue was located.

definitions: Reluctantly; with unwillingness.

examples.sentence: A desgana aceptó la invitación, aunque preferiría quedarse en casa descansando.
examples.translation: Reluctantly, he accepted the invitation, although he would prefer to stay home resting.

examples.sentence: No quiero ir al evento, pero iré a desgana para no decepcionar a mis amigos.
examples.translation: I don't want to go to the event, but I will reluctantly so as not to disappoint my friends.

examples.sentence: El profesor corrigió los exámenes a desgana porque estaba cansado después de un largo día.
examples.translation: The teacher graded the exams reluctantly because he was tired after a long day.

examples.sentence: Aunque le ofrecieron un puesto mejor, aceptó a desgana por la inseguridad que sentía al cambiar de trabajo.
examples.translation: Although they offered him a better position, he accepted reluctantly because of the insecurity he felt about changing jobs.

definitions: Half-heartedly; without enthusiasm or genuine interest.

examples.sentence: Ella trabaja a desgana en el proyecto porque no le interesa el tema.
examples.translation: She works half-heartedly on the project because she is not interested in the topic.

examples.sentence: No respondas a desgana los correos, mejor tómate un momento para contestar con atención.
examples.translation: Don't reply half-heartedly to emails; better take a moment to answer carefully.

examples.sentence: Los alumnos participaban a desgana en la clase, lo que se notaba en la falta de preguntas y comentarios.
examples.translation: The students participated half-heartedly in the class, which was noticeable in the lack of questions and comments.

definitions: Located out of the way; not conveniently situated.

examples.sentence: La cabaña está a desmano del pueblo, por lo que hay que caminar casi una hora para llegar.
examples.translation: The cabin is out of the way from the village, so you have to walk almost an hour to get there.

examples.sentence: El supermercado más cercano está a desmano, lo que complica hacer las compras diarias.
examples.translation: The nearest supermarket is inconveniently located, which complicates daily shopping.

examples.sentence: Nos hospedamos en una casa a desmano, alejada de las principales atracciones turísticas.
examples.translation: We stayed in a house located out of the way, far from the main tourist attractions.

examples.sentence: El taller mecánico está a desmano, así que mejor llama para asegurarte de que abren hoy.
examples.translation: The mechanic's shop is located out of the way, so better call to make sure they're open today.

definitions: Difficult or inconvenient to reach; remote from the usual route or centre.

examples.sentence: La nueva fábrica está a desmano y por eso el transporte de mercancías es más costoso.
examples.translation: The new factory is inconveniently located, and that's why transporting goods is more expensive.

examples.sentence: Aunque el restaurante es excelente, está a desmano para muchos clientes y eso afecta su popularidad.
examples.translation: Although the restaurant is excellent, it is difficult to reach for many customers, and that affects its popularity.

examples.sentence: El campamento estaba a desmano, lo que dificultaba la llegada de los suministros necesarios.
examples.translation: The campsite was hard to reach, which made the arrival of necessary supplies difficult.

definitions: On piecework; paid or employed by the amount of work completed rather than by time.

examples.sentence: Trabajaba a destajo en la fábrica para ganar más dinero durante el verano.
examples.translation: He worked piecework in the factory to earn more money during the summer.

examples.sentence: La empresa paga a destajo, por lo que los empleados se esfuerzan en producir la mayor cantidad posible.
examples.translation: The company pays by piecework, so the employees strive to produce as much as possible.

examples.sentence: Si quieres aumentar tus ganancias, podrías considerar un trabajo a destajo en lugar de uno con salario fijo.
examples.translation: If you want to increase your earnings, you could consider a piecework job instead of one with a fixed salary.

examples.sentence: Durante años, ella trabajó a destajo en la confección de ropa para ayudar a su familia.
examples.translation: For years, she worked piecework in clothing manufacturing to help her family.

definitions: Working rapidly and continuously; at high speed or without interruption.

examples.sentence: Los obreros trabajaron a destajo para terminar el edificio antes de la fecha límite.
examples.translation: The workers worked rapidly and continuously to finish the building before the deadline.

examples.sentence: Durante la campaña, el equipo estuvo a destajo para cubrir todos los eventos en tiempo real.
examples.translation: During the campaign, the team worked nonstop to cover all the events in real time.

examples.sentence: Si quieres terminar rápido, tendrás que trabajar a destajo sin pausas ni distracciones.
examples.translation: If you want to finish quickly, you'll have to work continuously without breaks or distractions.

definitions: Done in large quantities or indiscriminately, often implying haste or lack of care.

examples.sentence: El vendedor lanzó los folletos a destajo, sin preocuparse por a quién se los entregaba.
examples.translation: The vendor threw the flyers indiscriminately, without worrying about to whom he gave them.

examples.sentence: En la fábrica, cortan la tela a destajo para aprovechar al máximo el material, aunque queden piezas pequeñas.
examples.translation: In the factory, they cut the fabric indiscriminately to make the most of the material, even if small pieces remain.

examples.sentence: Los niños comieron galletas a destajo durante la fiesta y al final quedaron con el estómago lleno y un poco malestar.
examples.translation: The children ate cookies in large quantities during the party and ended up full and a bit uncomfortable.

definitions: As of today; at the present time.

examples.sentence: A día de hoy, no se ha encontrado una solución definitiva al problema del tráfico en la ciudad.
examples.translation: As of today, a definitive solution to the city's traffic problem has not been found.

examples.sentence: Los resultados del experimento, a día de hoy, son prometedores pero requieren más análisis.
examples.translation: The results of the experiment, as of today, are promising but require more analysis.

examples.sentence: A día de hoy, hemos recibido más de mil solicitudes para el curso de verano.
examples.translation: As of today, we have received more than a thousand applications for the summer course.

examples.sentence: El edificio todavía está en construcción a día de hoy, aunque se esperaba que terminara el mes pasado.
examples.translation: The building is still under construction as of today, although it was expected to be finished last month.

definitions: Up to now; to date (indicating the current state of affairs).

examples.sentence: A día de hoy, no he recibido respuesta de la empresa sobre mi solicitud de empleo.
examples.translation: To date, I haven't received a response from the company regarding my job application.

examples.sentence: El proyecto ha avanzado mucho a día de hoy, aunque todavía queda trabajo por hacer.
examples.translation: The project has advanced a lot up to now, although there is still work to do.

examples.sentence: A día de hoy, no se ha reportado ningún caso nuevo en la región después del brote inicial.
examples.translation: Up to now, no new cases have been reported in the region after the initial outbreak.

definitions: All over the place; everywhere and in all directions.

examples.sentence: La basura estaba esparcida a diestro y siniestro por todo el parque después de la fiesta.
examples.translation: The trash was scattered all over the park after the party.

examples.sentence: A diestro y siniestro, las hojas caían de los árboles durante el otoño.
examples.translation: Leaves were falling everywhere in all directions during autumn.

examples.sentence: Los mensajes llegaron a diestro y siniestro, causando confusión entre los participantes.
examples.translation: Messages arrived indiscriminately, causing confusion among the participants.

examples.sentence: Los niños corrieron a diestro y siniestro por el patio, jugando sin parar.
examples.translation: The children ran all over the playground, playing nonstop.

definitions: Indiscriminately; without distinction or restraint.

examples.sentence: El rumor se difundió a diestro y siniestro sin importar si era verdad o no.
examples.translation: The rumor spread indiscriminately without caring whether it was true or not.

examples.sentence: El político criticó a diestro y siniestro a sus opositores durante el debate.
examples.translation: The politician criticized his opponents indiscriminately during the debate.

examples.sentence: Los descuentos se aplicaron a diestro y siniestro para atraer más clientes durante el festival.
examples.translation: Discounts were applied indiscriminately to attract more customers during the festival.

definitions: Without restriction or limit; as much as one wants (used of food, drink, supplies, etc.).

examples.sentence: En el banquete, los invitados podían servirse a discreción de las bebidas y la comida.
examples.translation: At the banquet, guests could help themselves to food and drinks without restriction.

examples.sentence: Durante la celebración, ofrecieron comida y refrescos a discreción para que nadie se quedara con hambre.
examples.translation: During the celebration, they offered food and refreshments freely so no one would go hungry.

examples.sentence: En la cantina, los empleados tienen café a discreción durante todo el día.
examples.translation: In the cafeteria, employees have coffee without limit throughout the day.

examples.sentence: El hotel ofrece servicio a discreción en el minibar de la habitación.
examples.translation: The hotel offers unlimited service in the minibar of the room.

definitions: Ordered or permitted to fire freely; 'fire at will' or continuous, unrestricted firing in a military context.

examples.sentence: Durante la batalla, el comandante ordenó disparar a discreción para mantener la presión sobre el enemigo.
examples.translation: During the battle, the commander ordered to fire at will to keep pressure on the enemy.

examples.sentence: Los soldados abrieron fuego a discreción en cuanto recibieron la señal de ataque.
examples.translation: The soldiers opened fire freely as soon as they received the attack signal.

examples.sentence: El entrenamiento incluyó ejercicios en los que se debía disparar a discreción para acostumbrarse al ritmo de combate.
examples.translation: The training included exercises where they had to fire continuously to get used to the combat pace.

definitions: Left to someone's judgment or choice; at the discretion of a person or authority.

examples.sentence: La decisión de otorgar el premio queda a discreción del jurado, basándose en su criterio.
examples.translation: The decision to grant the prize is left to the jury's discretion, based on their judgment.

examples.sentence: El director dejó a discreción de los profesores la elección de los estudiantes para el taller especial.
examples.translation: The director left the selection of students for the special workshop to the teachers' discretion.

examples.sentence: A discreción del médico, se puede cambiar el tratamiento si el paciente no responde bien.
examples.translation: At the doctor's discretion, the treatment can be changed if the patient does not respond well.

definitions: Made available for use; placed at the service of someone or a group (of objects, vehicles, funds, etc.).

examples.sentence: El coche está a disposición del gerente para cualquier viaje de trabajo.
examples.translation: The car is made available to the manager for any business trip.

examples.sentence: Los fondos estarán a disposición del equipo una vez que se apruebe el presupuesto.
examples.translation: The funds will be available to the team once the budget is approved.

examples.sentence: El aula quedó a disposición del club de lectura todos los viernes por la tarde.
examples.translation: The classroom was placed at the disposal of the reading club every Friday afternoon.

examples.sentence: Tenemos varios voluntarios a disposición para ayudar durante el evento comunitario.
examples.translation: We have several volunteers available to help during the community event.

definitions: Handed over or presented to a judicial or law-enforcement authority; placed under the authority of the court or police.

examples.sentence: El sospechoso fue puesto a disposición de la policía para ser interrogado.
examples.translation: The suspect was handed over to the police for interrogation.

examples.sentence: La evidencia quedó a disposición del juez para analizarla durante el juicio.
examples.translation: The evidence was placed at the judge's disposal for review during the trial.

examples.sentence: Tras la detención, el detenido fue a disposición del tribunal para que se decidiera su situación legal.
examples.translation: After the arrest, the detainee was placed under the court's authority to decide his legal situation.

definitions: Being available to assist or serve another person; 'at someone's disposal' when offering help or services.

examples.sentence: Quedo a disposición para ayudarte con lo que necesites durante la mudanza.
examples.translation: I am at your disposal to help with whatever you need during the move.

examples.sentence: El equipo técnico está a disposición del cliente para resolver cualquier problema que surja.
examples.translation: The technical team is at the client's disposal to solve any problems that arise.

examples.sentence: Si tienes dudas, estoy a disposición para aclararlas en cualquier momento.
examples.translation: If you have questions, I am available to clarify them at any time.

definitions: Indicating resemblance to or the presence of pain; 'like pain' or 'sounding/smelling/feeling of pain' in descriptive contexts.

examples.sentence: El sonido del violín me pareció a dolor, como una queja silenciosa en la melodía.
examples.translation: The sound of the violin seemed pain-like to me, like a silent complaint in the melody.

examples.sentence: Su expresión era a dolor, reflejando el sufrimiento que llevaba dentro.
examples.translation: His expression was pain-like, reflecting the suffering he carried inside.

examples.sentence: El olor en la habitación era a dolor, una mezcla extraña que sugería algo desagradable.
examples.translation: The smell in the room was pain-like, a strange mixture suggesting something unpleasant.

definitions: Used in clinical or diagnostic phrases to indicate relation to pain, equivalent to 'to pain' or 'in response to pain' (e.g., a clinical response or reaction directed at a painful stimulus).

examples.sentence: El paciente reaccionó a dolor cuando el médico aplicó presión en la zona afectada.
examples.translation: The patient responded to pain when the doctor applied pressure to the affected area.

examples.sentence: Durante la prueba neurológica, se registraron reflejos a dolor para evaluar la sensibilidad del paciente.
examples.translation: During the neurological test, pain responses were recorded to assess the patient's sensitivity.

examples.sentence: El equipo médico observó contracciones musculares a dolor como parte del diagnóstico.
examples.translation: The medical team observed muscle contractions in response to pain as part of the diagnosis.

examples.sentence: La evaluación a dolor permitió determinar el nivel de daño nervioso en el brazo lesionado.
examples.translation: The pain test allowed determining the level of nerve damage in the injured arm.

definitions: Penniless; lacking money or financial resources.

examples.sentence: Después de pagar todas las cuentas, me quedé a dos velas y tuve que pedir ayuda a mi familia.
examples.translation: After paying all the bills, I was penniless and had to ask my family for help.

examples.sentence: No puedo salir esta noche porque estoy a dos velas; el mes fue muy caro y no me queda dinero.
examples.translation: I can't go out tonight because I'm broke; this month was very expensive and I have no money left.

examples.sentence: Aunque quisiera ayudarte, ahora mismo estoy a dos velas y no puedo prestarte nada.
examples.translation: Although I would like to help you, right now I'm penniless and can't lend you anything.

examples.sentence: Cuando me quedé sin trabajo, estuve a dos velas durante varios meses hasta que encontré otro empleo.
examples.translation: When I lost my job, I was penniless for several months until I found another one.

definitions: Left without what was expected or desired; abandoned, left in the lurch (figurative usage).

examples.sentence: Me dejó a dos velas justo antes de la boda, sin ninguna explicación.
examples.translation: He left me in the lurch just before the wedding, without any explanation.

examples.sentence: No esperaba que me dejaran a dos velas justo cuando más necesitaba apoyo.
examples.translation: I didn’t expect to be abandoned just when I needed support the most.

examples.sentence: Cuando cancelaron el concierto, todos los fans nos quedamos a dos velas sin poder ver a la banda.
examples.translation: When they canceled the concert, all the fans were left empty-handed without being able to see the band.

definitions: With great difficulty; scarcely; barely managing to do or obtain something.

examples.sentence: Conseguí terminar el proyecto a duras penas antes de la fecha límite.
examples.translation: I barely managed to finish the project before the deadline.

examples.sentence: A duras penas lograban sobrevivir con el salario que ganaban cada mes.
examples.translation: They scarcely managed to survive on the salary they earned each month.

examples.sentence: No pudo pagar la renta y a duras penas encontró un lugar donde quedarse.
examples.translation: He couldn’t pay the rent and barely found a place to stay.

examples.sentence: Aunque estaba cansado, a duras penas continuó la carrera hasta la meta.
examples.translation: Although he was tired, he barely continued the race until the finish line.

definitions: It is better to let an enemy who is retreating go unhindered than to pursue them; do not interfere with an adversary's withdrawal.
idiom: a enemigo que huye, puente de plata

examples.sentence: Cuando el enemigo comenzó a retroceder, el comandante ordenó un puente de plata para evitar bajas innecesarias.
examples.translation: When the enemy started to retreat, the commander ordered a safe passage to avoid unnecessary casualties.

examples.sentence: A enemigo que huye, puente de plata; no tiene sentido arriesgar soldados persiguiéndolo.
examples.translation: It's better to let a fleeing enemy go unhindered; it makes no sense to risk soldiers chasing them.
examples.matched_span: A enemigo que huye, puente de plata

examples.sentence: Nos enseñaron que a enemigo que huye, puente de plata, para evitar conflictos mayores.
examples.translation: We were taught that it's better to let a fleeing enemy go to avoid greater conflicts.
examples.matched_span: a enemigo que huye, puente de plata

examples.sentence: Aunque querían capturar al adversario, recordaron que a enemigo que huye, puente de plata y desistieron.
examples.translation: Although they wanted to capture the adversary, they remembered that it's best to let a fleeing enemy go and gave up.
examples.matched_span: a enemigo que huye, puente de plata

definitions: Advise to allow a fleeing opponent to leave safely rather than risk further conflict or harm by chasing them.
idiom: a enemigo que huye, puente de plata

examples.sentence: En la discusión, cuando vio que su oponente se retiraba, pensó: 'a enemigo que huye, puente de plata'.
examples.translation: In the argument, when he saw his opponent retreating, he thought: 'better to let a fleeing enemy go.'
examples.matched_span: a enemigo que huye, puente de plata

examples.sentence: Mi consejo es que no insistas más; a enemigo que huye, puente de plata, deja que se vaya en paz.
examples.translation: My advice is not to insist anymore; it's better to let a fleeing enemy go, let them leave in peace.
examples.matched_span: a enemigo que huye, puente de plata

examples.sentence: Durante la negociación, decidieron no presionar al rival que estaba cediendo, porque a enemigo que huye, puente de plata.
examples.translation: During the negotiation, they decided not to pressure the rival who was giving in, because it's better to let a fleeing enemy go.
examples.matched_span: a enemigo que huye, puente de plata

definitions: To flee or depart hastily; to make a quick getaway to avoid capture, trouble, or responsibility.

examples.sentence: Al ver que la policía se acercaba, el ladrón salió a escape por la puerta trasera.
examples.translation: When he saw the police approaching, the thief made a quick escape through the back door.

examples.sentence: La prisa era tal que tuvimos que a escape sin despedirnos de nadie.
examples.translation: The rush was such that we had to make a quick getaway without saying goodbye to anyone.

examples.sentence: Ella siempre busca a escape cuando las reuniones se prolongan demasiado.
examples.translation: She always looks for a way to make a quick escape when meetings drag on too long.

examples.sentence: El sospechoso fue detenido antes de que pudiera a escape del lugar del crimen.
examples.translation: The suspect was caught before he could flee the crime scene.

definitions: To have the character or function of an escape from routine or obligation; to serve as a means of diversion or relief.

examples.sentence: Para Marta, la pintura es a escape del estrés diario y la rutina agotadora.
examples.translation: For Marta, painting is an escape from daily stress and the exhausting routine.

examples.sentence: Cuando estoy a escape en la montaña, me siento libre y desconectado de todo.
examples.translation: When I am escaping in the mountains, I feel free and disconnected from everything.

examples.sentence: El cine siempre ha sido para ellos a escape de la realidad difícil que enfrentan.
examples.translation: The cinema has always been for them an escape from the difficult reality they face.

definitions: To leave a place urgently or clandestinely with the aim of escaping a situation.

examples.sentence: Durante la protesta, varios manifestantes intentaron a escape cuando la policía intervino.
examples.translation: During the protest, several demonstrators tried to flee when the police intervened.

examples.sentence: El espía tuvo que a escape de la ciudad clandestinamente para evitar ser capturado.
examples.translation: The spy had to leave the city secretly to avoid being captured.

examples.sentence: Cuando los rumores comenzaron a circular, el político decidió a escape para no enfrentar las preguntas.
examples.translation: When rumors started circulating, the politician decided to make a quick getaway to avoid facing questions.

definitions: In secret; without the knowledge of others; clandestinely.

examples.sentence: Los jóvenes se encontraron a escondidas para hablar sobre sus planes sin que los adultos se enteraran.
examples.translation: The young people met in secret to talk about their plans without the adults finding out.

examples.sentence: Ella siempre lee las cartas de amor de su novio a escondidas para no ser descubierta.
examples.translation: She always reads her boyfriend's love letters in secret so she won't be discovered.

examples.sentence: El director tomó la decisión a escondidas, sin consultar al resto del equipo.
examples.translation: The director made the decision secretly, without consulting the rest of the team.

examples.sentence: A escondidas, prepararon una sorpresa para el cumpleaños de María.
examples.translation: In secret, they prepared a surprise for María's birthday.

definitions: Used adverbially with verbs of motion or contact to indicate that the action is performed stealthily or out of sight.

examples.sentence: El gato se movió a escondidas por la casa para no despertar a los niños.
examples.translation: The cat moved stealthily through the house so as not to wake the children.

examples.sentence: Los ladrones entraron a escondidas, evitando las cámaras de seguridad.
examples.translation: The thieves entered stealthily, avoiding the security cameras.

examples.sentence: Ella tomó el libro a escondidas de la biblioteca para leerlo sin permiso.
examples.translation: She took the book stealthily from the library to read it without permission.

definitions: Done furtively or covertly to avoid detection or disapproval.

examples.sentence: A escondidas, los estudiantes organizaron una fiesta sin que los profesores lo supieran.
examples.translation: Secretly, the students organized a party without the teachers knowing.

examples.sentence: Las dos amigas se vieron a escondidas porque sus familias no aprobaban su relación.
examples.translation: The two friends met furtively because their families did not approve of their relationship.

examples.sentence: Trabajaban a escondidas para evitar que la competencia descubriera su estrategia.
examples.translation: They worked covertly to prevent the competition from discovering their strategy.

definitions: Secretly and furtively; on the sly, often implying repeated or surreptitious actions.

examples.sentence: Los adolescentes se escapaban a escondidillas para ir al cine sin permiso de sus padres.
examples.translation: The teenagers secretly sneaked out to go to the movies without their parents' permission.

examples.sentence: A escondidillas, ella visitaba a su abuelo en el hospital para animarlo sin que nadie lo supiera.
examples.translation: Secretly, she visited her grandfather in the hospital to cheer him up without anyone knowing.

examples.sentence: Los empleados hacían a escondidillas pausas más largas para descansar un poco más.
examples.translation: The employees furtively took longer breaks to rest a little more.

examples.sentence: A escondidillas, prepararon una reunión para sorprender al jefe con una fiesta de despedida.
examples.translation: On the sly, they prepared a meeting to surprise the boss with a farewell party.

definitions: In a manner intended to conceal an action from others, typically with a sense of clandestine intimacy or impropriety.

examples.sentence: Se encontraron a escondidillas porque sabían que su relación no sería aceptada por sus familias.
examples.translation: They met secretly because they knew their relationship wouldn't be accepted by their families.

examples.sentence: A escondidillas, pactaron un acuerdo para evitar conflictos en la empresa.
examples.translation: They clandestinely agreed on a deal to avoid conflicts in the company.

examples.sentence: Los jóvenes se veían a escondidillas para no levantar sospechas en el barrio conservador.
examples.translation: The young people saw each other furtively to avoid suspicion in the conservative neighborhood.

definitions: Behind someone's back; without their knowledge or consent, often implying secrecy or betrayal.

examples.sentence: Hablaron a espaldas de Marta para planear la fiesta sorpresa sin que ella se enterara.
examples.translation: They talked behind Marta's back to plan the surprise party without her knowing.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que tomen decisiones a espaldas del equipo; todos deberíamos estar informados.
examples.translation: I don't like them making decisions behind the team's back; we should all be informed.

examples.sentence: Descubrí que habían hablado a espaldas mías sobre mi posible despido en la empresa.
examples.translation: I discovered they had talked behind my back about my possible dismissal from the company.

definitions: Literally, on the back of someone or something; situated at or carried on the rear part.

examples.sentence: Llevaba la mochila a espaldas mientras caminaba por el sendero del bosque.
examples.translation: He carried the backpack on his back while walking along the forest path.

examples.sentence: El cartel estaba colocado a espaldas de la entrada principal para que solo los que entraban lo vieran.
examples.translation: The sign was placed on the back of the main entrance so only those entering could see it.

examples.sentence: Los niños se sentaron a espaldas de la profesora durante la excursión para descansar un poco.
examples.translation: The children sat with their backs to the teacher during the field trip to rest a bit.

examples.sentence: El perro se puso a espaldas del dueño mientras esperaba la orden para salir a pasear.
examples.translation: The dog positioned itself behind the owner while waiting for the order to go for a walk.

definitions: Conducted out of view or awareness of the person concerned, frequently to their detriment.

examples.sentence: Tomaron decisiones importantes a espaldas del director, lo que generó desconfianza en la empresa.
examples.translation: They made important decisions behind the director's back, which generated distrust in the company.

examples.sentence: A espaldas del gobierno, se negociaron acuerdos que beneficiaron solo a ciertos grupos de poder.
examples.translation: Behind the government's back, agreements were negotiated that benefited only certain power groups.

examples.sentence: El equipo trabajó a espaldas del entrenador para preparar una estrategia sorpresa.
examples.translation: The team worked behind the coach's back to prepare a surprise strategy.

definitions: In very large quantities; plentifully; in abundance.

examples.sentence: En el mercado había frutas a espuertas, y podías comprar kilos por un precio muy bajo.
examples.translation: At the market, there were fruits in abundance, and you could buy kilos for a very low price.

examples.sentence: Durante la celebración, sirvieron comida a espuertas para que nadie se quedara con hambre.
examples.translation: During the celebration, they served food plentifully so that no one went hungry.

examples.sentence: Los años de lluvia permitieron que crecieran flores a espuertas en el jardín.
examples.translation: The rainy years allowed flowers to grow in great quantities in the garden.

examples.sentence: Encontramos libros viejos a espuertas en la biblioteca del pueblo abandonado.
examples.translation: We found old books in great abundance in the library of the abandoned town.

definitions: In a profuse or copious manner, often implying excess or ease of acquisition.

examples.sentence: Los niños comían dulces a espuertas durante la fiesta de cumpleaños sin preocuparse por las calorías.
examples.translation: The children ate sweets profusely during the birthday party without worrying about calories.

examples.sentence: En aquella época, las oportunidades laborales aparecían a espuertas para quienes querían trabajar.
examples.translation: At that time, job opportunities appeared in abundance for those willing to work.

examples.sentence: La empresa regaló productos a espuertas para promocionar su nueva línea sin importar el gasto.
examples.translation: The company gave away products freely to promote its new line regardless of the cost.

definitions: Freely or without restraint, especially regarding spending or distribution.

examples.sentence: Gastaban dinero a espuertas en fiestas y viajes sin pensar en el futuro.
examples.translation: They spent money lavishly on parties and trips without thinking about the future.

examples.sentence: El alcalde distribuyó fondos a espuertas para ganar apoyo político durante la campaña.
examples.translation: The mayor distributed funds freely to gain political support during the campaign.

examples.sentence: En la celebración, se ofrecieron bebidas a espuertas para todos los invitados.
examples.translation: At the celebration, drinks were offered lavishly to all the guests.

definitions: Lavishly or wastefully, when indicating that something is given or used in excess.

examples.sentence: No deberías regalar cosas a espuertas, mejor piensa en ahorrar para emergencias.
examples.translation: You shouldn't give things away wastefully; it's better to think about saving for emergencies.

examples.sentence: El chef usó especias a espuertas en la receta, lo que arruinó el sabor del plato.
examples.translation: The chef used spices lavishly in the recipe, which ruined the dish's flavor.

examples.sentence: Gastaron recursos a espuertas en un proyecto que finalmente no tuvo éxito.
examples.translation: They wasted resources lavishly on a project that ultimately failed.

definitions: At this stage of the process, situation, or event; at this point in time.

examples.sentence: A estas alturas del partido, ya no tiene sentido cambiar de estrategia.
examples.translation: At this stage of the game, it no longer makes sense to change strategy.

examples.sentence: Estamos a estas alturas del partido y aún no hemos decidido qué hacer con el proyecto.
examples.translation: We are at this point in time and still haven't decided what to do with the project.

examples.sentence: A estas alturas del partido, lo mejor es aceptar las consecuencias y seguir adelante.
examples.translation: Given how far things have progressed, it's best to accept the consequences and move forward.

definitions: It is too late to change course or to undertake a particular action now; given what has already happened.

examples.sentence: A estas alturas del partido, cambiar de opinión sería contraproducente.
examples.translation: At this point, changing your mind would be counterproductive.

examples.sentence: No podemos retroceder ahora; a estas alturas del partido, debemos continuar con el plan.
examples.translation: We can't go back now; given what has already happened, we must continue with the plan.

examples.sentence: A estas alturas del partido, ya es demasiado tarde para pedir perdón.
examples.translation: At this stage, it's too late to ask for forgiveness.

definitions: Given how far things have progressed, in the present circumstances.

examples.sentence: A estas alturas del partido, todos sabemos que el acuerdo no será fácil de alcanzar.
examples.translation: Given how far things have progressed, we all know the agreement won't be easy to reach.

examples.sentence: El equipo está cansado, pero a estas alturas del partido no pueden rendirse.
examples.translation: The team is tired, but at this point, they can't give up.

examples.sentence: A estas alturas del partido, lo que importa es el resultado final, no los errores anteriores.
examples.translation: At this stage, what matters is the final result, not the previous mistakes.

definitions: As an emphatic assertion meaning 'I swear' or 'upon my faith', used to guarantee the truthfulness of a statement.

examples.sentence: A fe mía que no he visto nada sospechoso en la oficina durante la mañana.
examples.translation: I swear I haven't seen anything suspicious in the office this morning.

examples.sentence: Te digo a fe que ese documento es auténtico y no una falsificación.
examples.translation: I tell you upon my faith that this document is authentic and not a forgery.

examples.sentence: A fe que lo intenté todo para solucionar el problema, pero no hubo manera.
examples.translation: I swear I tried everything to solve the problem, but there was no way.

definitions: An interjection expressing strong affirmation or conviction, equivalent to 'indeed' or 'truly'.

examples.sentence: A fe, este es el mejor pastel que he probado en mucho tiempo.
examples.translation: Indeed, this is the best cake I've tasted in a long time.

examples.sentence: A fe que tienes razón, la reunión fue más complicada de lo que pensábamos.
examples.translation: Truly, you are right; the meeting was more complicated than we thought.

examples.sentence: A fe, nunca había visto una película tan emocionante como esta.
examples.translation: Indeed, I had never seen such an exciting movie like this.

definitions: An oath invoking one's honor or belief to confirm sincerity or veracity.

examples.sentence: A fe que cumpliré con mi promesa, puedes confiar en mí.
examples.translation: I swear on my honor that I will keep my promise; you can trust me.

examples.sentence: Lo juro a fe que no participé en esa decisión y no tengo nada que ver con ello.
examples.translation: I swear upon my faith that I did not participate in that decision and have nothing to do with it.

examples.sentence: A fe que hablé con sinceridad durante toda la entrevista, sin ocultar nada.
examples.translation: I swear that I spoke sincerely throughout the interview, hiding nothing.

definitions: Ultimately; in the end; when everything is considered.

examples.sentence: A fin de cuentas, lo que importa es que aprendimos de la experiencia.
examples.translation: Ultimately, what matters is that we learned from the experience.

examples.sentence: Después de discutir durante horas, a fin de cuentas decidieron aceptar la propuesta.
examples.translation: After arguing for hours, in the end they decided to accept the proposal.

examples.sentence: A fin de cuentas, todos queremos lo mejor para el equipo y el proyecto.
examples.translation: When all is said and done, we all want the best for the team and the project.

definitions: After all; used to introduce a summary conclusion or final assessment.

examples.sentence: A fin de cuentas, no fue tan difícil como pensábamos al principio.
examples.translation: After all, it wasn’t as difficult as we thought at the beginning.

examples.sentence: No importa lo que haya pasado antes; a fin de cuentas, lo importante es seguir adelante.
examples.translation: It doesn’t matter what happened before; after all, the important thing is to move forward.

examples.sentence: A fin de cuentas, el dinero no lo es todo en la vida.
examples.translation: After all, money isn’t everything in life.

definitions: Having feelings or emotions very near the surface; experiencing intense emotions that are easily expressed.

examples.sentence: Después de escuchar la noticia, sentí las emociones a flor de piel y no pude contener las lágrimas.
examples.translation: After hearing the news, I felt emotions very near the surface and couldn’t hold back the tears.

examples.sentence: Durante la obra de teatro, las emociones estaban a flor de piel y eso se notaba en la actuación.
examples.translation: During the play, emotions were running high and it showed in the performance.

examples.sentence: Cuando habló de su pasado, sus sentimientos estaban a flor de piel, muy sinceros y profundos.
examples.translation: When he spoke about his past, his feelings were very close to the surface, very sincere and deep.

definitions: Having nerves on edge; being tense, irritable, or easily upset.

examples.sentence: Después de tantas semanas sin descansar, estoy a flor de piel y cualquier cosa me irrita.
examples.translation: After so many weeks without rest, I am on edge and anything irritates me.

examples.sentence: Con tanto estrés en el trabajo, María está a flor de piel y se enoja fácilmente.
examples.translation: With so much stress at work, María is tense and gets angry easily.

examples.sentence: En ese momento, sus nervios estaban a flor de piel por la presión del examen final.
examples.translation: At that moment, his nerves were on edge due to the pressure of the final exam.

definitions: Emotionally raw or highly sensitive to emotional stimuli.

examples.sentence: Cuando Ana vio la carta de despedida, sus emociones estaban a flor de piel y no pudo contener las lágrimas.
examples.translation: When Ana saw the farewell letter, her emotions were raw and she couldn't hold back the tears.

examples.sentence: No me hables de ese tema ahora, que tengo los nervios a flor de piel después del accidente.
examples.translation: Don't talk to me about that topic now, my nerves are raw after the accident.

examples.sentence: Después de la discusión con su mejor amigo, Carlos tenía los sentimientos a flor de piel y se mostraba muy sensible.
examples.translation: After the argument with his best friend, Carlos had his feelings on edge and was very sensitive.

definitions: At maximum capacity; completely full or packed.

examples.sentence: El concierto estaba a full, no quedaba ni un solo asiento libre en todo el auditorio.
examples.translation: The concert was full, there wasn't a single empty seat left in the entire auditorium.

examples.sentence: Mañana el restaurante va a estar a full porque es día festivo y todos quieren celebrar ahí.
examples.translation: Tomorrow the restaurant will be full because it's a holiday and everyone wants to celebrate there.

examples.sentence: No pudimos entrar al cine porque la sala estaba a full y no aceptaban más público.
examples.translation: We couldn't get into the cinema because the theater was full and they weren't accepting more people.

definitions: Busy or operating at full occupancy.

examples.sentence: El taller está a full esta semana, todos los mecánicos están ocupados con reparaciones urgentes.
examples.translation: The workshop is busy this week, all the mechanics are occupied with urgent repairs.

examples.sentence: ¿Sabes si la oficina está a full hoy? Tengo que llamar para pedir una cita.
examples.translation: Do you know if the office is busy today? I need to call to make an appointment.

examples.sentence: Durante la temporada alta, el hotel funciona a full y no hay habitaciones disponibles.
examples.translation: During the high season, the hotel operates at full capacity and there are no rooms available.

definitions: At maximum power, speed, or intensity.

examples.sentence: El motor del coche estaba a full cuando cruzamos la autopista a toda velocidad.
examples.translation: The car engine was at full power when we crossed the highway at full speed.

examples.sentence: Para ganar la carrera, el ciclista tuvo que pedalear a full durante los últimos kilómetros.
examples.translation: To win the race, the cyclist had to pedal at full intensity during the last kilometers.

examples.sentence: Aunque el equipo estaba cansado, siguió trabajando a full para terminar el proyecto a tiempo.
examples.translation: Although the team was tired, they kept working at full intensity to finish the project on time.

definitions: Completely; entirely; fully (used as an English adjective or adverb in bilingual contexts).

examples.sentence: Estoy a full con mis estudios este semestre, no tengo tiempo para nada más.
examples.translation: I am fully occupied with my studies this semester, I have no time for anything else.

examples.sentence: El restaurante está a full en las noches, pero durante el día está tranquilo.
examples.translation: The restaurant is fully packed at night, but during the day it is quiet.

examples.sentence: Aunque está a full de trabajo, siempre encuentra tiempo para su familia.
examples.translation: Although he is fully busy with work, he always finds time for his family.

definitions: Working or applied to the fullest possible extent.

examples.sentence: El entrenador quiere que los jugadores den a full en el partido decisivo de mañana.
examples.translation: The coach wants the players to give their all in tomorrow's decisive match.

examples.sentence: Si quieres aprobar el examen, tendrás que estudiar a full durante las próximas semanas.
examples.translation: If you want to pass the exam, you will have to study fully during the next few weeks.

examples.sentence: Ella trabaja a full para sacar adelante su proyecto a pesar de las dificultades.
examples.translation: She works at full capacity to push forward her project despite the difficulties.

definitions: On hands and knees; crawling in a literal, physical sense.

examples.sentence: El bebé empezó a moverse a gatas por toda la sala esta mañana.
examples.translation: The baby started crawling on hands and knees all over the living room this morning.

examples.sentence: Vi a mi perro a gatas tratando de alcanzar su juguete debajo del sofá.
examples.translation: I saw my dog crawling on all fours trying to reach his toy under the sofa.

examples.sentence: Durante la visita al zoológico, los niños imitaron a gatas a los pequeños felinos en el exhibidor.
examples.translation: During the zoo visit, the children imitated the little felines crawling on all fours in the exhibit.

examples.sentence: Cuando se cayó, tuvo que arrastrarse a gatas hasta la puerta para pedir ayuda.
examples.translation: When he fell, he had to crawl on hands and knees to the door to ask for help.

definitions: Humbly or submissively, as in groveling or begging.

examples.sentence: Después de perder el juicio, el empresario tuvo que ir a gatas a pedir perdón a sus socios.
examples.translation: After losing the lawsuit, the businessman had to humbly go begging for forgiveness from his partners.

examples.sentence: No pienso ir a gatas a suplicar por un aumento, prefiero buscar otro trabajo.
examples.translation: I don't intend to grovel and beg for a raise, I'd rather look for another job.

examples.sentence: Ella nunca se pone a gatas para nadie; siempre defiende sus principios con dignidad.
examples.translation: She never grovels to anyone; she always defends her principles with dignity.

definitions: With great difficulty; barely managing to proceed.

examples.sentence: Con la deuda acumulada, la empresa avanzaba a gatas y apenas podía pagar a sus empleados.
examples.translation: With accumulated debt, the company was barely moving forward and could hardly pay its employees.

examples.sentence: Durante el invierno, los agricultores trabajaron a gatas para salvar la cosecha afectada por la sequía.
examples.translation: During the winter, the farmers struggled greatly to save the crop affected by the drought.

examples.sentence: A pesar de las dificultades, el equipo a gatas logró terminar el proyecto antes del plazo.
examples.translation: Despite the difficulties, the team barely managed to finish the project before the deadline.

definitions: Acting in a very dependent or humiliated way.

examples.sentence: Después del escándalo, el político actuaba a gatas para recuperar la confianza de sus votantes.
examples.translation: After the scandal, the politician acted submissively to regain the trust of his voters.

examples.sentence: No me gusta cuando alguien se pone a gatas solo para agradar a sus jefes.
examples.translation: I don't like it when someone acts humbly just to please their bosses.

examples.sentence: María no estaba dispuesta a ir a gatas para obtener ese puesto de trabajo.
examples.translation: María was not willing to grovel to get that job position.

definitions: Extremely pleasant or delightful, especially of taste, smell, sound, or sensation.

examples.sentence: El aroma del café recién hecho estaba a gloria y me despertó con una sonrisa.
examples.translation: The aroma of freshly made coffee was delightful and woke me up with a smile.

examples.sentence: La música de aquel concierto estuvo a gloria, cada nota tocó mi corazón.
examples.translation: The music at that concert was wonderful, every note touched my heart.

examples.sentence: Después de una larga caminata, el baño caliente fue a gloria para relajar mis músculos.
examples.translation: After a long walk, the hot bath was blissful to relax my muscles.

definitions: Used to indicate that something is wonderfully satisfying or blissful.

examples.sentence: Pasar el fin de semana en la playa fue a gloria; necesitaba ese descanso desesperadamente.
examples.translation: Spending the weekend at the beach was wonderful; I desperately needed that rest.

examples.sentence: La sonrisa de mi hija cuando le di el regalo fue a gloria, no había nada más satisfactorio.
examples.translation: My daughter's smile when I gave her the gift was blissful; there was nothing more satisfying.

examples.sentence: Escuchar esa noticia después de tanto tiempo fue a gloria para todos en la familia.
examples.translation: Hearing that news after so long was wonderful for everyone in the family.

definitions: In broad terms; in outline; without going into details.

examples.sentence: El profesor explicó a grandes rasgos el contenido del examen para que nos enfocáramos en los temas principales.
examples.translation: The teacher explained the exam content in broad terms so we could focus on the main topics.

examples.sentence: En la reunión, presentaron a grandes rasgos el plan de negocios sin entrar en detalles técnicos.
examples.translation: In the meeting, they presented the business plan in outline form without going into technical details.

examples.sentence: Para entender la historia a grandes rasgos, debes conocer los eventos más importantes primero.
examples.translation: To understand the history in broad terms, you must first know the most important events.

definitions: Summarily; giving a general overview rather than specific particulars.

examples.sentence: Podrías contarme a grandes rasgos qué ocurrió durante la conferencia? No necesito todos los detalles.
examples.translation: Could you tell me in summary what happened during the conference? I don't need all the details.

examples.sentence: El informe a grandes rasgos indica que las ventas aumentaron, pero no especifica por qué.
examples.translation: The report summarily indicates that sales increased, but doesn't specify why.

examples.sentence: Para empezar, hablemos a grandes rasgos del proyecto y luego iremos profundizando.
examples.translation: To start, let's talk broadly about the project and then we'll go into depth.

definitions: With a piteous, anguished, or plaintive cry.

examples.sentence: Al enterarse de la pérdida, gritó a grito herido y nadie pudo calmarla.
examples.translation: Upon learning of the loss, she screamed with a piteous cry and no one could calm her.

examples.sentence: El niño llamó a grito herido cuando se cayó y se lastimó la rodilla en el parque.
examples.translation: The child cried out plaintively when he fell and hurt his knee in the park.

examples.sentence: Durante la película triste, muchos espectadores sollozaron a grito herido por la emoción.
examples.translation: During the sad movie, many viewers sobbed with anguished cries from emotion.

definitions: In a loudly urgent or vehement way, often expressing distress or strong emotion.

examples.sentence: El manifestante protestó a grito herido para exigir justicia ante la multitud.
examples.translation: The protester shouted loudly and urgently to demand justice before the crowd.

examples.sentence: En la reunión, el empleado habló a grito herido para que sus preocupaciones fueran escuchadas.
examples.translation: In the meeting, the employee spoke vehemently so that his concerns would be heard.

examples.sentence: Ella llamó a grito herido a la policía cuando vio el accidente en la calle.
examples.translation: She shouted urgently to the police when she saw the accident on the street.

definitions: Uttered in a strained, wounded, or vehement manner of shouting.

examples.sentence: La víctima de la injusticia gritó a grito herido pidiendo ayuda sin descanso.
examples.translation: The victim of injustice shouted vehemently asking for help without stopping.

examples.sentence: El entrenador expresó a grito herido su frustración por la mala actuación del equipo.
examples.translation: The coach expressed his frustration loudly and stridently because of the team's poor performance.

examples.sentence: Cuando el fuego comenzó, los vecinos gritaban a grito herido para alertar a todos en el barrio.
examples.translation: When the fire started, the neighbors shouted vehemently to alert everyone in the neighborhood.

definitions: By shouting loudly; at the top of one's lungs.

examples.sentence: Durante el partido, los fans cantaban a grito limpio alentando al equipo sin parar.
examples.translation: During the match, the fans sang loudly at the top of their lungs encouraging the team nonstop.

examples.sentence: No podía escuchar nada porque el niño lloraba a grito limpio en la habitación contigua.
examples.translation: I couldn't hear anything because the child was crying loudly at the top of his lungs in the next room.

examples.sentence: El manifestante gritó a grito limpio para que su voz se escuchara en toda la plaza.
examples.translation: The protester shouted loudly to make his voice heard throughout the square.

definitions: In a loud, forceful manner intended to attract attention or impose one's will.

examples.sentence: Para llamar la atención del director, Marta habló a grito limpio en medio de la asamblea.
examples.translation: To get the director's attention, Marta spoke loudly and forcefully in the middle of the assembly.

examples.sentence: Los vendedores anuncian sus productos a grito limpio para atraer clientes en el mercado.
examples.translation: The vendors loudly announce their products to attract customers at the market.

examples.sentence: Cuando reclamó por el servicio, lo hizo a grito limpio para que se resolviera su problema rápido.
examples.translation: When he complained about the service, he did it forcefully to get his problem solved quickly.

definitions: With loud, unrestrained shouting; at full voice.

examples.sentence: La cantante interpretó la ópera a grito pelado, llenando el teatro con su potente voz.
examples.translation: The singer performed the opera loudly and unrestrained, filling the theater with her powerful voice.

examples.sentence: Durante el partido, los hinchas alentaban a grito pelado sin importar el frío ni la lluvia.
examples.translation: During the match, the fans cheered loudly and without restraint regardless of the cold or rain.

examples.sentence: No pudimos dormir porque los vecinos celebraban a grito pelado hasta la madrugada.
examples.translation: We couldn't sleep because the neighbors were partying loudly and unrestrained until dawn.

definitions: Blatantly or openly, without subtlety or reserve.

examples.sentence: El vendedor promocionaba a grito pelado sin disimulo, tratando de convencer a todos en la calle.
examples.translation: The salesman was blatantly promoting loudly, trying to convince everyone on the street.

examples.sentence: No es necesario gritar a grito pelado para que te escuchen; puedes hablar con calma y respeto.
examples.translation: It's not necessary to shout blatantly for them to hear you; you can speak calmly and respectfully.

examples.sentence: El político criticó a grito pelado a sus oponentes durante el debate público.
examples.translation: The politician openly and loudly criticized his opponents during the public debate.

definitions: Sung or spoken loudly and without restraint.

examples.sentence: Los niños cantaban a grito pelado su canción favorita en la excursión escolar.
examples.translation: The children sang their favorite song loudly and without restraint on the school trip.

examples.sentence: En el karaoke, Marta interpretó la balada a grito pelado y todos aplaudieron emocionados.
examples.translation: At karaoke, Marta performed the ballad loudly and without restraint, and everyone applauded excitedly.

examples.sentence: Los aficionados animaron a grito pelado durante todo el partido sin descanso.
examples.translation: The fans cheered loudly and unrestrained throughout the entire match without rest.

definitions: Carried on the shoulders of others, typically as a gesture of triumph or celebration.

examples.sentence: Después de ganar el campeonato, los jugadores fueron llevados a hombros por los aficionados eufóricos.
examples.translation: After winning the championship, the players were carried on the shoulders by the ecstatic fans.

examples.sentence: Cuando la selección nacional regresó, la multitud los recibió a hombros en el aeropuerto.
examples.translation: When the national team returned, the crowd welcomed them on their shoulders at the airport.

examples.sentence: Tras la victoria, el héroe local fue a hombros por todo el pueblo en señal de admiración.
examples.translation: After the victory, the local hero was carried on shoulders throughout the town as a sign of admiration.

definitions: Figuratively supported or borne by someone else; to be dependent on another's effort or resources.

examples.sentence: Este proyecto va a hombros de un equipo muy comprometido que ha trabajado sin descanso.
examples.translation: This project is borne by a very committed team that has worked tirelessly.

examples.sentence: No puedo hacer todo solo, necesito que el equipo cargue conmigo a hombros esta responsabilidad.
examples.translation: I can't do everything alone, I need the team to support this responsibility with me.

examples.sentence: El éxito de la empresa está a hombros de sus empleados dedicados y creativos.
examples.translation: The company's success rests on the shoulders of its dedicated and creative employees.

definitions: Transported by being placed on someone's shoulders.

examples.sentence: El niño fue transportado a hombros por su padre para alcanzar la cima de la colina sin cansarse.
examples.translation: The child was carried on his father's shoulders to reach the top of the hill without getting tired.

examples.sentence: Durante la procesión, la estatua del santo fue llevada a hombros por los fieles devotos.
examples.translation: During the procession, the statue of the saint was carried on the shoulders by the devoted faithful.

examples.sentence: Los soldados cruzaron el río llevando a hombros el equipo pesado para no mojarlo.
examples.translation: The soldiers crossed the river carrying the heavy equipment on their shoulders to keep it dry.

examples.sentence: En la fiesta, el novio fue llevado a hombros por sus amigos mientras todos cantaban.
examples.translation: At the party, the groom was carried on the shoulders by his friends while everyone sang.

definitions: Astride; sitting with one leg on each side of something (e.g., a horse, saddle, or object).

examples.sentence: Montó a horcajadas sobre el caballo y comenzó su paseo por el campo.
examples.translation: He mounted astride the horse and began his ride through the countryside.

examples.sentence: La niña se sentó a horcajadas en la silla mientras esperaba que comenzara la clase.
examples.translation: The girl sat astride the chair while waiting for the class to start.

examples.sentence: Para alcanzar la rama, el hombre se paró a horcajadas sobre la escalera con cuidado.
examples.translation: To reach the branch, the man stood astride the ladder carefully.

examples.sentence: Se colocó a horcajadas sobre la motocicleta, listo para arrancar.
examples.translation: He positioned himself astride the motorcycle, ready to start.

definitions: Figuratively, occupying a position that spans or bridges two areas, roles, or conditions.

examples.sentence: El director está a horcajadas entre la tradición y la innovación en su forma de liderar la empresa.
examples.translation: The director is straddling tradition and innovation in his way of leading the company.

examples.sentence: Ella se encuentra a horcajadas entre dos culturas, lo que le da una perspectiva única de la vida.
examples.translation: She is straddling two cultures, which gives her a unique perspective on life.

examples.sentence: La novela está a horcajadas entre el realismo y la fantasía, mezclando ambos géneros con habilidad.
examples.translation: The novel straddles realism and fantasy, skillfully mixing both genres.

definitions: Straddling or positioned with legs apart on either side of an object.

examples.sentence: El ciclista pasó la calle a horcajadas, con una pierna a cada lado del vehículo estacionado.
examples.translation: The cyclist crossed the street astride, with one leg on each side of the parked vehicle.

examples.sentence: Para limpiar la ventana, se subió a horcajadas sobre el alféizar sin miedo a caerse.
examples.translation: To clean the window, he climbed astride on the sill without fear of falling.

examples.sentence: Los niños jugaban a horcajadas sobre el tronco caído en el bosque.
examples.translation: The children played astride on the fallen log in the forest.

examples.sentence: Para tomar mejor la foto, se sentó a horcajadas en la barandilla del puente.
examples.translation: To take a better photo, he sat astride on the railing of the bridge.

definitions: Very easy or convenient; readily available and requiring little effort.

examples.sentence: Conseguir entradas para el concierto fue a huevo, porque las vendían en la esquina del teatro.
examples.translation: Getting tickets for the concert was very easy because they were sold at the theater corner.

examples.sentence: No te preocupes por la tarea, la solución está a huevo en el libro que te presté.
examples.translation: Don't worry about the homework, the solution is very easy to find in the book I lent you.

examples.sentence: El examen estuvo a huevo, todas las preguntas eran sobre lo que estudiamos en clase.
examples.translation: The exam was very easy, all the questions were about what we studied in class.

definitions: Used as an emphatic interjection or intensifier meaning 'certainly' or 'definitely' (colloquial slang).

examples.sentence: ¿Vas a ir a la fiesta? — ¡A huevo! No me la pierdo por nada.
examples.translation: Are you going to the party? — Definitely! I won't miss it for anything.

examples.sentence: Si me ayudas con el proyecto, a huevo que termino antes de la fecha límite.
examples.translation: If you help me with the project, I will definitely finish before the deadline.

examples.sentence: ¿Te gustó la película? — A huevo, fue una de las mejores que he visto este año.
examples.translation: Did you like the movie? — Definitely, it was one of the best I've seen this year.

definitions: Having something handed to one on a plate; an opportunity presented in an especially favorable way.

examples.sentence: Cuando me ofrecieron ese trabajo sin siquiera hacer una entrevista, supe que era a huevo.
examples.translation: When they offered me that job without even an interview, I knew it was handed to me on a plate.

examples.sentence: No puedes desaprovechar esta oportunidad tan buena, te la están dando a huevo.
examples.translation: You can't miss out on this great opportunity; they're giving it to you on a silver platter.

examples.sentence: Si él logra el contrato será a huevo, porque el cliente ya confía en su empresa.
examples.translation: If he lands the contract, it will be a sure thing because the client already trusts his company.

definitions: By means of show, ostentation, or empty talk; relying on appearances rather than substance.

examples.sentence: El político solo habla a humo de pajas para impresionar, pero no tiene propuestas concretas.
examples.translation: The politician only talks with empty show to impress, but he has no concrete proposals.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que esas empresas vendan a humo de pajas; prefiero hechos reales.
examples.translation: I don't like those companies selling smoke and mirrors; I prefer real facts.

examples.sentence: Durante la reunión, Marta se dio cuenta de que todo era a humo de pajas, sin sustancia real.
examples.translation: During the meeting, Marta realized everything was just show, without real substance.

definitions: With no real effect or result; futilely or superficially.

examples.sentence: Intentaron convencernos, pero sus promesas fueron a humo de pajas y no cambiaron nada.
examples.translation: They tried to convince us, but their promises were futile and changed nothing.

examples.sentence: Gastaron mucho dinero en publicidad, pero al final todo quedó a humo de pajas sin resultados.
examples.translation: They spent a lot on advertising, but in the end it was all superficial with no results.

examples.sentence: No vale la pena esforzarse si el proyecto termina siendo a humo de pajas y sin impacto real.
examples.translation: It's not worth the effort if the project ends up being futile and without real impact.

definitions: In the old-fashioned or traditional manner; according to former customs or practices.

examples.sentence: Mi abuela cocina el pan a la antigua, usando solo levadura natural y fuego de leña.
examples.translation: My grandmother bakes bread the old-fashioned way, using only natural yeast and wood fire.

examples.sentence: Aunque ahora hay máquinas, en la fábrica siguen trabajando a la antigua para mantener la calidad.
examples.translation: Although there are machines now, at the factory they still work in the traditional way to maintain quality.

examples.sentence: En el pueblo, la gente se viste a la antigua durante las fiestas para recordar sus raíces.
examples.translation: In the village, people dress in the old-fashioned style during festivals to remember their roots.

definitions: Describing a person or thing as old-fashioned, conservative, or resistant to modern ways.

examples.sentence: Juan es a la antigua, no le gusta usar teléfonos inteligentes ni redes sociales.
examples.translation: Juan is old-fashioned; he doesn't like using smartphones or social media.

examples.sentence: Aunque el mundo cambia rápido, ella sigue a la antigua y prefiere cartas en lugar de emails.
examples.translation: Although the world changes fast, she remains old-fashioned and prefers letters over emails.

examples.sentence: Dicen que su pensamiento es a la antigua, pero tiene buenos valores que merecen respeto.
examples.translation: They say his mindset is old-fashioned, but he has good values that deserve respect.

definitions: To spend time idly or lazily; to laze about or loaf.

examples.sentence: El domingo me quedé a la bartola todo el día viendo películas sin hacer nada.
examples.translation: On Sunday I lazed around all day watching movies without doing anything.

examples.sentence: Después de la semana tan intensa, prefiero pasar el fin de semana a la bartola en casa.
examples.translation: After such an intense week, I prefer spending the weekend idly at home.

examples.sentence: Los niños estaban a la bartola en el parque, sin preocuparse por la tarea ni los deberes.
examples.translation: The children were loafing about in the park, unconcerned with homework or chores.

examples.sentence: Aunque tenía mucho trabajo, terminó la tarde a la bartola sin hacer nada productivo.
examples.translation: Even though he had a lot of work, he ended the afternoon just lazing around without doing anything productive.

definitions: To shirk duties or avoid work; to neglect responsibilities through idleness.

examples.sentence: No puedes estar a la bartola cuando tienes responsabilidades importantes que cumplir.
examples.translation: You can't shirk your duties when you have important responsibilities to fulfill.

examples.sentence: Si sigues a la bartola en el trabajo, te van a despedir por falta de compromiso.
examples.translation: If you keep avoiding work, you'll be fired for lack of commitment.

examples.sentence: María dejó a la bartola sus estudios y ahora está preocupada por no haber avanzado.
examples.translation: María neglected her studies and now she is worried about not having progressed.

definitions: To relax or recline without doing anything productive.

examples.sentence: Después de la caminata, nos sentamos a la bartola en la sombra para descansar un rato.
examples.translation: After the hike, we relaxed lazily in the shade to rest for a while.

examples.sentence: En las vacaciones, prefiero estar a la bartola sin preocuparme por nada.
examples.translation: On vacation, I prefer to recline idly without worrying about anything.

examples.sentence: Llegaron temprano y pasaron la mañana a la bartola en la playa, disfrutando del sol.
examples.translation: They arrived early and spent the morning lounging idly on the beach, enjoying the sun.

definitions: By force or with violence; using coercion rather than persuasion.

examples.sentence: La policía entró a la brava para detener al sospechoso sin darle oportunidad de reaccionar.
examples.translation: The police barged in by force to arrest the suspect without giving him a chance to react.

examples.sentence: Si no abres la puerta, entraremos a la brava para revisar el lugar por seguridad.
examples.translation: If you don’t open the door, we’ll enter by force to check the place for safety.

examples.sentence: Los ladrones intentaron entrar a la brava, pero el sistema de alarma los ahuyentó.
examples.translation: The thieves tried to break in by force, but the alarm system scared them off.

definitions: Bluntly or rudely; done directly and without tact or subtlety.

examples.sentence: Me dijo a la brava que no le gustaba el plan sin dar explicaciones ni alternativas.
examples.translation: He bluntly told me he didn’t like the plan without giving explanations or alternatives.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que me hablen a la brava, prefiero conversaciones más amables y respetuosas.
examples.translation: I don’t like being spoken to rudely; I prefer kinder and more respectful conversations.

examples.sentence: Cuando discutieron, ella expresó su opinión a la brava, sin preocuparse por herir sentimientos.
examples.translation: When they argued, she expressed her opinion bluntly, without caring about hurting feelings.

definitions: Haphazardly or carelessly; carried out without planning, structure, or concern for consequences.

examples.sentence: El proyecto fue hecho a la buena de Dios, sin planificación ni control, por eso fracasó.
examples.translation: The project was done haphazardly, without planning or control, which is why it failed.

examples.sentence: No podemos seguir trabajando a la buena de Dios; necesitamos un plan claro y ordenado.
examples.translation: We can’t keep working carelessly; we need a clear and organized plan.

examples.sentence: Cuando organizan eventos a la buena de Dios, suelen surgir muchos problemas inesperados.
examples.translation: When they organize events haphazardly, many unexpected problems usually arise.

definitions: Left to chance or to fate; abandoned to others' care or to circumstance without protection.

examples.sentence: Dejaron a los niños a la buena de Dios mientras ellos se iban de viaje sin supervisión.
examples.translation: They left the children to fate while they went on a trip without supervision.

examples.sentence: No podemos abandonar a los pacientes a la buena de Dios; se necesita atención constante.
examples.translation: We can’t abandon the patients to chance; constant care is needed.

examples.sentence: El barco quedó a la buena de Dios en medio de la tormenta, sin ninguna ayuda cercana.
examples.translation: The boat was left to fate in the middle of the storm, with no help nearby.

definitions: By good fortune; as a matter of luck; by chance.

examples.sentence: Ganó la lotería a la buena ventura y su vida cambió por completo de la noche a la mañana.
examples.translation: He won the lottery by good fortune and his life completely changed overnight.

examples.sentence: A la buena ventura, conseguimos entradas para el concierto que estaban agotadas.
examples.translation: By good luck, we got tickets to the sold-out concert.

examples.sentence: No esperaba el ascenso, fue a la buena ventura cuando el jefe decidió cambiar el equipo.
examples.translation: I didn’t expect the promotion; it was by chance when the boss decided to change the team.

definitions: Haphazardly; without a clear plan or deliberate method; at random.

examples.sentence: El estudiante respondió las preguntas a la buena ventura, sin estudiar ni prepararse bien.
examples.translation: The student answered the questions haphazardly, without studying or preparing well.

examples.sentence: Si lanzas las semillas a la buena ventura, no tendrás un buen jardín, necesitas planificar.
examples.translation: If you scatter the seeds at random, you won’t have a good garden; you need to plan.

examples.sentence: Los trabajadores hicieron su tarea a la buena ventura y el jefe terminó insatisfecho.
examples.translation: The workers did their job carelessly and the boss ended up dissatisfied.

definitions: To rely on luck rather than planning or calculation.

examples.sentence: No podemos seguir confiando en el éxito a la buena ventura; hay que diseñar una estrategia.
examples.translation: We can’t keep relying on luck for success; we need to design a strategy.

examples.sentence: Siempre juega a la buena ventura sin analizar las consecuencias, y por eso pierde mucho dinero.
examples.translation: He always relies on luck without analyzing the consequences, and that’s why he loses a lot of money.

examples.sentence: Si decides hacer negocios a la buena ventura, podrías tener problemas financieros graves.
examples.translation: If you decide to do business by luck rather than planning, you could face serious financial problems.

definitions: Quietly and secretly; in a stealthy manner that avoids attracting attention.

examples.sentence: María logró a la chita callando que nadie notara su ascenso en la empresa.
examples.translation: María quietly managed to get promoted without anyone noticing.

examples.sentence: El ladrón entró a la chita callando para no despertar a nadie en la casa.
examples.translation: The thief entered stealthily so as not to wake anyone in the house.

examples.sentence: Juan fue a la chita callando ganando terreno en el mercado sin llamar la atención de sus competidores.
examples.translation: Juan was gradually gaining ground in the market quietly without attracting his competitors’ attention.

definitions: Gradually and imperceptibly; accomplishing something little by little without notice.

examples.sentence: A la chita callando, el proyecto fue tomando forma hasta que finalmente se presentó completo.
examples.translation: Gradually and imperceptibly, the project took shape until it was finally presented complete.

examples.sentence: El equipo avanzó a la chita callando, sin hacer mucho ruido pero logrando grandes resultados.
examples.translation: The team progressed little by little, quietly but achieving great results.

examples.sentence: A la chita callando, la empresa fue ganando clientes sin hacer publicidad agresiva.
examples.translation: Quietly and little by little, the company was gaining clients without aggressive advertising.

definitions: Surreptitiously; on the sly.

examples.sentence: A la chita callando, Marta empezó a trabajar en su novela sin contarle a nadie.
examples.translation: On the sly, Marta started working on her novel without telling anyone.

examples.sentence: El director decidió a la chita callando cambiar la política interna sin anunciarlo públicamente.
examples.translation: The director surreptitiously decided to change the internal policy without announcing it publicly.
