examples.translation: They organized the party hastily because they didn't have time to plan it well.

definitions: Rare or regional expression indicating that something is kept as a safeguard or emergency resource; literally 'as a hand-saving/handy measure'.

examples.sentence: Guardamos ese medicamento a salvamano por si alguien se siente mal durante el viaje.
examples.translation: We keep that medicine as a safeguard in case someone feels sick during the trip.

examples.sentence: Tengo un plan B a salvamano en caso de que el proyecto principal no funcione.
examples.translation: I have a backup plan at hand in case the main project doesn't work.

examples.sentence: Dejaron una copia del contrato a salvamano para cualquier eventualidad.
examples.translation: They left a copy of the contract as a safeguard for any eventuality.

definitions: Obsolete usage meaning 'within reach' or 'readily at hand'; appears infrequently in historical texts and regional speech.

examples.sentence: En el pueblo decían que el cuchillo siempre debía estar a salvamano en la cocina.
examples.translation: In the village, they said the knife should always be within reach in the kitchen.

examples.sentence: A salvamano tengo una lista de contactos para emergencias, aunque rara vez la uso.
examples.translation: I have an emergency contact list readily at hand, although I rarely use it.

examples.sentence: Los ancianos mantenían el bastón a salvamano mientras caminaban por el mercado.
examples.translation: The elders kept the cane within reach while walking through the market.

definitions: Used in technical or archaic contexts to refer to a protective device or guard for the hand (e.g., a hand guard), hence figuratively 'as protection' or 'as a contingency'.

examples.sentence: El artesano colocó un a salvamano en la herramienta para proteger la mano durante el trabajo.
examples.translation: The craftsman placed a hand guard on the tool to protect the hand during work.

examples.sentence: En los textos antiguos, el término a salvamano se usaba para referirse a un protector manual metálico.
examples.translation: In old texts, the term 'a salvamano' was used to refer to a metal hand guard.

examples.sentence: El equipo de seguridad incluye un a salvamano para evitar cortes accidentales con la sierra.
examples.translation: The safety equipment includes a hand guard to prevent accidental cuts with the saw.

examples.sentence: Como medida a salvamano, se añadió un protector de goma en el mango de la herramienta.
examples.translation: As a protective measure, a rubber guard was added to the tool's handle.

definitions: In cold blood; showing no emotion, remorse, or agitation when committing a violent or harmful act.

examples.sentence: El asesino actuó a sangre fría, sin mostrar ningún remordimiento durante el juicio.
examples.translation: The murderer acted in cold blood, showing no remorse during the trial.

examples.sentence: Nunca olvidaré cómo disparó a sangre fría sin dudar ni un segundo.
examples.translation: I will never forget how he shot in cold blood without hesitation.

examples.sentence: Cometió el crimen a sangre fría, lo que horrorizó a toda la comunidad.
examples.translation: He committed the crime in cold blood, which horrified the entire community.

definitions: Deliberately and calmly, especially with reference to crimes or acts of violence carried out without apparent passion or provocation.

examples.sentence: El ataque fue planeado y ejecutado a sangre fría, sin dejar lugar a la improvisación.
examples.translation: The attack was planned and carried out deliberately, without improvisation.

examples.sentence: A sangre fría, el ladrón observó su objetivo antes de actuar con calma y precisión.
examples.translation: Coldly, the thief observed his target before acting calmly and precisely.

examples.sentence: Se enfrentaron a sangre fría, sin que la tensión alterara su juicio ni sus movimientos.
examples.translation: They confronted each other coldly, without tension affecting their judgment or movements.

definitions: Figuratively, done calmly and dispassionately, without visible feeling or haste.

examples.sentence: Hizo la presentación a sangre fría, sin mostrar nervios ni alteración alguna.
examples.translation: He gave the presentation calmly and dispassionately, without showing nerves or agitation.

examples.sentence: Respondió a sangre fría a todas las preguntas difíciles durante la entrevista.
examples.translation: He responded calmly to all the difficult questions during the interview.

examples.sentence: A sangre fría, decidió cortar relaciones con su socio sin discutirlo previamente.
examples.translation: Coldly, he decided to cut ties with his partner without prior discussion.

definitions: Performed with cool detachment or composure, even when the action is severe or harsh.

examples.sentence: Aunque la crítica fue dura, la aceptó a sangre fría y sin perder la compostura.
examples.translation: Although the criticism was harsh, he accepted it with cool detachment and composure.

examples.sentence: Ejecutó la orden a sangre fría, sin mostrar emoción ni vacilación alguna.
examples.translation: He executed the order with cool detachment, showing no emotion or hesitation.

examples.sentence: El juez tomó la decisión a sangre fría, basándose únicamente en los hechos presentados.
examples.translation: The judge made the decision calmly, based solely on the facts presented.

definitions: By means of severe violence and destruction; through bloodshed and fire.

examples.sentence: El ejército avanzó a sangre y fuego, destruyendo todo a su paso.
examples.translation: The army advanced by means of severe violence and destruction, destroying everything in its path.

examples.sentence: La revolución se extendió a sangre y fuego por todo el país sin piedad.
examples.translation: The revolution spread through the country by bloodshed and fire, mercilessly.

examples.sentence: Los rebeldes tomaron la ciudad a sangre y fuego, dejando ruinas tras su paso.
examples.translation: The rebels took the city through bloodshed and fire, leaving ruins behind.

definitions: Using ruthless force or extreme measures, especially in military, political, or repressive contexts.

examples.sentence: El régimen reprimió a sangre y fuego cualquier intento de protesta o disidencia.
examples.translation: The regime ruthlessly suppressed any attempt at protest or dissent.

examples.sentence: Aplicaron medidas a sangre y fuego para terminar con la revuelta rápidamente.
examples.translation: They applied ruthless measures to quickly end the uprising.

examples.sentence: La policía actuó a sangre y fuego contra los manifestantes pacíficos.
examples.translation: The police acted with extreme force against the peaceful protesters.

definitions: Figuratively, to accomplish something with uncompromising intensity or radical action.

examples.sentence: Lograron la victoria a sangre y fuego, sin ceder ni un solo paso al enemigo.
examples.translation: They achieved victory with uncompromising intensity, not yielding an inch to the enemy.

examples.sentence: Defendió sus ideas a sangre y fuego, sin aceptar críticas ni concesiones.
examples.translation: He defended his ideas with uncompromising intensity, without accepting criticism or concessions.

examples.sentence: El artista persiguió su sueño a sangre y fuego, sacrificando todo por su pasión.
examples.translation: The artist pursued his dream with radical action, sacrificing everything for his passion.

definitions: Expresses the idea of achieving an objective by forceful, drastic, and often violent means.

examples.sentence: El director impuso cambios a sangre y fuego para transformar la empresa rápidamente.
examples.translation: The director imposed drastic changes to transform the company quickly.

examples.sentence: Para consolidar su poder, actuó a sangre y fuego contra cualquier oposición interna.
examples.translation: To consolidate his power, he acted ruthlessly against any internal opposition.

examples.sentence: El equipo ganó el campeonato a sangre y fuego, con una dedicación y esfuerzo extremos.
examples.translation: The team won the championship with uncompromising intensity, with extreme dedication and effort.

definitions: Simply; just; without any added title, qualifier, or additional information — used to indicate the bare name or item alone.

examples.sentence: Pido un café a secas, sin leche ni azúcar, por favor.
examples.translation: I ask for a coffee simply, without milk or sugar, please.

examples.sentence: Juan dijo su nombre a secas, sin dar más detalles sobre su identidad.
examples.translation: Juan said his name plainly, without giving more details about his identity.

examples.sentence: Compré el libro a secas, sin la edición especial ni la funda protectora.
examples.translation: I bought the book just the book, without the special edition or protective cover.

examples.sentence: El informe fue entregado a secas, sin anexos ni gráficos adicionales.
examples.translation: The report was delivered simply, without attachments or additional charts.

definitions: Neat; plain; served without mixers, sauces, or accompaniments (commonly used for drinks or food).

examples.sentence: Prefiero el whisky a secas, sin hielo ni mezclas.
examples.translation: I prefer whisky neat, without ice or mixers.

examples.sentence: El camarero preguntó si quería el vino a secas o con agua.
examples.translation: The waiter asked if I wanted the wine neat or with water.

examples.sentence: Para apreciar el sabor, siempre tomo el tequila a secas y sin limón.
examples.translation: To appreciate the flavor, I always drink tequila neat and without lime.

definitions: Used to indicate that nothing else accompanies or modifies the referent; purely and nothing more.

examples.sentence: El contrato se firmó a secas, sin ninguna cláusula adicional que modificar.
examples.translation: The contract was signed purely, without any additional clause to modify.

examples.sentence: Recibí la noticia a secas, sin explicaciones ni detalles extra.
examples.translation: I received the news plainly, without explanations or extra details.

examples.sentence: El plato llegó a secas, solo con arroz y sin guarniciones.
examples.translation: The dish arrived plain, just rice without side dishes.

definitions: In a squatting or crouched position; while squatting.

examples.sentence: Durante el entrenamiento, hicimos varias repeticiones a sentadillas para fortalecer las piernas.
examples.translation: During training, we did several repetitions squatting to strengthen the legs.

examples.sentence: El niño se agachó a sentadillas para recoger la pelota que había caído al suelo.
examples.translation: The child crouched down while squatting to pick up the ball that had fallen on the ground.

examples.sentence: A sentadillas, limpiaron el suelo con esmero después de la fiesta.
examples.translation: Squatting, they carefully cleaned the floor after the party.

examples.sentence: Ella trabaja a sentadillas en el huerto para plantar las semillas sin dañar las plantas cercanas.
examples.translation: She works squatting in the garden to plant the seeds without damaging nearby plants.

definitions: By performing squats (exercise); used when referring to the action of doing squat repetitions.

examples.sentence: Cada mañana hago veinte sentadillas para mantenerme en forma.
examples.translation: Every morning I do twenty squats to stay in shape.

examples.sentence: Ayer en el gimnasio completé tres series de sentadillas antes de correr.
examples.translation: Yesterday at the gym I completed three sets of squats before running.

examples.sentence: ¿Puedes contar cuántas sentadillas hiciste durante la clase de pilates?
examples.translation: Can you count how many squats you did during the Pilates class?

examples.sentence: Los entrenadores recomiendan hacer sentadillas con la espalda recta para evitar lesiones.
examples.translation: Trainers recommend doing squats with a straight back to avoid injuries.

definitions: To the naked eye; visible without the aid of instruments or magnification.

examples.sentence: A simple vista, el cuadro parecía auténtico, pero luego resultó ser una copia.
examples.translation: To the naked eye, the painting looked authentic, but later it turned out to be a copy.

examples.sentence: Las manchas en la pared no se notaban a simple vista, solo con luz directa se veían claramente.
examples.translation: The stains on the wall were not visible to the naked eye; only under direct light could they be clearly seen.

examples.sentence: A simple vista, el documento parecía estar en orden, aunque faltaban algunas firmas.
examples.translation: At first glance, the document seemed to be in order, although some signatures were missing.

examples.sentence: Si miras el terreno a simple vista, parece plano, pero en realidad tiene varias pendientes.
examples.translation: If you look at the land with the naked eye, it seems flat, but actually it has several slopes.

definitions: At first glance; apparently or superficially, as perceived by a casual or initial inspection.

examples.sentence: A simple vista, el proyecto parece viable, pero necesita un análisis más profundo.
examples.translation: At first glance, the project seems viable, but it needs a deeper analysis.

examples.sentence: A simple vista, no hay problemas con el sistema, aunque podría haber fallos ocultos.
examples.translation: At first glance, there are no problems with the system, although there could be hidden faults.

examples.sentence: Ella parecía muy amable a simple vista, pero después su actitud cambió completamente.
examples.translation: She seemed very kind at first glance, but later her attitude changed completely.

definitions: Probable nonstandard or erroneous form of 'a socapa'; meaning secretly, surreptitiously, or on the sly.

examples.sentence: Marcos siempre toma decisiones a so capa, sin avisar a nadie en la oficina.
examples.translation: Marcos always makes decisions secretly, without telling anyone at the office.

examples.sentence: A so capa, entregaron los documentos para evitar que se filtrara la información.
examples.translation: Secretly, they delivered the documents to prevent the information from leaking.

examples.sentence: No quiero que se entere nadie, así que haremos la reunión a so capa esta vez.
examples.translation: I don't want anyone to find out, so we'll have the meeting secretly this time.

definitions: Alone; by oneself; without the presence of other people.

examples.sentence: Después de un día largo, prefiero estar a solas en mi habitación para descansar.
examples.translation: After a long day, I prefer to be alone in my room to rest.

examples.sentence: No me gusta salir mucho; disfruto estar a solas leyendo un buen libro.
examples.translation: I don't like going out much; I enjoy being alone reading a good book.

examples.sentence: María pasó la tarde a solas, reflexionando sobre sus próximos pasos en la vida.
examples.translation: María spent the afternoon alone, reflecting on her next steps in life.

examples.sentence: ¿Quieres venir conmigo? Prefiero no estar a solas todo el tiempo.
examples.translation: Do you want to come with me? I prefer not to be alone all the time.

definitions: In private; alone with another person or persons for confidential conversation or interaction.

examples.sentence: El director pidió hablar a solas con el gerente para aclarar la situación.
examples.translation: The director asked to speak in private with the manager to clarify the situation.

examples.sentence: Cuando estamos a solas, me cuentas la verdad sin miedo a que alguien escuche.
examples.translation: When we are alone, you tell me the truth without fear that someone will hear.

examples.sentence: Prefiero discutir este asunto a solas, sin que otros se involucren.
examples.translation: I prefer to discuss this matter in private, without others getting involved.

definitions: For the purpose of relaxation, recreation, or enjoyment.

examples.sentence: Fuimos al parque a solaz después de una semana estresante en el trabajo.
examples.translation: We went to the park for relaxation after a stressful week at work.

examples.sentence: Ella siempre lee novelas a solaz cuando quiere desconectarse de la rutina.
examples.translation: She always reads novels for enjoyment when she wants to disconnect from the routine.

examples.sentence: Los domingos los pasamos a solaz, sin hacer nada importante.
examples.translation: We spend Sundays for leisure, doing nothing important.

definitions: For consolation or relief from distress; as a comfort or solace.

examples.sentence: Después de la mala noticia, buscó música a solaz para calmar su tristeza.
examples.translation: After the bad news, he sought music for consolation to calm his sadness.

examples.sentence: Los amigos se reunieron a solaz para apoyarse en tiempos difíciles.
examples.translation: The friends gathered for solace to support each other in difficult times.

examples.sentence: Leí poemas a solaz cuando necesitaba un poco de consuelo emocional.
examples.translation: I read poems for consolation when I needed a bit of emotional comfort.

definitions: As an amusement or pastime.

examples.sentence: Pintar cuadros es su pasatiempo favorito a solaz durante los fines de semana.
examples.translation: Painting is his favorite pastime for amusement during weekends.

examples.sentence: Se dedicaba a la jardinería a solaz para distraerse del estrés diario.
examples.translation: He devoted himself to gardening as an amusement to distract from daily stress.

examples.sentence: Jugaban cartas a solaz mientras esperaban que llegara la cena.
examples.translation: They played cards for amusement while waiting for dinner to arrive.

definitions: At the appropriate or appointed time; in due course.

examples.sentence: El informe será entregado a su debido tiempo, no te preocupes por la fecha.
examples.translation: The report will be delivered in due course, don't worry about the date.

examples.sentence: Las promesas se cumplirán a su debido tiempo, cuando todo esté listo.
examples.translation: Promises will be fulfilled at the appropriate time, when everything is ready.

examples.sentence: Confía, que las respuestas llegarán a su debido tiempo y no antes.
examples.translation: Trust that the answers will come in due time and not before.

definitions: When the circumstances or schedule make it proper to do so.

examples.sentence: El contrato se firmará a su debido tiempo, cuando ambas partes estén de acuerdo.
examples.translation: The contract will be signed when the circumstances make it proper, when both parties agree.

examples.sentence: No adelantemos los acontecimientos; las decisiones se tomarán a su debido tiempo.
examples.translation: Let's not jump ahead; decisions will be made when the time is right.

examples.sentence: Los estudiantes recibirán su certificado a su debido tiempo, tras completar el curso.
examples.translation: Students will receive their certificate at the proper time, after completing the course.

definitions: At the scheduled or proper time; punctually.

examples.sentence: El tren salió a su hora, puntual como siempre.
examples.translation: The train left on time, punctual as always.

examples.sentence: La clase empieza a su hora, por lo que no debes llegar tarde.
examples.translation: The class starts at the scheduled time, so you shouldn't be late.

examples.sentence: Las luces se apagaron a su hora, marcando el fin del evento.
examples.translation: The lights went off at the proper time, marking the end of the event.

examples.sentence: El doctor llegó a su hora para la consulta programada.
examples.translation: The doctor arrived at the scheduled time for the appointment.

definitions: In one's own time or when it is one's turn; at the appropriate moment in a sequence.

examples.sentence: Cada uno hablará a su hora durante la reunión para evitar interrupciones.
examples.translation: Everyone will speak in their own time during the meeting to avoid interruptions.

examples.sentence: No te preocupes, ese asunto se resolverá a su hora cuando sea el momento adecuado.
examples.translation: Don't worry, that matter will be resolved in its own time when the right moment comes.

examples.sentence: Los niños aprendieron a caminar a su hora, sin presiones de los padres.
examples.translation: The children learned to walk in their own time, without pressure from the parents.

definitions: Comfortably; at ease and without discomfort.

examples.sentence: Después de un día estresante, me gusta estar en casa a mis anchas, sin preocupaciones.
examples.translation: After a stressful day, I like to be at home comfortably, without worries.

examples.sentence: En el sofá me sentí a mis anchas y pude descansar por fin en paz.
examples.translation: On the sofa I felt at ease and was finally able to rest in peace.

examples.sentence: Los niños jugaban a sus anchas en el parque, felices y sin temor a nada.
examples.translation: The children played freely in the park, happy and without fear of anything.

definitions: Free to act without restraint; unchecked.

examples.sentence: En ese grupo, cada quien actúa a sus anchas, sin que nadie les imponga reglas.
examples.translation: In that group, everyone acts freely, without anyone imposing rules on them.

examples.sentence: El dirigente permitió que los miembros operaran a sus anchas, lo que generó problemas de coordinación.
examples.translation: The leader allowed members to operate unchecked, which caused coordination problems.

examples.sentence: No podemos dejar que los empleados trabajen a sus anchas, necesitamos supervisión constante.
examples.translation: We can't let employees work unchecked; we need constant supervision.

definitions: In a state of physical or mental ease.

examples.sentence: Después de las vacaciones, regreso a la oficina a mis anchas, sin estrés ni preocupaciones.
examples.translation: After vacation, I return to the office feeling at ease, without stress or worries.

examples.sentence: Cuando estoy leyendo un libro en casa, me siento a mis anchas y disfruto el momento.
examples.translation: When I'm reading a book at home, I feel comfortable and enjoy the moment.

examples.sentence: En la naturaleza, me muevo a mis anchas, sin prisa y conectado con el entorno.
examples.translation: In nature, I move freely, without hurry and connected with the environment.

definitions: Roaming or operating with little or no control or opposition.

examples.sentence: Los bandoleros se movían a sus anchas por la región, sin miedo a la policía.
examples.translation: The bandits roamed freely through the region, without fear of the police.

examples.sentence: Los rumores corren a sus anchas por la oficina, causando tensiones entre los empleados.
examples.translation: Rumors run unchecked through the office, causing tensions among employees.

examples.sentence: En tiempos de caos, las pandillas actúan a sus anchas y la seguridad se ve comprometida.
examples.translation: In times of chaos, gangs operate unchecked and security is compromised.

definitions: Physically at or near someone's feet.

examples.sentence: El perro se sentó a sus pies mientras su dueño trabajaba en la sala.
examples.translation: The dog sat at his owner's feet while he worked in the living room.

examples.sentence: Durante la ceremonia, la reina permaneció a sus pies de su consejero más fiel.
examples.translation: During the ceremony, the queen stayed at the feet of her most loyal advisor.

examples.sentence: Los niños se arrodillaron a sus pies para pedirle un deseo al anciano sabio.
examples.translation: The children knelt at the feet of the wise old man to ask for a wish.

examples.sentence: Encontré mi libro favorito tirado a sus pies en el suelo de la habitación.
examples.translation: I found my favorite book lying at his feet on the bedroom floor.

definitions: In a posture of submission, reverence, or adoration toward someone.

examples.sentence: El poeta estaba a sus pies, admirando cada palabra que ella pronunciaba en el recital.
examples.translation: The poet was at her feet, admiring every word she spoke at the recital.

examples.sentence: Los fans quedaron a sus pies después del concierto, rendidos ante su talento.
examples.translation: The fans were at his feet after the concert, overwhelmed by his talent.

examples.sentence: Ella tiene a sus pies a todo el público con su carisma y presencia escénica.
examples.translation: She has the entire audience at her feet with her charisma and stage presence.

definitions: To have someone or something completely under one's control or influence; to command or dominate.

examples.sentence: El político tenía a sus pies a los votantes gracias a sus promesas y discursos convincentes.
examples.translation: The politician had the voters at his feet thanks to his promises and convincing speeches.

examples.sentence: Con su encanto, logró tener a sus pies a los inversores y asegurar el financiamiento.
examples.translation: With her charm, she managed to have investors at her feet and secure funding.

examples.sentence: El entrenador mantiene a sus jugadores a sus pies para controlar cada aspecto del equipo.
examples.translation: The coach keeps his players under his control to manage every aspect of the team.

definitions: To surrender oneself emotionally or deferentially to another.

examples.sentence: A pesar de las críticas, ella se rindió a sus pies y aceptó la ayuda que le ofrecieron.
examples.translation: Despite the criticism, she surrendered emotionally and accepted the help offered to her.

examples.sentence: Después de años de lucha, finalmente se entregó a sus pies y encontró paz interior.
examples.translation: After years of struggle, he finally gave himself over and found inner peace.

examples.sentence: El artista se puso a sus pies, mostrando su admiración y respeto por el maestro.
examples.translation: The artist humbled himself, showing admiration and respect for the master.

definitions: Deliberately and with a specific aim or purpose; intentionally.

examples.sentence: Le dispararon a tiro hecho, sin dudar ni un segundo, en medio del enfrentamiento.
examples.translation: He was shot deliberately, without hesitation, in the middle of the confrontation.

examples.sentence: El francotirador apuntó a tiro hecho y logró impactar al objetivo desde larga distancia.
examples.translation: The sniper aimed deliberately and managed to hit the target from a long distance.

examples.sentence: Ella cuestionó a tiro hecho las decisiones del director en la junta de ayer.
examples.translation: She deliberately challenged the director's decisions at yesterday's meeting.

definitions: At point-blank range; delivered from very close distance (especially of a shot).

examples.sentence: El disparo a tiro hecho impactó la puerta sin causar daños mayores en el muro.
examples.translation: The point-blank shot hit the door without causing major damage to the wall.

examples.sentence: Recibió un disparo a tiro hecho durante el asalto y fue trasladado al hospital inmediatamente.
examples.translation: He was shot at point-blank range during the assault and was taken to the hospital immediately.

examples.sentence: El cazador disparó a tiro hecho para asegurarse de abatir al animal sin fallar.
examples.translation: The hunter shot at point-blank range to ensure he would kill the animal without missing.

examples.sentence: En la película, el villano dispara a tiro hecho contra el héroe en el clímax.
examples.translation: In the movie, the villain shoots point-blank at the hero during the climax.

definitions: Doing something directly and without detours, aimed at a particular target or outcome.

examples.sentence: Le pregunté a tiro hecho si realmente quería cambiar de carrera y fue honesto conmigo.
examples.translation: I asked him directly if he really wanted to change careers and he was honest with me.

examples.sentence: Cuando hablas a tiro hecho, la gente entiende que vas al grano sin rodeos.
examples.translation: When you speak directly, people understand that you get straight to the point without beating around the bush.

examples.sentence: Ella fue a tiro hecho en la negociación para conseguir el mejor acuerdo posible.
examples.translation: She went straight to the point in the negotiation to get the best possible deal.

definitions: At full gallop (literally referring to a horse moving at maximum speed).

examples.sentence: El jinete llevó al caballo a toda brida durante la carrera en el campo abierto.
examples.translation: The rider took the horse at full gallop during the race in the open field.

examples.sentence: A toda brida, el caballo cruzó la meta dejando atrás a todos los competidores.
examples.translation: At full gallop, the horse crossed the finish line leaving all competitors behind.

examples.sentence: Durante el entrenamiento, corrimos a toda brida para mejorar nuestra resistencia.
examples.translation: During training, we ran at full speed to improve our endurance.

examples.sentence: El cowboy controlaba al caballo a toda brida mientras atravesaban el desierto.
examples.translation: The cowboy controlled the horse at full gallop while crossing the desert.

definitions: Figuratively, at top speed; very quickly or with great haste.

examples.sentence: Estamos trabajando a toda brida para terminar el informe antes del viernes.
examples.translation: We are working very quickly to finish the report before Friday.

examples.sentence: El equipo se movió a toda brida para cumplir con los plazos del proyecto.
examples.translation: The team moved at full speed to meet the project deadlines.

examples.sentence: Cuando reciben una emergencia, los bomberos actúan a toda brida sin perder tiempo.
examples.translation: When they receive an emergency, firefighters act very quickly without wasting time.

definitions: Regardless of the cost, expense, or consequences; by any means necessary.

examples.sentence: María quiso ganar la beca a toda costa, incluso si eso significaba sacrificar sus vacaciones.
examples.translation: María wanted to win the scholarship at all costs, even if it meant sacrificing her vacation.

examples.sentence: No importa lo que cueste, debemos salvar el proyecto a toda costa para asegurar el futuro de la empresa.
examples.translation: No matter what it costs, we must save the project at all costs to secure the company's future.

examples.sentence: ¿Por qué insistes en defender esa idea a toda costa si sabes que es inviable?
examples.translation: Why do you insist on defending that idea at all costs if you know it is unfeasible?

definitions: With absolute determination to achieve an objective, even if it requires great sacrifice.

examples.sentence: Carlos luchó a toda costa por su sueño de convertirse en artista, sin importar los obstáculos.
examples.translation: Carlos fought with absolute determination for his dream of becoming an artist, regardless of the obstacles.

examples.sentence: Ella se esforzará a toda costa para lograr la medalla en las próximas olimpiadas.
examples.translation: She will strive with absolute determination to win the medal in the next Olympics.

examples.sentence: No podemos rendirnos; tenemos que avanzar a toda costa para cumplir nuestro objetivo.
examples.translation: We cannot give up; we have to move forward at all costs to achieve our goal.

definitions: At all hours; continuously or repeatedly throughout the day and night.

examples.sentence: Mi hermano llama a toda hora para saber cómo estoy después del accidente.
examples.translation: My brother calls at all hours to check how I am after the accident.

examples.sentence: Los vecinos se quejaron porque el perro ladra a toda hora y no los deja dormir.
examples.translation: The neighbors complained because the dog barks at all hours and doesn't let them sleep.

examples.sentence: A toda hora llegan turistas al museo, sin importar el día o la temporada.
examples.translation: Tourists arrive at the museum at all hours, regardless of the day or season.

definitions: At any time; whenever (without restriction to a particular hour).

examples.sentence: Puedes llamarme a toda hora si necesitas ayuda con el proyecto.
examples.translation: You can call me at any time if you need help with the project.

examples.sentence: Ella está disponible a toda hora para sus clientes, incluso fuera del horario laboral.
examples.translation: She is available at any time for her clients, even outside working hours.

examples.sentence: No importa la hora, él responde los mensajes a toda hora porque trabaja desde casa.
examples.translation: No matter the time, he answers messages at any time because he works from home.

definitions: At very high speed; full throttle.

examples.sentence: El piloto llevó el avión a toda hostia para llegar a tiempo a destino.
examples.translation: The pilot flew the plane at full throttle to arrive on time.

examples.sentence: ¿Viste cómo el coche de Juan aceleró a toda hostia en la autopista?
examples.translation: Did you see how Juan's car sped at full throttle on the highway?

examples.sentence: Nos fuimos a toda hostia para evitar el embotellamiento en la ciudad.
examples.translation: We left at full speed to avoid the traffic jam in the city.

definitions: With great intensity or volume (e.g., very loudly or forcefully).

examples.sentence: En la fiesta, la música sonaba a toda hostia y nadie podía escuchar nada más.
examples.translation: At the party, the music played very loudly and no one could hear anything else.

examples.sentence: Los vecinos se quejaron porque el televisor estaba a toda hostia hasta la madrugada.
examples.translation: The neighbors complained because the TV was on at full volume until dawn.

examples.sentence: El entrenador gritaba a toda hostia para motivar al equipo durante el partido.
examples.translation: The coach shouted very loudly to motivate the team during the match.

definitions: To do something very quickly or to leave hurriedly.

examples.sentence: Al escuchar la alarma, me fui a toda hostia sin mirar atrás.
examples.translation: When I heard the alarm, I left very quickly without looking back.

examples.sentence: Terminamos el trabajo a toda hostia para poder salir temprano.
examples.translation: We finished the work very quickly so we could leave early.

examples.sentence: Si quieres llegar a tiempo, tendrás que irte a toda hostia desde aquí.
examples.translation: If you want to arrive on time, you’ll have to leave very quickly from here.

definitions: At top speed; very quickly; in great haste.

examples.sentence: Corrí a toda leche para alcanzar el autobús que ya estaba por salir.
examples.translation: I ran at top speed to catch the bus that was about to leave.

examples.sentence: Los niños bajaban la colina a toda leche mientras jugaban en el parque.
examples.translation: The children went down the hill very quickly while playing in the park.

examples.sentence: Si no te das prisa, no llegarás a tiempo; tienes que ir a toda leche.
examples.translation: If you don't hurry, you won't arrive on time; you have to go very quickly.

definitions: With great intensity or force; energetically; operating at full capacity.

examples.sentence: La banda tocaba a toda leche, llenando el estadio con energía y fuerza.
examples.translation: The band played with great intensity, filling the stadium with energy and force.

examples.sentence: Durante el partido, el equipo atacó a toda leche para tratar de remontar el marcador.
examples.translation: During the match, the team attacked energetically to try to come back in the score.

examples.sentence: Ella trabaja a toda leche para entregar el informe antes del fin de semana.
examples.translation: She works energetically to deliver the report before the weekend.

definitions: To move or act with urgent rapidity.

examples.sentence: Tuvimos que movernos a toda leche para preparar todo antes de que llegaran los invitados.
examples.translation: We had to move urgently to prepare everything before the guests arrived.

examples.sentence: El equipo de emergencias llegó a toda leche tras recibir el aviso de accidente.
examples.translation: The emergency team arrived urgently after receiving the accident alert.

examples.sentence: Cuando sonó la alarma, los trabajadores salieron a toda leche del edificio.
examples.translation: When the alarm sounded, the workers left the building very quickly.

definitions: Doing something in a vigorous, all-out manner.

examples.sentence: Los atletas entrenan a toda leche para mejorar su rendimiento en la competencia.
examples.translation: The athletes train vigorously to improve their performance in the competition.

examples.sentence: Se dedicó a estudiar a toda leche para aprobar el examen final con buena nota.
examples.translation: He devoted himself to studying in an all-out manner to pass the final exam with a good grade.

examples.sentence: La empresa trabajó a toda leche para lanzar el producto a tiempo en el mercado.
examples.translation: The company worked vigorously to launch the product on time in the market.

definitions: In strict accordance with the law; lawful; legitimate.

examples.sentence: El contrato fue redactado a toda ley para evitar futuros conflictos legales.
examples.translation: The contract was drafted in strict accordance with the law to avoid future legal conflicts.

examples.sentence: La empresa opera a toda ley y cumple con todas las regulaciones del sector.
examples.translation: The company operates lawfully and complies with all industry regulations.

examples.sentence: Se asegura de que todas las licencias estén a toda ley antes de abrir el nuevo negocio.
examples.translation: He makes sure all licenses are fully valid before opening the new business.

examples.sentence: Los documentos fueron verificados a toda ley por el equipo jurídico de la universidad.
examples.translation: The documents were verified in strict accordance with the law by the university's legal team.

definitions: Fully valid or rightful under legal or established rules.

examples.sentence: Su derecho a reclamar está a toda ley, así que no lo pueden ignorar.
examples.translation: His right to claim is fully valid under the law, so they cannot ignore it.

examples.sentence: El permiso que obtuvimos es a toda ley, lo que garantiza la legalidad del evento.
examples.translation: The permit we obtained is fully valid, which guarantees the legality of the event.

examples.sentence: No hay duda de que el contrato es a toda ley, por eso podemos proceder sin miedo.
examples.translation: There is no doubt that the contract is fully valid, so we can proceed without fear.

definitions: Clearly and unmistakably; plainly; in full view (figurative).

examples.sentence: El fraude quedó a toda luz cuando revisaron las cuentas con detalle.
examples.translation: The fraud became clearly and unmistakably evident when they reviewed the accounts in detail.

examples.sentence: La verdad salió a toda luz después de que todos los testigos hablaran.
examples.translation: The truth came out plainly after all the witnesses spoke.

examples.sentence: Su mentira fue expuesta a toda luz durante la reunión del consejo directivo.
examples.translation: His lie was exposed openly and unmistakably during the board meeting.

definitions: With full brightness; in full light (literal).

examples.sentence: La sala estaba iluminada a toda luz para la conferencia de prensa.
examples.translation: The room was lit with full brightness for the press conference.

examples.sentence: El cuadro quedó a toda luz para que todos pudieran apreciar los detalles.
examples.translation: The painting was displayed in full light so everyone could appreciate the details.

examples.sentence: Durante la fiesta, el jardín estuvo a toda luz gracias a las lámparas instaladas.
examples.translation: During the party, the garden was bathed in abundant light thanks to the installed lamps.

examples.sentence: El taller se mantuvo a toda luz para facilitar el trabajo de los artesanos.
examples.translation: The workshop was kept in full light to facilitate the artisans’ work.

definitions: Openly and without doubt or ambiguity.

examples.sentence: El escándalo se hizo público a toda luz y nadie pudo ocultarlo.
examples.translation: The scandal became public openly and without doubt, and no one could hide it.

examples.sentence: A toda luz, quedó demostrado que el acusado no cumplía con las normas.
examples.translation: It was clearly shown without any doubt that the accused did not comply with the rules.

examples.sentence: La injusticia fue denunciada a toda luz por los medios de comunicación.
examples.translation: The injustice was openly denounced without ambiguity by the media.

definitions: Bathed in or revealed by abundant light.

examples.sentence: El salón estaba a toda luz durante el día gracias a las grandes ventanas.
examples.translation: The hall was bathed in abundant light during the day thanks to the large windows.

examples.sentence: Las flores crecían a toda luz en el invernadero, favorecidas por la iluminación natural.
examples.translation: The flowers grew in full light in the greenhouse, favored by natural illumination.

examples.sentence: El artista pintó el retrato a toda luz para captar mejor los colores y sombras.
examples.translation: The artist painted the portrait in full brightness to better capture colors and shadows.

examples.sentence: La biblioteca está diseñada para estar a toda luz y crear un ambiente acogedor.
examples.translation: The library is designed to be bathed in abundant light and create a cozy environment.

definitions: At full speed; at maximum velocity; full throttle.

examples.sentence: El tren avanzaba a toda máquina para llegar a tiempo a la estación central.
examples.translation: The train advanced at full speed to arrive on time at the central station.

examples.sentence: Los motores funcionaban a toda máquina durante la carrera para mantener la velocidad máxima.
examples.translation: The engines were running at full throttle during the race to maintain maximum speed.

examples.sentence: Cuando comenzó la evacuación, todos se movieron a toda máquina para salir rápido.
examples.translation: When the evacuation began, everyone moved at full speed to leave quickly.

definitions: Operating at full capacity or power; with maximum effort.

examples.sentence: El equipo de ventas trabaja a toda máquina para alcanzar las metas trimestrales.
examples.translation: The sales team works at full capacity to reach quarterly goals.

examples.sentence: Durante la temporada alta, la fábrica opera a toda máquina para cumplir con los pedidos.
examples.translation: During the high season, the factory operates at full power to fulfill orders.

examples.sentence: Los estudiantes estudiaban a toda máquina antes de los exámenes finales.
examples.translation: The students were studying with maximum effort before the final exams.

definitions: Moving or proceeding as fast as possible.

examples.sentence: Llegaron a toda máquina para preparar todo antes de que empezara la conferencia.
examples.translation: They arrived as fast as possible to prepare everything before the conference started.

examples.sentence: El equipo avanzaba a toda máquina para terminar el proyecto antes de la fecha límite.
examples.translation: The team proceeded as fast as possible to finish the project before the deadline.

examples.sentence: Si queremos ganar, tenemos que jugar a toda máquina desde el primer minuto.
examples.translation: If we want to win, we have to play as fast as possible from the first minute.

definitions: Running all systems or resources at peak performance.

examples.sentence: El sistema estaba a toda máquina para procesar la gran cantidad de datos recibidos.
examples.translation: The system was running all systems at peak performance to process the large amount of data received.

examples.sentence: Durante la campaña, la empresa puso todos sus recursos a toda máquina para aumentar ventas.
examples.translation: During the campaign, the company put all its resources running at peak performance to increase sales.

examples.sentence: Los motores funcionaban a toda máquina durante el viaje para garantizar la seguridad.
examples.translation: The engines ran at full capacity during the trip to guarantee safety.

definitions: At top speed; very fast; full throttle.

examples.sentence: El corredor salió a toda mecha y nadie pudo alcanzarlo en la carrera.
examples.translation: The runner took off at top speed and no one could catch him in the race.

examples.sentence: El auto avanzaba a toda mecha por la autopista mientras caía la noche.
examples.translation: The car moved very fast on the highway as night fell.

examples.sentence: A toda mecha, los bomberos llegaron al lugar del incendio para apagar las llamas.
examples.translation: At full throttle, the firefighters arrived at the fire to extinguish the flames.

definitions: To go or act with great speed and urgency.

examples.sentence: Tenemos que terminar este trabajo a toda mecha si queremos entregarlo mañana.
examples.translation: We have to finish this work very quickly if we want to deliver it tomorrow.

examples.sentence: Ella respondió a toda mecha para no perder la oportunidad de la entrevista.
examples.translation: She responded urgently so as not to miss the opportunity for the interview.

examples.sentence: Los empleados se movían a toda mecha para preparar la tienda antes de la apertura.
examples.translation: The employees moved with great speed to prepare the store before opening.

definitions: With great intensity or energy; rapidly and vigorously.

examples.sentence: El equipo trabajó a toda mecha para completar el proyecto antes del plazo final.
examples.translation: The team worked vigorously to complete the project before the final deadline.

examples.sentence: A toda mecha, los músicos ensayaban para el concierto de la noche siguiente.
examples.translation: With great intensity, the musicians rehearsed for the concert the following night.

examples.sentence: Los niños corrían a toda mecha por el parque mientras jugaban sin parar.
examples.translation: The children ran vigorously through the park while playing nonstop.

definitions: Carried out in an accelerated, all-out manner.

examples.sentence: La obra se desarrolló a toda mecha, sin pausas, para cumplir con el estricto calendario.
examples.translation: The work was carried out in an accelerated, all-out manner without breaks to meet the strict schedule.

examples.sentence: Durante la campaña publicitaria, la agencia trabajó a toda mecha para maximizar el alcance.
examples.translation: During the advertising campaign, the agency worked at full speed to maximize the reach.

examples.sentence: El equipo de rescate actuó a toda mecha para salvar a las personas atrapadas en el edificio.
examples.translation: The rescue team acted vigorously to save the people trapped in the building.

definitions: At very high speed; moving or proceeding full throttle.

examples.sentence: Juan conducía a toda pastilla para llegar a tiempo a la reunión importante.
examples.translation: Juan was driving at full speed to arrive on time to the important meeting.

examples.sentence: ¿Por qué siempre vas a toda pastilla cuando manejas por la ciudad? Es peligroso.
examples.translation: Why do you always drive at full throttle when you're in the city? It's dangerous.

examples.sentence: Los motociclistas pasaron a toda pastilla por la carretera, sorprendiendo a todos los que los vieron.
examples.translation: The motorcyclists sped along the road at full throttle, surprising everyone who saw them.

definitions: With maximum intensity or force; at full blast (e.g., volume, effort, or activity).

examples.sentence: Durante el concierto, la banda tocó a toda pastilla para animar al público.
examples.translation: During the concert, the band played at full blast to energize the audience.

examples.sentence: Marta trabaja a toda pastilla cuando se acerca la fecha de entrega del proyecto.
examples.translation: Marta works at full intensity when the project deadline approaches.

examples.sentence: Los niños jugaban a toda pastilla en el parque, sin importarles el cansancio.
examples.translation: The kids were playing at full blast in the park, not caring about being tired.

definitions: Doing something extremely quickly.

examples.sentence: Terminé el informe a toda pastilla para enviarlo antes de la medianoche.
examples.translation: I finished the report extremely quickly to send it before midnight.

examples.sentence: ¿Puedes hacer las copias a toda pastilla? Tenemos prisa.
examples.translation: Can you make the copies really fast? We're in a hurry.

examples.sentence: Ellos limpiaron la casa a toda pastilla antes de que llegaran los invitados.
examples.translation: They cleaned the house very quickly before the guests arrived.

definitions: In great haste; hurriedly; very quickly because of urgency.

examples.sentence: Llegué a toda prisa al hospital cuando supe que había tenido un accidente.
examples.translation: I hurried to the hospital when I found out he had an accident.

examples.sentence: ¿Por qué sales siempre a toda prisa? Parece que nunca tienes tiempo para nada.
examples.translation: Why do you always leave in such a hurry? It seems you never have time for anything.

examples.sentence: Los bomberos llegaron a toda prisa cuando se reportó el incendio en el edificio.
examples.translation: The firefighters arrived hurriedly when the building fire was reported.

definitions: With all sails set; sailing at full sail.

examples.sentence: El velero navegaba a toda vela bajo el sol de la tarde, disfrutando del buen viento.
examples.translation: The sailboat was sailing with all sails set under the afternoon sun, enjoying the good wind.

examples.sentence: Durante la regata, los barcos iban a toda vela para ganar la carrera.
examples.translation: During the regatta, the boats sailed at full sail to win the race.

examples.sentence: Ayer el capitán ordenó izar las banderas y salir a toda vela hacia el puerto.
examples.translation: Yesterday the captain ordered to hoist the flags and sail at full sail toward the port.

examples.sentence: Los pescadores partieron a toda vela con la esperanza de una buena pesca.
examples.translation: The fishermen left with all sails set hoping for a good catch.

definitions: Proceeding at full speed or with great momentum; operating at full capacity.

examples.sentence: La empresa está trabajando a toda vela para cumplir con los plazos de producción.
examples.translation: The company is operating at full capacity to meet production deadlines.

examples.sentence: Después de la crisis, el equipo volvió a funcionar a toda vela para recuperar el tiempo perdido.
examples.translation: After the crisis, the team went back to working at full speed to recover lost time.

examples.sentence: Con la nueva maquinaria, la fábrica está a toda vela y aumenta su producción diaria.
examples.translation: With the new machinery, the factory is operating at full steam and increasing its daily output.

definitions: Continuously; all the time; constantly.

examples.sentence: Mi hermana estudia a todas horas para aprobar sus exámenes finales.
examples.translation: My sister studies all the time to pass her final exams.

examples.sentence: Los vecinos se quejaron porque la música estaba sonando a todas horas durante el fin de semana.
examples.translation: The neighbors complained because the music was playing constantly during the weekend.

examples.sentence: A todas horas, el hospital recibe pacientes y atiende emergencias sin descanso.
examples.translation: The hospital receives patients and attends emergencies nonstop.

definitions: At any hour of the day or night; at all hours.

examples.sentence: El supermercado está abierto a todas horas para mayor comodidad de los clientes.
examples.translation: The supermarket is open at all hours for the customers' convenience.

examples.sentence: Puedes llamar a la línea de ayuda a todas horas, siempre hay alguien atendiendo.
examples.translation: You can call the helpline at any hour; there is always someone answering.

examples.sentence: En esta ciudad, las farmacias funcionan a todas horas, incluso durante la noche.
examples.translation: In this city, pharmacies operate at all hours, even during the night.

definitions: Clearly; plainly; manifestly; beyond reasonable doubt.

examples.sentence: A todas luces, ella es la mejor candidata para el puesto gracias a su experiencia.
examples.translation: Clearly, she is the best candidate for the position because of her experience.

examples.sentence: El informe demuestra a todas luces que la compañía ha cumplido con las normativas.
examples.translation: The report plainly shows that the company has complied with the regulations.

examples.sentence: A todas luces, la decisión de cerrar la planta fue la correcta para evitar pérdidas mayores.
examples.translation: Beyond doubt, the decision to close the plant was right to avoid greater losses.

definitions: By all appearances; judging by the available evidence.

examples.sentence: A todas luces, el clima está cambiando según los datos recogidos en los últimos años.
examples.translation: By all appearances, the climate is changing according to the data collected in recent years.

examples.sentence: Judging by her attitude, a todas luces ella no está de acuerdo con las nuevas reglas.
examples.translation: A juzgar por su actitud, a todas luces ella no está de acuerdo con las nuevas reglas.

examples.sentence: A todas luces, el proyecto tendrá éxito si siguen trabajando con este nivel de dedicación.
examples.translation: By all appearances, the project will succeed if they continue working with this level of dedication.

definitions: Produced, printed, photographed, or broadcast in full color as opposed to black and white.

examples.sentence: La revista publicó las fotografías a todo color para mostrar mejor los paisajes naturales.
examples.translation: The magazine published the photographs in full color to better show the natural landscapes.

examples.sentence: Imprimieron el cartel a todo color para atraer más atención en la calle principal.
examples.translation: They printed the poster in full color to attract more attention on the main street.

examples.sentence: El documental fue transmitido a todo color, lo que hizo que las imágenes fueran más impactantes.
examples.translation: The documentary was broadcast in full color, making the images more striking.

examples.sentence: Las ilustraciones del libro infantil están a todo color para captar el interés de los niños.
examples.translation: The illustrations in the children's book are in full color to capture the kids' interest.

definitions: Displayed using the full range of natural or artificial colors to reproduce a realistic appearance.

examples.sentence: El televisor nuevo muestra los programas a todo color, con una calidad impresionante.
examples.translation: The new TV displays programs in full color, with impressive quality.

examples.sentence: El cuadro en la galería se ve a todo color gracias a la luz natural del salón.
examples.translation: The painting in the gallery looks in full color thanks to the natural light in the room.

examples.sentence: En la exposición, los modelos estaban iluminados a todo color para resaltar sus detalles.
examples.translation: At the exhibition, the models were lit in full color to highlight their details.

examples.sentence: La pantalla del ordenador muestra las imágenes a todo color para una experiencia más realista.
examples.translation: The computer screen shows images in full color for a more realistic experience.

definitions: Presented vividly or graphically, emphasizing striking visual detail.

examples.sentence: El periodista describió el accidente a todo color para que todos entendieran la gravedad del suceso.
examples.translation: The journalist described the accident vividly so that everyone understood the severity of the event.

examples.sentence: En su novela, María pinta a todo color las emociones de sus personajes, haciendo la historia muy intensa.
examples.translation: In her novel, María vividly portrays the emotions of her characters, making the story very intense.

examples.sentence: El reportaje estuvo a todo color, mostrando cada detalle del festival cultural en la ciudad.
examples.translation: The report was presented vividly, showing every detail of the cultural festival in the city.

definitions: Used emphatically to indicate that something is done with maximum visual impact or completeness.

examples.sentence: El testigo relató a todo color lo que vio aquella noche, sin dejar ningún detalle fuera.
examples.translation: The witness described in full detail what he saw that night, leaving no detail out.

examples.sentence: El abogado expuso a todo color los argumentos que demostraban la inocencia de su cliente.
examples.translation: The lawyer emphatically presented the arguments that proved his client's innocence.

examples.sentence: En la presentación, mostraron a todo color las ventajas del nuevo producto para convencer a los inversores.
examples.translation: In the presentation, they emphatically showed the advantages of the new product to convince the investors.

definitions: Described or shown in a way that makes visual elements especially vivid or dramatic.

examples.sentence: El documental mostró a todo color la vida salvaje en la selva amazónica, dejando a todos fascinados.
examples.translation: The documentary showed the wildlife in the Amazon jungle vividly, leaving everyone fascinated.

examples.sentence: Ella describió a todo color su viaje por Europa, haciendo que todos quisieran visitarla también.
examples.translation: She described her trip through Europe vividly, making everyone want to visit as well.

examples.sentence: La novela grafica está a todo color, con ilustraciones que resaltan cada escena dramática.
examples.translation: The graphic novel is vividly illustrated, with drawings that highlight every dramatic scene.

definitions: At the top of one's voice; very loudly.

examples.sentence: En el karaoke, Ana cantó a todo gañote y todos en el bar se unieron a ella.
examples.translation: At karaoke, Ana sang at the top of her voice and everyone in the bar joined her.

examples.sentence: ¿Por qué gritas a todo gañote? No es necesario que te escuches tan fuerte.
examples.translation: Why are you shouting at the top of your lungs? There's no need to be so loud.

examples.sentence: Los hinchas cantaban a todo gañote en las gradas para apoyar a su equipo favorito.
examples.translation: The fans sang at full volume in the stands to support their favorite team.

definitions: Shouting, singing, or making noise with maximum vocal volume.

examples.sentence: Durante la fiesta, la banda tocó a todo gañote y nadie dejó de bailar.
examples.translation: During the party, the band played at maximum volume and nobody stopped dancing.

examples.sentence: El cantante estaba a todo gañote, entregando toda su energía en el escenario.
examples.translation: The singer was performing at full vocal power, giving all his energy on stage.

examples.sentence: En el festival, los niños gritaban a todo gañote mientras corrían por el parque.
examples.translation: At the festival, the children shouted at the top of their voices while running through the park.

definitions: At full speed; with great rapidity; moving or acting very quickly.

examples.sentence: El corredor avanzó a todo gas para ganar la carrera en los últimos metros.
examples.translation: The runner went full speed to win the race in the last meters.

examples.sentence: ¿Puedes trabajar a todo gas para terminar el proyecto hoy mismo?
examples.translation: Can you work at full speed to finish the project today?

examples.sentence: La ambulancia salió a todo gas para llegar rápido al hospital con el paciente.
examples.translation: The ambulance left at full speed to get quickly to the hospital with the patient.

definitions: Functioning at full capacity or working at maximum intensity.

examples.sentence: La fábrica está funcionando a todo gas para cumplir con la demanda de este mes.
examples.translation: The factory is operating at full capacity to meet this month's demand.

examples.sentence: El equipo de soporte técnico trabaja a todo gas para resolver los problemas de los usuarios.
examples.translation: The technical support team is working at full intensity to solve users' issues.

examples.sentence: Con la llegada del nuevo jefe, la empresa empezó a funcionar a todo gas y mejoró sus resultados.
examples.translation: With the arrival of the new boss, the company started working at full speed and improved its results.

definitions: Operating with maximum power or throttle (literal sense for vehicles or machinery).

examples.sentence: El motor del automóvil está a todo gas, alcanzando su máxima potencia sin problemas.
examples.translation: The car's engine is at full throttle, reaching maximum power without problems.

examples.sentence: Durante la prueba, la motocicleta fue llevada a todo gas para evaluar su rendimiento.
examples.translation: During the test, the motorcycle was run at full throttle to evaluate its performance.

examples.sentence: El avión aceleró a todo gas antes de despegar de la pista en una maniobra perfecta.
examples.translation: The plane accelerated at full throttle before taking off from the runway in a perfect maneuver.

examples.sentence: La máquina de corte funciona a todo gas para mantener la producción sin interrupciones.
examples.translation: The cutting machine operates at full power to keep production uninterrupted.

definitions: Completely; utterly; to the utmost degree.

examples.sentence: Estaba a todo mecate convencido de que este era el mejor camino para el éxito.
examples.translation: He was completely convinced that this was the best path to success.

examples.sentence: María se entregó a todo mecate a su trabajo para conseguir la promoción que tanto quería.
examples.translation: María gave her all to her work to get the promotion she wanted so much.

examples.sentence: El equipo luchó a todo mecate para ganar el campeonato después de años de esfuerzo.
examples.translation: The team fought wholeheartedly to win the championship after years of effort.

definitions: With great haste or force; very quickly and vigorously.

examples.sentence: Los obreros trabajaban a todo mecate para terminar la obra antes del invierno.
examples.translation: The workers were working very quickly and vigorously to finish the construction before winter.

examples.sentence: Si seguimos a todo mecate, seguro que terminamos el proyecto en tiempo récord.
examples.translation: If we keep going very fast and forcefully, we'll surely finish the project in record time.

examples.sentence: Los atletas entrenaron a todo mecate para prepararse para la competencia internacional.
examples.translation: The athletes trained with great intensity and speed to prepare for the international competition.

definitions: All-out or wholehearted, done with full intensity or commitment.

examples.sentence: Cuando le gusta algo, lo hace a todo mecate, sin escatimar esfuerzo ni tiempo.
examples.translation: When he likes something, he does it wholeheartedly, sparing no effort or time.

examples.sentence: Ella cantó a todo mecate en el concurso y ganó el primer lugar gracias a su pasión.
examples.translation: She sang with full intensity in the contest and won first place thanks to her passion.

examples.sentence: El pintor creó su obra a todo mecate, entregando toda su energía en cada pincelada.
examples.translation: The painter created his work wholeheartedly, putting all his energy into every brushstroke.

definitions: At full speed; with great force or intensity; doing something very quickly or energetically.

examples.sentence: El ciclista bajó la colina a todo meter para ganar la etapa de la carrera.
examples.translation: The cyclist went down the hill at full speed to win the stage of the race.

examples.sentence: ¿Puedes terminar el informe a todo meter? El jefe lo quiere para esta tarde.
examples.translation: Can you finish the report really fast? The boss wants it by this afternoon.

examples.sentence: Los estudiantes trabajaban a todo meter para preparar la presentación final.
examples.translation: The students were working at full speed to prepare the final presentation.

definitions: Continuously or without pause; nonstop.

examples.sentence: Desde que empezó el proyecto, el equipo ha estado trabajando a todo meter sin descansar.
examples.translation: Since the project started, the team has been working nonstop without resting.

examples.sentence: El programa de televisión se transmitió a todo meter durante toda la noche especial.
examples.translation: The TV program was broadcast nonstop throughout the entire special night.

examples.sentence: A todo meter, la fábrica produce miles de unidades cada día para satisfacer la demanda.
examples.translation: Nonstop, the factory produces thousands of units each day to meet demand.

definitions: To an excessive degree; done excessively or without restraint (applied to actions such as drinking, working, or performing).

examples.sentence: Después de la fiesta, él siguió bebiendo a todo meter, sin importarle nada más.
examples.translation: After the party, he kept drinking excessively, not caring about anything else.

examples.sentence: Trabajó a todo meter durante semanas y terminó agotado por el esfuerzo excesivo.
examples.translation: He worked excessively for weeks and ended up exhausted from the overwork.

examples.sentence: Si comes a todo meter, podrías tener problemas de salud a largo plazo.
examples.translation: If you eat excessively, you might have health problems in the long run.

definitions: According to plan; proceeding as arranged.

examples.sentence: El evento se desarrolló a todo plan, sin contratiempos ni retrasos inesperados.
examples.translation: The event proceeded according to plan, without setbacks or unexpected delays.

examples.sentence: Gracias a la buena organización, el proyecto avanza a todo plan y sin problemas.
examples.translation: Thanks to good organization, the project is moving forward as planned and without problems.

examples.sentence: ¿Crees que la reunión seguirá a todo plan o surgirán inconvenientes?
examples.translation: Do you think the meeting will go according to plan or will problems arise?

definitions: Smoothly and without problems; in good order.

examples.sentence: La obra en construcción marcha a todo plan, lo que nos da confianza para la entrega a tiempo.
examples.translation: The construction work is going smoothly, which gives us confidence for on-time delivery.

examples.sentence: El proyecto de software está a todo plan, sin errores ni fallos que hayan detenido el desarrollo.
examples.translation: The software project is running smoothly, without errors or failures that have stopped development.

examples.sentence: Después de resolver los inconvenientes iniciales, todo sigue a todo plan en la empresa.
examples.translation: After solving the initial issues, everything is running smoothly in the company.

definitions: At most; at the highest estimate; generously speaking.

examples.sentence: Calculando los gastos, el presupuesto, a todo tirar, no superará los cinco mil euros.
examples.translation: Calculating the expenses, the budget, at most, will not exceed five thousand euros.

examples.sentence: Si vas a comprar ese coche, a todo tirar, te costará unos diez mil dólares.
examples.translation: If you are going to buy that car, at the highest estimate, it will cost you about ten thousand dollars.

examples.sentence: No te preocupes, a todo tirar, la reunión durará una hora, no más.
examples.translation: Don't worry, at most, the meeting will last an hour, no more.

definitions: Barely acceptable; only just (when evaluating quality or performance).

examples.sentence: El trabajo que entregaste es a todo tirar; apenas cumple con los requisitos mínimos.
examples.translation: The work you submitted is barely acceptable; it just meets the minimum requirements.

examples.sentence: No puedo recomendar ese restaurante, la comida es a todo tirar y el servicio lento.
examples.translation: I cannot recommend that restaurant, the food is only just acceptable and the service is slow.

examples.sentence: Tu presentación estuvo a todo tirar, deberías esforzarte más la próxima vez.
examples.translation: Your presentation was barely acceptable; you should put in more effort next time.

definitions: By all means; at any cost; under any circumstances (denoting determination or inevitability).

examples.sentence: Vamos a terminar este proyecto a todo trance, sin importar las dificultades que encontremos.
examples.translation: We will finish this project by all means, no matter the difficulties we encounter.

examples.sentence: Paco insistió en que debíamos salir a todo trance para alcanzar el tren.
examples.translation: Paco insisted that we must leave at any cost to catch the train.

examples.sentence: Aunque llueva, María irá a todo trance a la manifestación para apoyar la causa.
examples.translation: Even if it rains, María will go by all means to the demonstration to support the cause.

definitions: Urgently; immediately; without delay.

examples.sentence: Necesito que me envíes esos documentos a todo trance, la reunión es en una hora.
examples.translation: I need you to send me those documents urgently; the meeting is in an hour.

examples.sentence: Por favor, atiende esa llamada a todo trance, puede ser una emergencia.
examples.translation: Please answer that call immediately; it could be an emergency.

examples.sentence: El doctor pidió que trasladaran al paciente a todo trance a la sala de urgencias.
examples.translation: The doctor requested that the patient be moved urgently to the emergency room.

definitions: At full speed; full throttle.

examples.sentence: El piloto aceleró a todo trapo y en pocos segundos alcanzaron la velocidad máxima.
examples.translation: The pilot accelerated at full speed and in a few seconds reached maximum velocity.

examples.sentence: Durante la carrera, el ciclista fue a todo trapo para mantener la primera posición.
examples.translation: During the race, the cyclist went full throttle to maintain first position.

examples.sentence: No puedo ir más rápido, ya voy a todo trapo y el motor está a punto de sobrecalentarse.
examples.translation: I can't go faster, I'm already at full speed and the engine is about to overheat.

definitions: Very loudly; at maximum volume (especially of music).

examples.sentence: La música sonaba a todo trapo en la fiesta, nadie podía oír bien sus propios pensamientos.
examples.translation: The music was playing at maximum volume at the party; nobody could hear their own thoughts.

examples.sentence: Sube la radio a todo trapo que quiero animarme un poco en este viaje largo.
examples.translation: Turn the radio up loud; I want to cheer myself up a bit on this long trip.

examples.sentence: En el concierto, la banda tocó a todo trapo y la gente no paraba de bailar.
examples.translation: At the concert, the band played very loudly and people didn't stop dancing.

definitions: With great intensity; all-out.

examples.sentence: Decidieron pelear a todo trapo por el campeonato sin importar las consecuencias.
examples.translation: They decided to fight with great intensity for the championship regardless of the consequences.

examples.sentence: Para ganar el contrato, el equipo trabajó a todo trapo toda la semana pasada.
examples.translation: To win the contract, the team worked all-out the entire last week.

examples.sentence: El grupo de voluntarios se lanzó a todo trapo a ayudar a las víctimas del desastre natural.
examples.translation: The group of volunteers threw themselves with great intensity to help the victims of the natural disaster.

definitions: For all intents and purposes; in every respect.

examples.sentence: A todos los efectos, el cambio de política afectó a la empresa como si fuera una reestructuración total.
examples.translation: For all intents and purposes, the policy change affected the company as if it were a total restructuring.

examples.sentence: Aunque no firmó el contrato, a todos los efectos, está comprometido con el proyecto.
examples.translation: Although he didn't sign the contract, for all intents and purposes, he is committed to the project.

examples.sentence: El edificio está cerrado por reformas, pero a todos los efectos, sigue siendo propiedad del ayuntamiento.
examples.translation: The building is closed for renovations, but for all intents and purposes, it is still owned by the city council.

definitions: Effectively; for practical or legal purposes.

examples.sentence: El documento es válido a todos los efectos legales y puede utilizarse en el juicio.
examples.translation: The document is legally valid for all practical purposes and can be used in court.

examples.sentence: Aunque no tenga título universitario, a todos los efectos es un experto en su campo.
examples.translation: Although he doesn't have a university degree, effectively he is an expert in his field.

examples.sentence: La empresa fue disuelta, y a todos los efectos, dejó de existir a partir del mes pasado.
examples.translation: The company was dissolved and effectively ceased to exist as of last month.

definitions: An angry imperative telling someone to go away; equivalent to 'go to hell', 'fuck off', or 'get lost'.

examples.sentence: Cuando Pedro empezó a molestar, Marta le gritó: '¡A tomar por culo, no quiero verte más!'
examples.translation: When Pedro started bothering her, Marta shouted: 'Go to hell, I don't want to see you anymore!'

examples.sentence: Si no vas a ayudar, mejor a tomar por culo y déjanos en paz.
examples.translation: If you're not going to help, then fuck off and leave us alone.

examples.sentence: ¡A tomar por culo con tus excusas! Ya no te creo nada.
examples.translation: Fuck off with your excuses! I don't believe you anymore.

definitions: A phrase used to send a person away contemptuously or to dismiss them rudely.

examples.sentence: Cuando le propusieron la idea, la rechazó diciendo simplemente: 'A tomar por culo'.
examples.translation: When they proposed the idea, he dismissed it simply by saying: 'Get lost.'

examples.sentence: No pierdas tiempo con ese idiota, mándalo a tomar por culo y sigue con tu trabajo.
examples.translation: Don't waste time with that idiot, tell him to fuck off and keep working.

examples.sentence: Cada vez que intento hablar con él, me manda a tomar por culo sin dar explicaciones.
examples.translation: Every time I try to talk to him, he tells me to fuck off without explanations.

definitions: Describing an event, plan, or situation that has failed, broken down, or gone badly; equivalent to 'gone to hell' or 'gone to shit'.

examples.sentence: El plan para las vacaciones se fue a tomar por culo cuando cancelaron el vuelo.
examples.translation: The vacation plan went to hell when the flight was canceled.

examples.sentence: Todo salió a tomar por culo después de que se rompiera la computadora en medio de la presentación.
examples.translation: Everything went to shit after the computer broke down in the middle of the presentation.

examples.sentence: La relación entre ellos se fue a tomar por culo tras la discusión tan fuerte que tuvieron.
examples.translation: Their relationship went to hell after the big argument they had.

definitions: Indicating that something has been ruined or rendered useless.

examples.sentence: El teléfono cayó al agua y ahora está a tomar por culo, no enciende para nada.
examples.translation: The phone fell into the water and now it's ruined; it doesn't turn on at all.

examples.sentence: Después de la tormenta, el jardín quedó a tomar por culo y tuvimos que replantar todo.
examples.translation: After the storm, the garden was destroyed and we had to replant everything.

examples.sentence: El motor del coche se averió y quedó a tomar por culo, no vale la pena arreglarlo.
examples.translation: The car engine broke down and is ruined; it's not worth fixing.

definitions: An emphatic, coarse imperative used to tell someone to go away or to express contempt; equivalent to 'go to hell', 'go fuck yourself', or 'fuck off'.

examples.sentence: Cuando el vecino empezó a quejarse, le respondí: 'A tomar por el culo, no es asunto tuyo.'
examples.translation: When the neighbor started complaining, I replied: 'Go fuck yourself, it's none of your business.'

examples.sentence: Si no quieres ayudar, mejor a tomar por el culo y no molestes más.
examples.translation: If you don't want to help, better fuck off and don't bother anymore.

examples.sentence: El jefe le dijo a Carlos a tomar por el culo después de su incompetencia repetida.
examples.translation: The boss told Carlos to fuck off after his repeated incompetence.

definitions: Used to indicate that something has been ruined, spoiled, or gone disastrously wrong; equivalent to 'gone to shit' or 'completely ruined'.

examples.sentence: La propuesta de negocio se fue a tomar por el culo cuando no consiguieron financiamiento.
examples.translation: The business proposal went to shit when they failed to get funding.

examples.sentence: Este año el proyecto se fue a tomar por el culo por la mala planificación y falta de equipo.
examples.translation: This year the project went disastrously wrong due to poor planning and lack of staff.

examples.sentence: La relación entre las dos empresas se fue a tomar por el culo tras el incumplimiento del contrato.
examples.translation: The relationship between the two companies went completely wrong after the breach of contract.

definitions: A contemptuous formula for dismissing or rejecting a person or idea.

examples.sentence: Cuando propuse la idea, me la rechazaron diciendo que era a tomar por el culo.
examples.translation: When I proposed the idea, they dismissed it contemptuously saying it was bullshit.

examples.sentence: No le hagas caso, su opinión es a tomar por el culo y no tiene fundamento alguno.
examples.translation: Don't pay attention to him, his opinion is rubbish and baseless.

examples.sentence: Cada vez que intento aportar algo, me lo hacen a tomar por el culo sin consideración.
examples.translation: Every time I try to contribute something, they dismiss it contemptuously without consideration.

definitions: In agreement, harmony, or consonance with something; appropriate or fitting in relation to context or style.

examples.sentence: Su actitud estaba a tono con el ambiente relajado de la fiesta, lo que hizo que todos se sintieran cómodos.
examples.translation: His attitude was in tune with the relaxed atmosphere of the party, which made everyone feel comfortable.

examples.sentence: El discurso del orador estuvo a tono con la temática del congreso, captando la atención del público.
examples.translation: The speaker's speech was appropriate to the theme of the conference, capturing the audience's attention.

examples.sentence: Cuando eliges la decoración, es importante que los colores estén a tono para lograr armonía visual.
examples.translation: When choosing decoration, it's important that the colors match to achieve visual harmony.

definitions: Musically in tune; at the correct pitch or in harmony with other sounds.
