examples.translation: The team reached the top of the league after winning the national championship.

examples.sentence: Juan siempre ha querido estar al tope de su campo, y finalmente lo logró con su último proyecto.
examples.translation: Juan has always wanted to be at the top of his field, and he finally achieved it with his latest project.

definitions: Operating or present at maximum level or intensity.

examples.sentence: El motor del coche estaba al tope y no podía ir más rápido sin peligro.
examples.translation: The car's engine was at full throttle and couldn't go faster without danger.

examples.sentence: Durante el partido, la adrenalina estaba al tope y los jugadores no se rendían.
examples.translation: During the match, adrenaline was at its peak and the players didn't give up.

examples.sentence: La música en la fiesta sonaba al tope y todos bailaban sin parar.
examples.translation: The music at the party was blasting at full volume and everyone danced nonstop.

definitions: Used to describe someone or something that has attained the utmost success or prominence.

examples.sentence: Con su último álbum, la cantante está al tope y es reconocida mundialmente.
examples.translation: With her latest album, the singer is at the top and is recognized worldwide.

examples.sentence: La empresa alcanzó al tope del mercado gracias a su innovación constante.
examples.translation: The company reached the pinnacle of the market thanks to its constant innovation.

examples.sentence: Carlos está al tope en su carrera política después de ganar las elecciones recientes.
examples.translation: Carlos is at the height of his political career after winning the recent elections.

definitions: To be ruined, spoiled, or come to nothing; to fail completely.

examples.sentence: Después del incendio, la fábrica quedó al traste y no se pudo recuperar.
examples.translation: After the fire, the factory was ruined and could not be recovered.

examples.sentence: El proyecto que tanto esperábamos terminó al traste por falta de financiación.
examples.translation: The project we were so hopeful for ended up ruined due to lack of funding.

examples.sentence: Si no solucionamos ese problema a tiempo, todo el plan irá al traste.
examples.translation: If we don't solve that problem on time, the whole plan will go to ruin.

examples.sentence: Las negociaciones se fueron al traste cuando ambas partes no llegaron a un acuerdo.
examples.translation: The negotiations fell apart when both parties failed to reach an agreement.

definitions: To cause something to be ruined or destroyed (plans, projects, reputation, etc.); to wreck or spoil intentionally or inadvertently.

examples.sentence: No quiero alzar el traste de tus esfuerzos, pero este error puede arruinar todo.
examples.translation: I don't want to wreck your efforts, but this mistake could ruin everything.

examples.sentence: La tormenta al trasteó la cosecha, dejándola completamente perdida.
examples.translation: The storm ruined the harvest, leaving it completely lost.

examples.sentence: Cuidado con esas críticas, no sea que al trastees la reputación del equipo.
examples.translation: Be careful with those criticisms, or you might spoil the team's reputation.

definitions: To go to the dogs; to end up worthless or useless.

examples.sentence: Sin un buen plan, todo termina al traste y nadie sabe qué hacer.
examples.translation: Without a good plan, everything goes to the dogs and no one knows what to do.

examples.sentence: Después de tantos problemas, la relación se fue al traste y decidieron separarse.
examples.translation: After so many problems, the relationship went to ruin and they decided to separate.

examples.sentence: El negocio se fue al traste tras la mala gestión de los nuevos socios.
examples.translation: The business went to the dogs after the poor management of the new partners.

definitions: At random; done without order, method, or careful thought.

examples.sentence: No puedes simplemente elegir nombres al tuntún para el equipo, necesitamos algo serio.
examples.translation: You can't just choose names at random for the team; we need something serious.

examples.sentence: María respondió al tuntún sin saber realmente cuál era la respuesta correcta.
examples.translation: María answered blindly without really knowing what the correct answer was.

examples.sentence: El decorador colocó las flores al tuntún, sin seguir ninguna armonía estética.
examples.translation: The decorator placed the flowers haphazardly, without following any aesthetic harmony.

examples.sentence: Si estudias al tuntún, no vas a aprobar el examen final.
examples.translation: If you study randomly, you won't pass the final exam.

definitions: Blindly or without aiming (used of shooting or acting without precision).

examples.sentence: El cazador disparó al tuntún sin ver claramente su objetivo.
examples.translation: The hunter shot blindly without clearly seeing his target.

examples.sentence: No puedes actuar al tuntún en este trabajo; cada paso debe ser preciso.
examples.translation: You can't act blindly in this job; every step must be precise.

examples.sentence: Dispararon al tuntún durante el disturbio, causando daños colaterales.
examples.translation: They fired indiscriminately during the riot, causing collateral damage.

definitions: Haphazardly or aimlessly, without planning or deliberation.

examples.sentence: No puede tomar decisiones al tuntún sin antes consultar al equipo.
examples.translation: He can't make decisions haphazardly without consulting the team first.

examples.sentence: El plan salió mal porque actuaron al tuntún sin pensar en las consecuencias.
examples.translation: The plan failed because they acted aimlessly without thinking about the consequences.

examples.sentence: No vayas al tuntún en esta reunión; prepárate para presentar datos concretos.
examples.translation: Don't go in blindly to this meeting; prepare to present concrete data.

definitions: Live; broadcast or performed in real time (on air or on stage).

examples.sentence: El programa se transmitió al vivo y los espectadores pudieron interactuar en tiempo real.
examples.translation: The program was broadcast live and viewers could interact in real time.

examples.sentence: Durante el concierto al vivo, el cantante improvisó una canción que emocionó a todos.
examples.translation: During the live concert, the singer improvised a song that moved everyone.

examples.sentence: ¿Viste el debate al vivo anoche? Fue muy intenso y lleno de sorpresas.
examples.translation: Did you watch the live debate last night? It was very intense and full of surprises.

definitions: To affect or wound someone deeply; to hit where it hurts (figurative: to touch 'to the quick').

examples.sentence: Sus palabras me tocaron al vivo, porque hablaban justo de mis experiencias.
examples.translation: His words hit me where it hurts because they spoke exactly about my experiences.

examples.sentence: El comentario de Ana fue al vivo y causó un fuerte debate en la reunión.
examples.translation: Ana's comment hit to the quick and caused a strong debate in the meeting.

examples.sentence: Cuando me criticaron públicamente, sentí que me herían al vivo delante de todos.
examples.translation: When they criticized me publicly, I felt they wounded me deeply in front of everyone.

definitions: Pertaining to a living person or organism; while alive (contrasted with what is dead).

examples.sentence: El médico explicó que el tejido al vivo tiene una capacidad de regeneración mayor que el muerto.
examples.translation: The doctor explained that living tissue has a greater capacity for regeneration than dead tissue.

examples.sentence: Durante la autopsia, examinaron los órganos al vivo para determinar la causa de la muerte.
examples.translation: During the autopsy, they examined the organs in a living state to determine the cause of death.

examples.sentence: El biólogo estudió al vivo el comportamiento de los insectos sin interferir en su hábitat natural.
examples.translation: The biologist studied the insects alive without interfering in their natural habitat.

examples.sentence: Las células al vivo reaccionaron rápidamente a los estímulos externos durante el experimento.
examples.translation: The living cells reacted quickly to external stimuli during the experiment.

definitions: While in flight or midair; used literally of catching or intercepting something while it is airborne.

examples.sentence: El portero atrapó el balón al vuelo justo antes de que entrara a la portería.
examples.translation: The goalkeeper caught the ball midair just before it entered the goal.

examples.sentence: Vi cómo el pájaro tomó la mosca al vuelo con una precisión impresionante.
examples.translation: I saw how the bird caught the fly midair with impressive precision.

examples.sentence: Para evitar que se caiga, tienes que coger las llaves al vuelo cuando te las tiro.
examples.translation: To prevent them from falling, you have to catch the keys on the fly when I throw them to you.

examples.sentence: El jugador interceptó el pase al vuelo y lanzó un contraataque inmediato.
examples.translation: The player intercepted the pass midair and launched an immediate counterattack.

definitions: Immediately; at once; done on the spot or on the fly without delay.

examples.sentence: No tuve tiempo para preparar un discurso, así que hablé al vuelo durante la reunión.
examples.translation: I didn't have time to prepare a speech, so I spoke on the fly during the meeting.

examples.sentence: Cuando me preguntaron sobre el proyecto, respondí al vuelo sin dudarlo.
examples.translation: When they asked me about the project, I answered immediately without hesitation.

examples.sentence: El chef improvisó al vuelo una receta deliciosa con lo que encontró en la cocina.
examples.translation: The chef improvised a delicious recipe on the spot with what he found in the kitchen.

definitions: Alert and watchful; paying close attention; on the lookout.

examples.sentence: Durante la vigilancia, el guardia estuvo aliquindoi para detectar cualquier movimiento sospechoso.
examples.translation: During the watch, the guard was alert and watchful to detect any suspicious movement.

examples.sentence: Los soldados permanecieron aliquindoi toda la noche para evitar emboscadas.
examples.translation: The soldiers remained vigilant all night to avoid ambushes.

examples.sentence: El conductor estaba aliquindoi en la carretera para evitar accidentes inesperados.
examples.translation: The driver was alert on the road to avoid unexpected accidents.

examples.sentence: En el aeropuerto, el personal está siempre aliquindoi para la seguridad de los pasajeros.
examples.translation: At the airport, the staff is always watchful for passenger safety.

definitions: Vigilant or attentive in order to avoid being surprised or cheated.

examples.sentence: Es importante estar aliquindoi para no ser engañado por estafadores en línea.
examples.translation: It's important to be vigilant to avoid being cheated by online scammers.

examples.sentence: Los compradores deben mantenerse aliquindoi para detectar productos falsificados.
examples.translation: Buyers must stay alert to spot counterfeit products.

examples.sentence: El cajero estaba aliquindoi para evitar que alguien intentara robar dinero en efectivo.
examples.translation: The cashier was attentive to prevent anyone from trying to steal cash.

definitions: the late hours of the night; very late at night

examples.sentence: Nos quedamos hablando hasta las altas horas de la noche, disfrutando la compañía.
examples.translation: We stayed talking until the late hours of the night, enjoying the company.

examples.sentence: La fiesta continuó hasta las altas horas y nadie quería irse a casa.
examples.translation: The party went on until the late hours and no one wanted to go home.

examples.sentence: Trabajé en el informe hasta las altas horas para entregarlo a tiempo.
examples.translation: I worked on the report until the late hours to submit it on time.

examples.sentence: Los estudiantes estudiaban para el examen hasta las altas horas en la biblioteca.
examples.translation: The students studied for the exam until the late hours in the library.

definitions: the small hours (the time after midnight when it is late and quiet)

examples.sentence: Salimos de la cena a las altas horas cuando la ciudad ya estaba tranquila y silenciosa.
examples.translation: We left dinner in the small hours when the city was already quiet and peaceful.

examples.sentence: A las altas horas, solo se escuchaba el sonido de los grillos en el campo.
examples.translation: In the small hours, only the sound of crickets was heard in the countryside.

examples.sentence: Cuando el reloj marcó las altas horas, decidimos regresar a casa después de la fiesta.
examples.translation: When the clock struck the small hours, we decided to go home after the party.

definitions: to raise an accusing finger; to point at someone as guilty or to blame

examples.sentence: En la reunión, Juan no dudó en alzar el dedo para señalar al responsable del error.
examples.translation: In the meeting, Juan did not hesitate to raise an accusing finger to point out who was responsible for the mistake.

examples.sentence: María alzó el dedo y culpó a Pedro de romper el jarrón sin querer.
examples.translation: María raised her finger and blamed Pedro for breaking the vase unintentionally.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que me alcen el dedo cuando no he hecho nada malo.
examples.translation: I don't like being pointed at as guilty when I haven't done anything wrong.

definitions: to raise a finger or hand to signal, call attention, or indicate a desire to speak

examples.sentence: Para pedir la palabra en clase, tienes que alzar el dedo y esperar a que te den la palabra.
examples.translation: To ask to speak in class, you have to raise your finger and wait to be called on.

examples.sentence: Ella alzó el dedo para hacer una pregunta durante la conferencia.
examples.translation: She raised her finger to ask a question during the lecture.

examples.sentence: Cuando el profesor preguntó, varios estudiantes alzaron el dedo para responder.
examples.translation: When the teacher asked, several students raised their fingers to answer.

examples.sentence: No olvides alzar el dedo si quieres intervenir en la reunión, para que te escuchen.
examples.translation: Don't forget to raise your hand if you want to intervene in the meeting so they hear you.

definitions: to single someone out with a gesture of accusation

examples.sentence: Durante la discusión, Pedro alzó el dedo señalando a Luis como el culpable del retraso.
examples.translation: During the argument, Pedro singled out Luis with a gesture of accusation as responsible for the delay.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que me alces el dedo en público, prefiero hablar las cosas en privado.
examples.translation: I don't like being singled out with an accusing finger in public; I prefer to talk things in private.

examples.sentence: El jefe alzó el dedo contra el empleado que no cumplió con sus responsabilidades.
examples.translation: The boss singled out the employee who did not fulfill his responsibilities.

definitions: a twisted, mangled mass of metal; wreckage composed of crushed or entangled metal parts

examples.sentence: El accidente dejó un amasijo de hierros que bloqueaba la carretera durante horas.
examples.translation: The accident left a twisted mass of metal that blocked the road for hours.

examples.sentence: Los bomberos tuvieron que usar herramientas especiales para despejar el amasijo de hierros de la colisión.
examples.translation: The firefighters had to use special tools to clear the mangled wreckage from the collision.

examples.sentence: El carro quedó convertido en un amasijo de hierros después del choque frontal.
examples.translation: The car was turned into a twisted wreck of metal after the head-on crash.

examples.sentence: Tras el tornado, el barrio parecía un amasijo de hierros y escombros por todas partes.
examples.translation: After the tornado, the neighborhood looked like a mangled mass of metal and debris everywhere.

definitions: a chaotic jumble or tangle of metal objects; a confused, disordered cluster of metallic things

examples.sentence: El taller estaba lleno de un amasijo de hierros que nadie sabía cómo ordenar.
examples.translation: The workshop was full of a chaotic jumble of metal pieces that no one knew how to organize.

examples.sentence: Cuando entré al depósito, encontré un amasijo de hierros mezclados con viejas máquinas oxidadas.
examples.translation: When I entered the warehouse, I found a tangled heap of metal mixed with old rusty machines.

examples.sentence: Los desechos de la fábrica forman un amasijo de hierros que parece imposible de separar.
examples.translation: The factory waste forms a chaotic jumble of metals that seems impossible to separate.

definitions: the smashed remains of a vehicle or machinery after a collision or accident

examples.sentence: Después del choque, el coche quedó convertido en un amasijo de hierros irreconocible.
examples.translation: After the crash, the car was turned into an unrecognizable smashed heap of metal.

examples.sentence: La policía encontró el amasijo de hierros en la cuneta y empezó la investigación del accidente.
examples.translation: The police found the wrecked remains of the vehicle by the roadside and started the accident investigation.

examples.sentence: Nadie salió ileso del amasijo de hierros que resultó del impacto frontal entre los dos camiones.
examples.translation: No one came out unscathed from the smashed remains of the vehicles after the head-on collision between the two trucks.

definitions: in addition to; besides; apart from

examples.sentence: Amén de los gastos de viaje, tuvimos que pagar una multa inesperada en la aduana.
examples.translation: Besides the travel expenses, we had to pay an unexpected fine at customs.

examples.sentence: Ella trajo una tarta, amén de unas flores para decorar la mesa en la fiesta.
examples.translation: She brought a cake, as well as some flowers to decorate the table at the party.

examples.sentence: En el informe se mencionan los errores técnicos, amén de las deficiencias en la gestión del proyecto.
examples.translation: The report mentions the technical errors, in addition to the deficiencies in project management.

examples.sentence: Amén de su trabajo como profesor, también colabora en proyectos comunitarios los fines de semana.
examples.translation: Apart from his job as a teacher, he also collaborates in community projects on weekends.

definitions: used to introduce an extra element or consideration alongside those already mentioned

examples.sentence: El candidato habla de economía, amén de la importancia de la educación para el país.
examples.translation: The candidate talks about the economy, along with the importance of education for the country.

examples.sentence: Amén de los problemas habituales, esta vez enfrentamos un desafío inesperado en el proyecto.
examples.translation: Besides the usual problems, this time we faced an unexpected challenge in the project.

examples.sentence: Los documentos incluyen el contrato original, amén de varias enmiendas que se firmaron después.
examples.translation: The documents include the original contract, as well as several amendments that were signed afterward.

definitions: a friendship that includes sexual activity without romantic commitment; 'friends with benefits'

examples.sentence: Juan y Marta tienen una amistad con derechos, pero prefieren no complicar las cosas con un compromiso serio.
examples.translation: Juan and Marta have a friends with benefits relationship, but they prefer not to complicate things with a serious commitment.

examples.sentence: No estoy buscando una relación formal, solo una amistad con derechos para disfrutar sin ataduras.
examples.translation: I'm not looking for a formal relationship, just a friends with benefits to enjoy without strings attached.

examples.sentence: Cuando me preguntaron si tenía pareja, expliqué que mantenía una amistad con derechos desde hace meses.
examples.translation: When they asked me if I had a partner, I explained that I've had a friends with benefits relationship for months.

examples.sentence: Aunque su amistad con derechos parecía funcionar, ambos sabían que no querían algo más profundo.
examples.translation: Although their friends with benefits relationship seemed to work, both knew they didn't want anything deeper.

definitions: a casual sexual relationship between friends that does not imply an exclusive or romantic partnership

examples.sentence: En realidad, su amistad con derechos no impide que cada uno salga con otras personas.
examples.translation: In fact, their friends with benefits relationship doesn't stop either of them from dating others.

examples.sentence: No sienten celos ni presiones; su amistad con derechos es muy clara y sin compromisos románticos.
examples.translation: They don't feel jealousy or pressure; their friends with benefits relationship is very clear and without romantic commitments.

examples.sentence: Aunque su amistad con derechos causa confusión a veces, ambos disfrutan la libertad que les da.
examples.translation: Although their friends with benefits relationship sometimes causes confusion, both enjoy the freedom it gives them.

definitions: A friendship in which the participants engage in sexual activity without establishing a romantic or committed relationship.

examples.sentence: Laura y Pedro tienen una amistad con ventajas que les permite compartir momentos íntimos sin complicaciones.
examples.translation: Laura and Pedro have a friends with benefits relationship that allows them to share intimate moments without complications.

examples.sentence: No buscan nada serio, solo una amistad con ventajas que se adapte a sus estilos de vida actuales.
examples.translation: They're not looking for anything serious, just a friends with benefits arrangement that fits their current lifestyles.

examples.sentence: En la universidad, muchos optan por una amistad con ventajas para evitar ataduras sentimentales.
examples.translation: At university, many choose a friends with benefits relationship to avoid emotional attachments.

examples.sentence: Su amistad con ventajas les ha funcionado bien porque mantienen la comunicación abierta y honesta.
examples.translation: Their friends with benefits relationship has worked well because they keep open and honest communication.

definitions: A casual sexual relationship between friends that intentionally excludes expectations of emotional exclusivity or long‑term commitment.

examples.sentence: Ellos mantienen una amistad con ventajas sin esperar exclusividad ni compromisos emocionales.
examples.translation: They maintain a friends with benefits relationship without expecting exclusivity or emotional commitments.

examples.sentence: Su amistad con ventajas es clara: placer sin ataduras ni dramas sentimentales de por medio.
examples.translation: Their friends with benefits relationship is clear: pleasure without strings or romantic dramas involved.

examples.sentence: Aunque son amigos desde hace años, decidieron tener una amistad con ventajas para explorar su química.
examples.translation: Although they've been friends for years, they decided to have a friends with benefits relationship to explore their chemistry.

definitions: An immediate and intense romantic attraction felt upon first seeing another person.

examples.sentence: Cuando vio a Sofía en la fiesta, supo que era amor a primera vista y no pudo apartar la mirada.
examples.translation: When he saw Sofía at the party, he knew it was love at first sight and couldn't look away.

examples.sentence: Muchos creen en el amor a primera vista, pero otros piensan que es solo una ilusión pasajera.
examples.translation: Many believe in love at first sight, but others think it's just a fleeting illusion.

examples.sentence: En la novela, el protagonista experimenta amor a primera vista con la misteriosa desconocida en el tren.
examples.translation: In the novel, the protagonist experiences love at first sight with the mysterious stranger on the train.

examples.sentence: No pensé en el amor a primera vista hasta que conocí a Ana y sentí una conexión inmediata.
examples.translation: I didn't believe in love at first sight until I met Ana and felt an immediate connection.

definitions: A sudden and powerful liking or enthusiasm for something nonhuman, such as an object, place, or idea, experienced at first encounter.

examples.sentence: Tuve amor a primera vista por ese cuadro en la galería; su colorido me cautivó al instante.
examples.translation: I had love at first sight for that painting in the gallery; its colors captivated me instantly.

examples.sentence: Para muchos turistas, el amor a primera vista ocurre al ver la arquitectura única de la ciudad antigua.
examples.translation: For many tourists, love at first sight happens upon seeing the unique architecture of the old city.

examples.sentence: Sentí amor a primera vista con el nuevo modelo de coche; su diseño es simplemente espectacular.
examples.translation: I felt love at first sight with the new car model; its design is simply spectacular.

definitions: The belief or experience that romantic love can begin instantly at the moment of first sight.

examples.sentence: Ella siempre ha creído en el amor a primera vista y cuenta cómo se enamoró nada más verlo.
examples.translation: She has always believed in love at first sight and tells how she fell in love as soon as she saw him.

examples.sentence: El concepto de amor a primera vista ha inspirado muchas canciones y poemas románticos a lo largo de la historia.
examples.translation: The concept of love at first sight has inspired many romantic songs and poems throughout history.

examples.sentence: Aunque algunos dudan, hay quienes aseguran que el amor a primera vista es una experiencia real y profunda.
examples.translation: Although some doubt it, there are those who claim that love at first sight is a real and deep experience.

definitions: To be in conflict with someone; to quarrel, argue, or be at odds.

examples.sentence: Desde hace semanas, los hermanos andan a la greña por la herencia de sus padres.
examples.translation: For weeks, the brothers have been at odds over their parents' inheritance.

examples.sentence: No quiero andar a la greña contigo, prefiero que resolvamos esto con calma y respeto.
examples.translation: I don't want to quarrel with you; I'd rather we resolve this calmly and respectfully.

examples.sentence: Aunque antes se llevaban bien, últimamente andan a la greña por diferencias políticas.
examples.translation: Although they used to get along, lately they have been quarreling over political differences.

examples.sentence: ¿Por qué andan a la greña los vecinos? La fiesta del sábado pasado causó varios malentendidos.
examples.translation: Why are the neighbors quarreling? Last Saturday's party caused several misunderstandings.

definitions: To maintain an ongoing antagonistic or hostile relationship with another person or group.

examples.sentence: Desde que comenzó el proyecto, esas dos empresas andan a la greña y no logran colaborar.
examples.translation: Since the project started, those two companies have been hostile and cannot collaborate.

examples.sentence: Los partidos políticos andan a la greña constantemente, lo que dificulta la aprobación de leyes importantes.
examples.translation: The political parties are constantly at odds, making it difficult to approve important laws.

examples.sentence: Aunque trabajan en la misma oficina, Juan y Carlos andan a la greña y evitan hablarse.
examples.translation: Although they work in the same office, Juan and Carlos maintain a hostile relationship and avoid speaking to each other.

definitions: To be on the lookout or watchful; to move about while keeping a careful watch for someone or something.

examples.sentence: Andaba a la mira durante la fiesta, buscando a su amigo perdido entre la multitud.
examples.translation: He was on the lookout during the party, searching for his lost friend in the crowd.

examples.sentence: Siempre ando a la mira cuando camino por calles desconocidas por la noche.
examples.translation: I'm always watchful when I walk through unfamiliar streets at night.

examples.sentence: Durante la excursión, andábamos a la mira para no perdernos en el bosque cerrado.
examples.translation: During the hike, we kept watch to avoid getting lost in the dense forest.

examples.sentence: María andaba a la mira porque esperaba que llegara su cita en cualquier momento.
examples.translation: María was on the lookout because she expected her date to arrive at any moment.

definitions: To be under observation or to be the object of someone's attention or surveillance.

examples.sentence: Desde que empezó el escándalo, el político anda a la mira de los medios de comunicación.
examples.translation: Since the scandal began, the politician has been under the watchful eye of the media.

examples.sentence: Los empleados saben que andan a la mira del jefe, así que evitan cualquier error.
examples.translation: The employees know they are under the boss's surveillance, so they avoid any mistakes.

examples.sentence: Con tantas cámaras en la calle, los ladrones andan a la mira y tienen que ser más cautelosos.
examples.translation: With so many cameras on the street, thieves are under observation and have to be more cautious.

definitions: Literally, to be at or near quarter to three (approximately 2:45); used historically to indicate an approximate time.

examples.sentence: El reloj marcaba andar a tres menos cuartillo cuando decidió salir de casa.
examples.translation: The clock showed it was about quarter to three when he decided to leave the house.

examples.sentence: Recuerdo que la reunión terminó andar a tres menos cuartillo, justo antes de la cena.
examples.translation: I remember the meeting ended at about quarter to three, just before dinner.

examples.sentence: Andábamos a tres menos cuartillo y aún faltaban varios invitados por llegar.
examples.translation: It was around quarter to three and several guests had still not arrived.

examples.sentence: El tren salió andar a tres menos cuartillo, según el anuncio en la estación.
examples.translation: The train departed at about quarter to three, according to the announcement at the station.

definitions: An old or regional expression implying that the time, situation, or condition is slightly short of a full or expected state (figurative use).

examples.sentence: La situación económica anda a tres menos cuartillo; no estamos en crisis, pero tampoco en bonanza.
examples.translation: The economic situation is slightly short of ideal; we're not in crisis, but neither in boom.

examples.sentence: Su ánimo anda a tres menos cuartillo después de los últimos acontecimientos en su vida personal.
examples.translation: His mood is somewhat off after the recent events in his personal life.

examples.sentence: El proyecto anda a tres menos cuartillo, falta poco para completarlo pero todavía hay detalles que pulir.
examples.translation: The project is almost finished, just short of complete, but there are still details to polish.

definitions: To behave in an affectedly shy, coy, or girlish manner, suggesting inexperience or coquettishness.

examples.sentence: En la reunión, Carla andaba como quinceañera, nerviosa y sin saber qué decir.
examples.translation: At the meeting, Carla behaved like a quinceañera, nervous and unsure of what to say.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que andes como quinceañera cuando hablamos de temas serios, sé más directa.
examples.translation: I don't like you acting coy like a quinceañera when we talk about serious topics; be more direct.

examples.sentence: El actor andaba como quinceañera en la entrevista, mostrando una timidez poco habitual en él.
examples.translation: The actor behaved shyly like a quinceañera during the interview, showing unusual timidity.

examples.sentence: A veces, cuando está incómoda, Marta anda como quinceañera y evita el contacto visual.
examples.translation: Sometimes, when she's uncomfortable, Marta acts coy like a quinceañera and avoids eye contact.

definitions: To be overly preoccupied with appearance or ceremony, as if presenting oneself for a coming-of-age celebration.

examples.sentence: Para la fiesta, María andaba como quinceañera, preocupada por cada detalle del vestido y el peinado.
examples.translation: For the party, María was overly concerned like a quinceañera about every detail of her dress and hairstyle.

examples.sentence: Los organizadores andan como quinceañeras con la decoración, quieren que todo sea perfecto y delicado.
examples.translation: The organizers are fussing like quinceañeras with the decorations; they want everything perfect and delicate.

examples.sentence: No es necesario andar como quinceañera preparando una presentación tan sencilla.
examples.translation: It's not necessary to be so preoccupied like a quinceañera preparing such a simple presentation.

definitions: To speak or act with circumlocution; to avoid stating something plainly by using evasive or roundabout language.

examples.sentence: No andes con ambages y dime directamente qué piensas sobre el proyecto.
examples.translation: Don't beat around the bush and tell me directly what you think about the project.

examples.sentence: El político anduvo con ambages durante toda la entrevista para evitar responder a las preguntas difíciles.
examples.translation: The politician spoke evasively throughout the interview to avoid answering difficult questions.

examples.sentence: Cuando le pregunté por la razón del retraso, él andaba con ambages y no me dio una respuesta clara.
examples.translation: When I asked him about the reason for the delay, he was evasive and didn't give me a clear answer.

definitions: To delay or hinder communication by adding unnecessary detail or equivocation.

examples.sentence: Andan con ambages en la negociación, añadiendo detalles que solo confunden más el acuerdo.
examples.translation: They delay the negotiation by adding unnecessary details that only confuse the agreement further.

examples.sentence: No me gusta que andes con ambages cuando hablamos de dinero; prefiero que seas claro y directo.
examples.translation: I don't like you to be evasive when we talk about money; I prefer you to be clear and direct.

examples.sentence: El informe anduvo con ambages, lo que hizo difícil entender los puntos clave presentados por el equipo.
examples.translation: The report was full of circumlocution, which made it difficult to understand the key points presented by the team.

definitions: To be involved in shady, underhanded, or corrupt dealings.

examples.sentence: Se rumorea que el empresario anda en chanchullos para evitar pagar impuestos.
examples.translation: It is rumored that the businessman is involved in shady dealings to avoid paying taxes.

examples.sentence: No confío en ese político porque siempre anda en chanchullos y nunca cumple sus promesas.
examples.translation: I don't trust that politician because he's always involved in underhanded schemes and never keeps his promises.

examples.sentence: Durante años, la compañía anduvo en chanchullos para conseguir contratos gubernamentales fraudulentos.
examples.translation: For years, the company engaged in corrupt dealings to obtain fraudulent government contracts.

definitions: To engage in deceitful schemes or fraudulent transactions for personal gain.

examples.sentence: Los empleados descubrieron que el jefe andaba en chanchullos para desviar fondos de la empresa.
examples.translation: The employees discovered that the boss was involved in fraudulent schemes to divert company funds.

examples.sentence: No quiero saber nada de personas que andan en chanchullos, prefiero relaciones transparentes y honestas.
examples.translation: I don't want anything to do with people involved in shady dealings; I prefer transparent and honest relationships.

examples.sentence: El caso judicial reveló que varios funcionarios andaban en chanchullos para beneficiar a ciertos empresarios.
examples.translation: The court case revealed that several officials were involved in fraudulent deals to benefit certain businessmen.

definitions: To be the subject of gossip or widespread rumor; to be talked about by others.

examples.sentence: Después del escándalo, Ana anda en lenguas y todos comentan sobre su situación.
examples.translation: After the scandal, Ana is the subject of gossip and everyone talks about her situation.

examples.sentence: El cantante anda en lenguas tras su polémica entrevista que causó revuelo en las redes sociales.
examples.translation: The singer is being gossiped about after his controversial interview caused an uproar on social media.

examples.sentence: Cuando alguien anda en lenguas, es difícil mantener la privacidad en un pequeño pueblo.
examples.translation: When someone is the subject of gossip, it is hard to maintain privacy in a small town.

definitions: To go about gossiping or spreading rumors oneself.

examples.sentence: No me gusta andar en lenguas porque muchas veces se distorsionan las historias.
examples.translation: I don't like to gossip because stories are often distorted.

examples.sentence: En la oficina, algunos empleados andan en lenguas difundiendo rumores sin fundamento.
examples.translation: In the office, some employees go about gossiping and spreading baseless rumors.

examples.sentence: Aunque sabía que no era correcto, terminó andando en lenguas con sus compañeros de trabajo.
examples.translation: Although she knew it was wrong, she ended up gossiping with her coworkers.

definitions: To engage in criminal, immoral, or otherwise disreputable activities.

examples.sentence: Después de perder su empleo, Luis empezó a andar en malos pasos y tuvo problemas con la ley.
examples.translation: After losing his job, Luis started engaging in bad activities and got into trouble with the law.

examples.sentence: Los jóvenes que andan en malos pasos suelen alejarse de sus familias y amigos genuinos.
examples.translation: Young people who get involved in bad ways often distance themselves from their families and genuine friends.

examples.sentence: La policía arrestó a varios individuos que andaban en malos pasos relacionados con el narcotráfico.
examples.translation: The police arrested several individuals involved in criminal activities related to drug trafficking.

definitions: To associate with a bad crowd or adopt harmful habits and behavior.

examples.sentence: Se preocupa porque su hijo anda en malos pasos y frecuenta malas compañías.
examples.translation: He worries because his son is hanging out with a bad crowd and adopting harmful habits.

examples.sentence: No quiero que mis amigos anden en malos pasos que puedan arruinar su futuro.
examples.translation: I don't want my friends to get involved in bad behaviors that could ruin their future.

examples.sentence: La comunidad está intentando ayudar a los jóvenes que andan en malos pasos para que cambien de rumbo.
examples.translation: The community is trying to help young people involved in bad activities to change course.

definitions: To be short of money; to be experiencing financial difficulties.

examples.sentence: Este mes ando mal de dinero, así que tendré que recortar algunos gastos.
examples.translation: This month I'm short of money, so I'll have to cut some expenses.

examples.sentence: No puedo salir a cenar hoy porque ando mal de dinero después de pagar el alquiler.
examples.translation: I can't go out to dinner today because I'm short on money after paying the rent.

examples.sentence: Si andas mal de dinero, puedo prestarte algo para que no te quedes sin nada.
examples.translation: If you're short of money, I can lend you some so you don't end up with nothing.

definitions: To digress from the subject; to speak or act evasively and avoid getting to the point.
idiom: andar por los cerros de Úbeda

examples.sentence: En la reunión, el jefe andaba por los cerros de Úbeda y nunca respondió a la pregunta principal.
examples.translation: In the meeting, the boss digressed and never answered the main question.
examples.matched_span: andaba por los cerros de Úbeda

examples.sentence: Cuando hablas por los cerros de Úbeda, pierdes la atención del público y no avanzas en el tema.
examples.translation: When you go off on tangents, you lose the audience's attention and don't get to the point.
examples.matched_span: hablas por los cerros de Úbeda

examples.sentence: No me gusta cuando el profesor anda por los cerros de Úbeda; prefiero que sea claro y directo.
examples.translation: I don't like it when the teacher digresses; I prefer him to be clear and direct.
examples.matched_span: anda por los cerros de Úbeda

definitions: To tell someone to go away in a coarse or obscene manner; to send someone to hell.

examples.sentence: Si no te gusta lo que digo, entonces andate a la chucha y no vuelvas más.
examples.translation: If you don't like what I say, then go to hell and don't come back.

examples.sentence: Cuando el cliente empezó a insultar, el vendedor le dijo que se anduviera a la chucha y terminó la llamada.
examples.translation: When the client started insulting, the salesman told him to go to hell and ended the call.

examples.sentence: No voy a tolerar ese comportamiento; si quieres problemas, andate a la chucha de una vez.
examples.translation: I'm not going to tolerate that behavior; if you want trouble, go to hell right now.

definitions: To avoid speaking directly; to use circumlocution or detours instead of addressing a matter plainly.

examples.sentence: Cuando le pregunté sobre el problema, Juan empezó a andarse con rodeos en lugar de darme una respuesta clara.
examples.translation: When I asked him about the problem, Juan started beating around the bush instead of giving me a clear answer.

examples.sentence: No me ando con rodeos: necesito que entregues el informe antes del viernes o tendremos problemas.
examples.translation: I won't beat around the bush: I need you to deliver the report by Friday or we'll have problems.

examples.sentence: ¿Por qué te andas con rodeos? Dime de una vez si aceptarás la propuesta o no.
examples.translation: Why are you beating around the bush? Just tell me once and for all if you will accept the proposal or not.

definitions: To beat around the bush.

examples.sentence: En la reunión, María se anduvo con rodeos y nunca explicó cuál era el verdadero problema.
examples.translation: In the meeting, María beat around the bush and never explained what the real problem was.

examples.sentence: No me gusta cuando la gente se anda con rodeos; prefiero que hablen directo y claro.
examples.translation: I don't like it when people beat around the bush; I prefer them to speak directly and clearly.

examples.sentence: Si quieres convencer a tu jefe, no te andes con rodeos y presenta tu idea sin rodeos.
examples.translation: If you want to convince your boss, don't beat around the bush and present your idea straightforwardly.

definitions: To avoid getting to the point; to speak or act in a roundabout way.

examples.sentence: Carlos siempre se anda por las ramas cuando hablamos de sus planes futuros, nunca va al grano.
examples.translation: Carlos always beats around the bush when we talk about his future plans; he never gets to the point.

examples.sentence: No te andes por las ramas, explícame exactamente qué pasó ayer en la fiesta.
examples.translation: Don't beat around the bush, explain exactly what happened at the party yesterday.

examples.sentence: La profesora se anduvo por las ramas durante la clase y no explicó el tema principal.
examples.translation: The teacher beat around the bush during class and didn't explain the main topic.

definitions: To digress from the main subject.

examples.sentence: Durante la conferencia, el ponente se anduvo por las ramas y terminó hablando de cosas irrelevantes.
examples.translation: During the conference, the speaker digressed and ended up talking about irrelevant things.

examples.sentence: No me ando por las ramas: la reunión fue un fracaso porque nadie cumplió con sus responsabilidades.
examples.translation: I won't digress: the meeting was a failure because no one fulfilled their responsibilities.

examples.sentence: ¿Por qué te andas por las ramas cuando te pregunto por el proyecto? Solo dame la información clave.
examples.translation: Why do you digress when I ask you about the project? Just give me the key information.

definitions: To be overcome by intense crying; to burst into uncontrollable tears.

examples.sentence: Cuando recibió la noticia del accidente, Ana se anegó en llanto y no pudo hablar durante varios minutos.
examples.translation: When she received the news of the accident, Ana burst into uncontrollable tears and couldn't speak for several minutes.

examples.sentence: El niño se anegó en llanto al perder su juguete favorito en el parque.
examples.translation: The boy was overcome with crying when he lost his favorite toy in the park.

examples.sentence: No me anegué en llanto, pero sí sentí una tristeza profunda cuando me despedí de mis amigos.
examples.translation: I didn't burst into tears, but I felt deep sadness when I said goodbye to my friends.

definitions: To weep profusely or be flooded with tears, often as an expression of deep grief or emotion.

examples.sentence: Ella se anegaba en llanto cada vez que recordaba aquel día tan doloroso.
examples.translation: She wept profusely every time she remembered that painful day.

examples.sentence: Durante la película, algunos espectadores se anegaron en llanto por la emotiva historia.
examples.translation: During the movie, some viewers were flooded with tears due to the emotional story.

examples.sentence: No pude evitar anegarme en llanto al ver la despedida de mis abuelos en la estación.
examples.translation: I couldn't help but weep profusely when I saw my grandparents' farewell at the station.

definitions: When uncertain; in a situation of doubt.

examples.sentence: Ante la duda, es mejor consultar con un experto antes de tomar una decisión importante.
examples.translation: When uncertain, it is better to consult an expert before making an important decision.

examples.sentence: Si ante la duda no sabes qué hacer, siempre puedes pedir una segunda opinión.
examples.translation: If when in doubt you don't know what to do, you can always ask for a second opinion.

examples.sentence: Ante la duda, Marta prefirió esperar a que llegaran más datos para actuar con seguridad.
examples.translation: Faced with uncertainty, Marta preferred to wait for more data before acting confidently.

definitions: Faced with uncertainty: used to introduce how one should respond or decide when information is lacking.

examples.sentence: Ante la duda, siempre recomiendo guardar una copia de respaldo para evitar pérdidas.
examples.translation: Faced with uncertainty, I always recommend keeping a backup copy to avoid losses.

examples.sentence: Cuando no estás seguro, ante la duda debes optar por la opción más segura.
examples.translation: When you are not sure, in case of doubt you should choose the safest option.

examples.sentence: Ante la duda, el doctor decidió realizar más pruebas antes de diagnosticar la enfermedad.
examples.translation: Faced with uncertainty, the doctor decided to run more tests before diagnosing the illness.

definitions: Used to indicate a precautionary course of action: in case of doubt, take a conservative or specified action.

examples.sentence: Ante la duda, apaga el dispositivo y reinícialo; muchas fallas se solucionan así.
examples.translation: When in doubt, turn off the device and restart it; many problems are solved that way.

examples.sentence: Si no estás seguro de la calidad, ante la duda compra una marca reconocida aunque sea más cara.
examples.translation: If you’re not sure of the quality, in case of doubt buy a recognized brand even if it’s more expensive.

examples.sentence: Ante la duda, siempre lleva un paraguas porque el clima puede cambiar rápidamente.
examples.translation: When uncertain, always carry an umbrella because the weather can change quickly.

definitions: First of all; before anything else.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, quiero agradecer a todos por venir a esta reunión tan importante.
examples.translation: First of all, I want to thank everyone for coming to this important meeting.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, debemos revisar el presupuesto para saber si podemos continuar con el proyecto.
examples.translation: First of all, we must review the budget to know if we can continue with the project.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, asegúrate de tener todos los documentos necesarios para la solicitud.
examples.translation: First of all, make sure you have all the necessary documents for the application.

definitions: Above all; primarily.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, recuerda que la salud es lo más importante en cualquier circunstancia.
examples.translation: Above all, remember that health is the most important thing in any circumstance.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, debemos proteger el medio ambiente para garantizar un futuro sostenible.
examples.translation: Primarily, we must protect the environment to ensure a sustainable future.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, quiero dejar claro que el respeto mutuo es la base de esta relación.
examples.translation: Above all, I want to make clear that mutual respect is the foundation of this relationship.

definitions: Used to indicate the primary priority or the first point to be addressed.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, el primer punto en la agenda es discutir el plan de acción para el próximo trimestre.
examples.translation: First of all, the first item on the agenda is to discuss the action plan for the next quarter.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, debemos resolver los problemas técnicos antes de avanzar con el diseño final.
examples.translation: Before anything else, we must solve the technical problems before moving forward with the final design.

examples.sentence: Antes que nada, quiero aclarar las expectativas del proyecto para evitar malentendidos.
examples.translation: First of all, I want to clarify the project’s expectations to avoid misunderstandings.

definitions: Formerly; previously; as before (archaic or emphatic expression indicating something that occurred in the past).

examples.sentence: Antes y con antes, la plaza era un lugar vacío, pero ahora está llena de vida y comercio.
examples.translation: Formerly, the plaza was an empty place, but now it is full of life and commerce.

examples.sentence: Antes y con antes, los caminos eran difíciles de transitar, pero ahora están bien pavimentados.
examples.translation: Previously, the roads were difficult to travel, but now they are well paved.

examples.sentence: En aquel pueblo, antes y con antes, las tradiciones se respetaban más que ahora.
examples.translation: In that town, formerly, traditions were respected more than now.

definitions: Earlier still; used to convey an intensified sense of prior occurrence (rare, literary usage).

examples.sentence: Antes y con antes, se creía que el sol giraba alrededor de la Tierra, una idea ya superada.
examples.translation: Earlier still, it was believed that the sun revolved around the Earth, an idea now outdated.

examples.sentence: Antes y con antes, la gente viajaba a caballo, pero con la llegada del tren todo cambió.
examples.translation: Earlier still, people traveled by horse, but with the arrival of the train everything changed.

examples.sentence: Antes y con antes, la comunicación era mucho más lenta sin la tecnología actual.
examples.translation: Earlier still, communication was much slower without current technology.

definitions: Before and after; referring to the periods immediately prior to and subsequent to a specified event.

examples.sentence: Aquí tienes las fotos del antes y después de la renovación de la casa; notarás la gran diferencia.
examples.translation: Here are the before and after photos of the house renovation; you will notice the big difference.

examples.sentence: El antes y después del parque es impresionante: ahora hay áreas verdes y juegos infantiles nuevos.
examples.translation: The before and after of the park is impressive: now there are green areas and new playgrounds.

examples.sentence: Comparar el antes y después del equipo nos muestra cuánto han mejorado en la temporada.
examples.translation: Comparing the before and after of the team shows us how much they have improved this season.

examples.sentence: El antes y después del restaurante revela un cambio total en la decoración y el menú.
examples.translation: The before and after of the restaurant reveals a total change in decoration and the menu.

definitions: On both sides of a specified time; occurring or applicable both prior to and following a particular time or event.

examples.sentence: Durante el evento, hubo controles de seguridad tanto antes como después de la presentación principal.
examples.translation: During the event, there were security checks both before and after the main presentation.

examples.sentence: Los accesos estaban restringidos antes y después del concierto para evitar aglomeraciones.
examples.translation: Access was restricted on both sides of the concert to avoid crowds.

examples.sentence: La información se distribuyó antes y después de la reunión para que todos estuvieran informados.
examples.translation: Information was distributed before and after the meeting so that everyone was informed.

examples.sentence: El tráfico estuvo complicado antes y después de la hora pico en las avenidas principales.
examples.translation: Traffic was complicated before and after rush hour on the main avenues.

definitions: Used to indicate a comparison or contrast between a state existing before an event and the state after it.

examples.sentence: El antes y después de mi recuperación muestra cuánto ha cambiado mi salud en poco tiempo.
examples.translation: The before and after of my recovery shows how much my health has changed in a short time.

examples.sentence: Este documento ilustra el antes y después de la reforma educativa en nuestro país.
examples.translation: This document illustrates the before and after of the educational reform in our country.

examples.sentence: El antes y después de la ciudad tras la construcción del metro es notable en la movilidad urbana.
examples.translation: The before and after of the city after the metro construction is notable in urban mobility.

definitions: To make an already bad or tense situation worse by contributing additional provocation, criticism, or harmful information.

examples.sentence: En lugar de calmar la discusión, sus comentarios solo añadieron leña al fuego y empeoraron el ambiente.
examples.translation: Instead of calming the argument, his comments only added fuel to the fire and worsened the atmosphere.

examples.sentence: No vamos a añadir leña al fuego con más acusaciones; mejor busquemos una solución pacífica.
examples.translation: We are not going to add fuel to the fire with more accusations; let's better look for a peaceful solution.

examples.sentence: Cada vez que habla del tema, parece que añade leña al fuego y provoca más tensión entre todos.
examples.translation: Every time he talks about the topic, it seems he adds fuel to the fire and causes more tension among everyone.

definitions: To intentionally inflame emotions or stir up controversy in order to provoke a stronger reaction.

examples.sentence: Los medios de comunicación añadieron leña al fuego con rumores infundados sobre el escándalo.
examples.translation: The media added fuel to the fire with unfounded rumors about the scandal.

examples.sentence: No quiero añadir leña al fuego, pero creo que deberían aclarar esa situación cuanto antes.
examples.translation: I don't want to add fuel to the fire, but I think they should clarify that situation as soon as possible.

examples.sentence: Ella añadió leña al fuego al publicar comentarios polémicos en las redes sociales durante la crisis.
examples.translation: She added fuel to the fire by posting controversial comments on social media during the crisis.

definitions: To exacerbate a conflict or problem through words or actions that increase anger, tension, or damage.

examples.sentence: No deberías añadir leña al fuego con esas palabras, porque la discusión ya está bastante acalorada.
examples.translation: You shouldn't add fuel to the fire with those words because the discussion is already quite heated.

examples.sentence: Cada vez que intentan mediar, alguien añade leña al fuego y la pelea se intensifica más.
examples.translation: Every time they try to mediate, someone adds fuel to the fire and the fight intensifies more.

examples.sentence: En vez de ayudar, sus actitudes solo añadieron leña al fuego y provocaron una crisis mayor.
examples.translation: Instead of helping, their attitudes only added fuel to the fire and caused a bigger crisis.

definitions: A proverb stating that a year with abundant snowfall will bring good crops or prosperity, implying that certain adverse-seeming conditions presage future benefit.
idiom: año de nieves, año de bienes

examples.sentence: Dicen que año de nieves, año de bienes, y este invierno tan frío augura una buena cosecha.
examples.translation: They say a year of snow is a year of good crops, and this cold winter foretells a good harvest.
examples.matched_span: año de nieves, año de bienes

examples.sentence: Aunque este año hubo muchas tormentas, año de nieves, año de bienes, así que esperamos prosperidad.
examples.translation: Although this year had many storms, a year of snow is a year of good crops, so we expect prosperity.
examples.matched_span: año de nieves, año de bienes

examples.sentence: Mi abuela siempre repetía que año de nieves, año de bienes para animarnos en tiempos difíciles.
examples.translation: My grandmother always used to say a year of snow is a year of good crops to cheer us in difficult times.
examples.matched_span: año de nieves, año de bienes

definitions: By extension, a saying used to express that a temporary difficulty or unusual occurrence may result in positive outcomes later on.
idiom: año de nieves, año de bienes

examples.sentence: Sé que el proyecto ha tenido problemas, pero año de nieves, año de bienes; seguro que algo bueno saldrá de esto.
examples.translation: I know the project has had problems, but a year of snow is a year of good crops; surely something good will come out of this.
examples.matched_span: año de nieves, año de bienes

examples.sentence: Aunque la pandemia trajo dificultades, año de nieves, año de bienes, y esperamos que la economía mejore pronto.
examples.translation: Although the pandemic brought difficulties, a year of snow is a year of good crops, and we hope the economy improves soon.
examples.matched_span: año de nieves, año de bienes

examples.sentence: No te preocupes por el retraso; año de nieves, año de bienes, a veces los contratiempos traen beneficios inesperados.
examples.translation: Don't worry about the delay; a year of snow is a year of good crops, sometimes setbacks bring unexpected benefits.
examples.matched_span: año de nieves, año de bienes

definitions: To manage or get by with the means available; to cope or make do in difficult or constrained circumstances.

examples.sentence: Con poco dinero y mucha creatividad, Paula se las arregló para montar un negocio exitoso.
examples.translation: With little money and lots of creativity, Paula managed to set up a successful business.

examples.sentence: Nos quedamos sin gasolina en medio de la carretera, pero nos las arreglamos para llegar a la próxima estación.
examples.translation: We ran out of gas in the middle of the highway, but we managed to get to the next station.

examples.sentence: Aunque la situación era complicada, ellos se las arreglaron para cumplir con el plazo establecido.
examples.translation: Although the situation was complicated, they managed to meet the established deadline.

definitions: To fend for oneself or to handle a situation without external assistance.

examples.sentence: Cuando vivía solo, me las arreglaba para cocinar y limpiar sin ayuda de nadie.
examples.translation: When I lived alone, I managed to cook and clean without anyone's help.

examples.sentence: ¿Cómo te las arreglaste para resolver ese problema sin llamar al técnico?
examples.translation: How did you manage to solve that problem without calling the technician?

examples.sentence: Aunque no recibió apoyo, el joven se las arregló para conseguir un empleo por sus propios medios.
examples.translation: Although he received no support, the young man managed to get a job on his own.

definitions: To improvise a solution or to repair/arrange something by resourcefulness or makeshift methods.

examples.sentence: Nos quedamos sin martillo, pero nos las arreglamos con unas piedras para clavar los clavos.
examples.translation: We ran out of hammers, but we improvised with some stones to hammer the nails.

examples.sentence: Cuando la máquina se rompió, se las arreglaron para repararla con piezas recicladas.
examples.translation: When the machine broke down, they improvised to fix it with recycled parts.

examples.sentence: No teníamos las herramientas adecuadas, pero nos las arreglamos para armar el mueble con lo que había.
examples.translation: We didn’t have the right tools, but we managed to put together the furniture with what we had.

definitions: To contrive or rig something together using ingenuity rather than standard tools or procedures.

examples.sentence: Para la presentación, se las arregló para crear un proyector casero con materiales simples.
examples.translation: For the presentation, he contrived to create a homemade projector with simple materials.

examples.sentence: Aunque no era lo ideal, se las arreglaron para montar un escenario improvisado en la plaza.
examples.translation: Although it was not ideal, they managed to rig together an improvised stage in the square.

examples.sentence: Ella se las arregló para montar un sistema de sonido usando solo cables y altavoces viejos.
examples.translation: She contrived to set up a sound system using only old cables and speakers.

definitions: To separate what is valuable or true from what is worthless or false; to distinguish the essential from the inessential.
idiom: apartar el grano de la paja

examples.sentence: En su investigación, logró apartar el grano de la paja y enfocarse solo en datos confiables.
examples.translation: In his research, he managed to separate the wheat from the chaff and focus only on reliable data.
examples.matched_span: apartar el grano de la paja

examples.sentence: Durante la revisión, el editor apartó el grano de la paja para mejorar la calidad del artículo.
examples.translation: During the review, the editor sifted through the material to improve the article's quality.
examples.matched_span: apartó el grano de la paja

examples.sentence: Cuando escucho tantas opiniones, intento apartar el grano de la paja para tomar una buena decisión.
examples.translation: When I hear so many opinions, I try to separate the wheat from the chaff to make a good decision.
examples.matched_span: apartar el grano de la paja

definitions: To sift information, ideas, or items in order to retain what is useful and discard what is not.
idiom: apartar el grano de la paja

examples.sentence: El equipo de analistas se encargó de apartar el grano de la paja para entregar un informe claro.
examples.translation: The team of analysts took care to sift through the information to deliver a clear report.
examples.matched_span: apartar el grano de la paja

examples.sentence: Necesitamos apartar el grano de la paja en este proyecto para identificar qué ideas son viables.
examples.translation: We need to separate the wheat from the chaff in this project to identify which ideas are viable.
examples.matched_span: apartar el grano de la paja

examples.sentence: Ante tanta información, es importante apartar el grano de la paja para no distraernos con lo irrelevante.
examples.translation: With so much information, it is important to sift through it to avoid being distracted by the irrelevant.
examples.matched_span: apartar el grano de la paja

definitions: To go out and dominate public spaces or social settings, often by attracting attention, impressing others, or being highly successful; to 'take the town by storm.'

examples.sentence: Con su nuevo disco, ese cantante logró aplanar calles y convertirse en la sensación de la ciudad.
examples.translation: With his new album, that singer managed to take the town by storm and become the sensation of the city.

examples.sentence: Las bailarinas aplanaron calles en su gira por Europa, llenando cada teatro con sus presentaciones.
examples.translation: The dancers took the town by storm on their European tour, filling every theater with their performances.

examples.sentence: Cuando la compañía lanzó su producto innovador, aplanaron calles y dominaron el mercado rápidamente.
examples.translation: When the company launched its innovative product, they took the market by storm and dominated quickly.

definitions: To level, smooth, or flatten streets or roads as part of construction or maintenance work.

examples.sentence: Los trabajadores están aplanando calles en el centro para mejorar el acceso vehicular.
examples.translation: The workers are leveling streets downtown to improve vehicle access.

examples.sentence: El ayuntamiento contrató una empresa para aplanar calles y renovar la infraestructura vial.
examples.translation: The city council hired a company to flatten streets and renew the road infrastructure.

examples.sentence: Durante el verano, se aplanaron calles en los barrios residenciales para facilitar el tránsito.
examples.translation: During the summer, streets in residential neighborhoods were leveled to facilitate traffic.

examples.sentence: El equipo de construcción aplanó calles antes de colocar el nuevo pavimento asfáltico.
examples.translation: The construction team flattened streets before laying the new asphalt pavement.

definitions: To perform or present oneself in a way that overwhelms rivals or onlookers, producing notable public impact.

examples.sentence: Cuando Marta apareció en el escenario con su voz potente, realmente aplanó calles y dejó a todos boquiabiertos.
examples.translation: When Marta appeared on stage with her powerful voice, she really overwhelmed everyone and left them speechless.

examples.sentence: No creo que él pueda aplanar calles en la próxima competencia, pero seguro dará lo mejor de sí.
examples.translation: I don't think he can overwhelm the competition in the next contest, but he'll definitely give his best.

examples.sentence: La banda aplanó calles anoche con su presentación, la multitud nunca había visto algo así.
examples.translation: The band blew everyone away last night with their performance; the crowd had never seen anything like it.

definitions: To reduce the rate of new cases or the intensity of a surge (typically of an epidemic or similar phenomenon) so that demand on healthcare systems or other resources does not exceed capacity.

examples.sentence: Para evitar el colapso hospitalario, el gobierno implementó medidas estrictas para aplanar la curva del contagio.
examples.translation: To avoid hospital collapse, the government implemented strict measures to flatten the contagion curve.

examples.sentence: Si todos seguimos las recomendaciones, lograremos aplanar la curva y proteger a los más vulnerables.
examples.translation: If we all follow the recommendations, we will flatten the curve and protect the most vulnerable.

examples.sentence: Los expertos explicaron que aplanar la curva es crucial para que el sistema de salud pueda atender a todos los pacientes.
examples.translation: Experts explained that flattening the curve is crucial so the health system can attend to all patients.

definitions: To lessen, disperse, or mitigate the peak or rapid increase of any social, economic, or demographic problem by flattening its growth curve.

examples.sentence: Las políticas sociales buscan aplanar la curva de la desigualdad para que la brecha no siga creciendo.
examples.translation: Social policies aim to flatten the inequality curve so that the gap does not keep growing.

examples.sentence: Para aplanar la curva del desempleo, el gobierno lanzó un programa de capacitación laboral intensiva.
examples.translation: To flatten the unemployment curve, the government launched an intensive job training program.

examples.sentence: Aunque la crisis económica es grave, con estas medidas podemos aplanar la curva y evitar un colapso total.
examples.translation: Although the economic crisis is severe, with these measures we can flatten the curve and avoid a total collapse.

definitions: To slow and spread out the occurrence of an undesirable peak over a longer period to avoid overwhelming infrastructure or services.

examples.sentence: Hay que aplanar la curva del tráfico para que las calles no se saturen en horas pico.
examples.translation: We need to flatten the traffic curve so that the streets don’t get saturated during rush hours.

examples.sentence: La empresa decidió aplanar la curva de producción para evitar sobrecargar sus instalaciones.
examples.translation: The company decided to flatten the production curve to avoid overloading its facilities.

examples.sentence: Aplanar la curva de consumo energético en verano ayuda a prevenir apagones generalizados.
examples.translation: Flattening the energy consumption curve in summer helps prevent widespread blackouts.

definitions: To squeeze or grasp someone's buttocks; to engage in a sexual or physical act involving the buttocks.

examples.sentence: Durante el baile, él no dudó en apretar el culo de su pareja con cariño y complicidad.
examples.translation: During the dance, he didn’t hesitate to squeeze his partner’s buttocks with affection and complicity.

examples.sentence: No creo que apriete el culo de nadie sin su consentimiento; siempre respeta a los demás.
examples.translation: I don’t think he squeezes anyone’s buttocks without consent; he always respects others.

examples.sentence: ¿Me permites apretar tu culo un momento? Es parte del juego, no te preocupes.
examples.translation: Can I squeeze your buttocks for a moment? It’s part of the game, don’t worry.

examples.sentence: Apreté el culo de mi novia mientras caminábamos por la playa, disfrutando del momento juntos.
examples.translation: I squeezed my girlfriend’s buttocks while we walked on the beach, enjoying the moment together.

definitions: To brace oneself, tighten up, or endure hardship with determination; to prepare to face difficulty.

examples.sentence: Si queremos terminar el proyecto a tiempo, tendremos que apretar el culo y trabajar hasta tarde.
examples.translation: If we want to finish the project on time, we’ll have to brace ourselves and work late.

examples.sentence: Cuando la situación se puso difícil, apreté el culo y seguí adelante sin rendirme.
examples.translation: When the situation got tough, I braced myself and kept going without giving up.

examples.sentence: Nos van a apretar el culo durante el examen final, así que conviene prepararse bien desde ahora.
examples.translation: They’re going to make us brace ourselves during the final exam, so it’s best to prepare well from now.

definitions: To clench one's buttocks or body tightly, often as a physical reaction to tension, fear, or excitement.

examples.sentence: Al escuchar el ruido extraño, apreté el culo con miedo esperando que nada malo ocurriera.
examples.translation: Upon hearing the strange noise, I clenched my buttocks with fear, hoping nothing bad would happen.

examples.sentence: Ella siempre aprieta el culo cuando está nerviosa antes de subir al escenario.
examples.translation: She always clenches her buttocks when she’s nervous before going on stage.

examples.sentence: No pude evitar apretar el culo cuando vi el final de la película de terror, ¡qué tensión!
examples.translation: I couldn’t help but clench my buttocks when I saw the ending of the horror movie, what tension!

examples.sentence: En la montaña rusa, todos apretaron el culo durante las bajadas más pronunciadas.
examples.translation: On the roller coaster, everyone clenched their buttocks during the steepest drops.

definitions: To be frugal or stingy with money; to restrain spending or hold back resources in order to cope with limited means.

examples.sentence: Con el sueldo reducido, tuve que apretar el culo y ahorrar en gastos innecesarios.
examples.translation: With the reduced salary, I had to be stingy and save on unnecessary expenses.

examples.sentence: Nos estamos apretando el culo este mes porque el negocio no ha ido bien y hay que cuidar cada peso.
examples.translation: We’re tightening our belts this month because business hasn’t been good and we have to watch every penny.

examples.sentence: Si quieres salir adelante, tendrás que apretar el culo y evitar comprar cosas que no necesitas.
examples.translation: If you want to get ahead, you’ll have to be frugal and avoid buying things you don’t need.

definitions: To clench or tighten the hands into fists; a physical action often expressing anger, frustration, or readiness.

examples.sentence: Cuando escuchó la noticia, apretó los puños con rabia e impotencia.
examples.translation: When he heard the news, he clenched his fists with anger and helplessness.

examples.sentence: Apreté los puños para controlar mi frustración durante la reunión difícil con el jefe.
examples.translation: I clenched my fists to control my frustration during the difficult meeting with the boss.

examples.sentence: Ella apretó los puños antes de salir al ring, lista para la pelea.
examples.translation: She clenched her fists before going into the ring, ready for the fight.

examples.sentence: No pude evitar apretar los puños cuando vi la injusticia que cometieron contra mi amigo.
examples.translation: I couldn’t help but clench my fists when I saw the injustice committed against my friend.

definitions: To summon determination or resolve to confront difficulties; to steel oneself to act despite fear or sorrow.

examples.sentence: Para enfrentar esa difícil situación, tuve que apretar los puños y no dejar que el miedo me paralizara.
examples.translation: To face that difficult situation, I had to summon determination and not let fear paralyze me.

examples.sentence: Ella apretó los puños y decidió luchar por sus sueños a pesar de las adversidades.
examples.translation: She steeled herself and decided to fight for her dreams despite the adversities.

examples.sentence: Cuando las cosas se pusieron feas, apretamos los puños y seguimos adelante con más fuerza que nunca.
examples.translation: When things got tough, we braced ourselves and moved forward stronger than ever.

definitions: To restrain or control one's emotions, such as containing tears or suppressing visible distress.

examples.sentence: Apreté los puños para contener las lágrimas durante el discurso emotivo de despedida.
examples.translation: I clenched my fists to hold back tears during the emotional farewell speech.

examples.sentence: Ella apretó los puños para no mostrar su tristeza frente a los demás.
examples.translation: She clenched her fists to hide her sadness in front of others.

examples.sentence: Intenté apretar los puños y controlar mis emociones, pero era imposible no llorar en ese momento.
examples.translation: I tried to clench my fists and control my emotions, but it was impossible not to cry at that moment.

definitions: To reduce personal or organizational spending; to adopt austerity measures in order to cope with reduced income or difficult economic conditions.

examples.sentence: Debido a la crisis, la empresa tuvo que apretarse el cinturón y reducir gastos en todas las áreas.
examples.translation: Due to the crisis, the company had to tighten its belt and reduce expenses in all areas.

examples.sentence: Las familias están apretándose el cinturón para poder llegar a fin de mes sin problemas.
examples.translation: Families are tightening their belts to make it to the end of the month without problems.

examples.sentence: Si queremos salir adelante, tendremos que apretarnos el cinturón y evitar gastos innecesarios.
examples.translation: If we want to get ahead, we’ll have to tighten our belts and avoid unnecessary expenses.

definitions: To fasten or tighten one's belt around the waist (literal physical action).

examples.sentence: Antes de salir, apreté el cinturón para que la camisa me quedara bien ajustada.
examples.translation: Before going out, I fastened my belt so the shirt would fit snugly.

examples.sentence: Ella siempre aprieta el cinturón con cuidado para no dañarlo.
examples.translation: She always tightens her belt carefully so as not to damage it.

examples.sentence: ¿Puedes ayudarme a apretar el cinturón? No logro que quede bien.
examples.translation: Can you help me tighten my belt? I can’t get it to fit properly.

examples.sentence: El sastre ajustó el cinturón para que apretara justo en la cintura.
examples.translation: The tailor adjusted the belt so that it fit tightly around the waist.

definitions: To live more frugally or tighten one's budget until financial circumstances improve.

examples.sentence: Después de perder el trabajo, tuvimos que apretarnos el cinturón y vivir con menos.
examples.translation: After losing the job, we had to tighten our belts and live with less.

examples.sentence: Para ahorrar dinero, María decidió apretarse el cinturón durante varios meses.
examples.translation: To save money, María decided to live frugally for several months.

examples.sentence: Si quieres comprar la casa, tendrás que apretarte el cinturón y controlar tus gastos.
examples.translation: If you want to buy the house, you’ll have to tighten your belt and control your expenses.

definitions: To show early signs of talent, skill, or promise in a particular field or activity; to demonstrate potential for future success.

examples.sentence: Desde pequeño, Lucas apuntaba maneras para ser un gran futbolista.
examples.translation: Since he was little, Lucas showed signs of being a great footballer.

examples.sentence: No cabe duda de que Ana apunta maneras; su talento para la pintura es impresionante.
examples.translation: There’s no doubt Ana shows promise; her talent for painting is impressive.

examples.sentence: Cuando entrevistaron a Sofía, el entrenador dijo que apuntaba maneras para el equipo nacional.
examples.translation: When they interviewed Sofía, the coach said she showed potential for the national team.

definitions: To exhibit characteristics or behaviors that suggest an individual may develop into a skilled or notable practitioner.

examples.sentence: El joven escritor apunta maneras en sus primeros relatos, demostrando un estilo único.
examples.translation: The young writer shows signs of talent in his first stories, demonstrating a unique style.

examples.sentence: No solo apunta maneras en los estudios, sino que también tiene una actitud ejemplar.
