examples.sentence: Por lo general, las reuniones de trabajo empiezan puntualmente a las nueve de la mañana.
examples.translation: Meetings usually start promptly at nine in the morning.

definitions: Generally; as a rule; usually.

examples.sentence: Por lo general, no me gusta el café, pero esta mañana hice una excepción.
examples.translation: Generally, I don't like coffee, but this morning I made an exception.

examples.sentence: La tienda, por lo general, abre de lunes a sábado y cierra los domingos.
examples.translation: The store generally opens Monday through Saturday and closes on Sundays.

examples.sentence: Por lo general, las películas de ese director tienen un estilo muy particular.
examples.translation: Usually, that director's movies have a very particular style.

definitions: For the moment; for now; for the time being.

examples.sentence: Por lo pronto, vamos a esperar los resultados antes de tomar una decisión final.
examples.translation: For the moment, let's wait for the results before making a final decision.

examples.sentence: No puedo prometer nada, pero por lo pronto me comprometo a investigar el caso.
examples.translation: I can't promise anything, but for now I commit to investigating the case.

examples.sentence: Por lo pronto, el proyecto seguirá adelante hasta que recibamos nuevas instrucciones.
examples.translation: For now, the project will continue until we receive new instructions.

definitions: Provisionally or tentatively; until further notice or until circumstances change.

examples.sentence: Por lo pronto, el contrato es provisional y podrá cambiarse en el próximo trimestre.
examples.translation: Provisionally, the contract is temporary and can be changed next quarter.

examples.sentence: Por lo pronto, aceptamos la oferta aunque seguimos negociando algunos detalles.
examples.translation: Tentatively, we accept the offer although we are still negotiating some details.

examples.sentence: El acuerdo es válido por lo pronto, hasta que ambas partes confirmen los términos definitivos.
examples.translation: The agreement is valid provisionally, until both parties confirm the final terms.

definitions: As is apparent; as can be seen or observed.

examples.sentence: Por lo visto, la reunión se ha retrasado porque varios invitados no han llegado aún.
examples.translation: As is apparent, the meeting has been delayed because several guests haven't arrived yet.

examples.sentence: Los documentos, por lo visto, se extraviaron durante el traslado al archivo central.
examples.translation: The documents, apparently, got lost during the transfer to the central archive.

examples.sentence: Por lo visto, Marta no podrá venir a la fiesta porque tiene que trabajar hasta tarde.
examples.translation: It seems Marta won't be able to come to the party because she has to work late.

definitions: Apparently; it seems; used to indicate that something appears to be true based on available evidence or appearances.

examples.sentence: Por lo visto, el proyecto fue cancelado debido a la falta de presupuesto.
examples.translation: Apparently, the project was canceled due to lack of budget.

examples.sentence: No sé exactamente qué pasó, pero por lo visto hubo un problema técnico en el sistema.
examples.translation: I don't know exactly what happened, but apparently there was a technical problem in the system.

examples.sentence: Por lo visto, Ana ya terminó su trabajo y está esperando instrucciones para continuar.
examples.translation: It seems Ana has already finished her work and is waiting for instructions to continue.

definitions: On all four sides; around the entire perimeter of something.

examples.sentence: Colocaron vallas publicitarias por los cuatro costados del estadio para el evento.
examples.translation: They placed billboards on all four sides of the stadium for the event.

examples.sentence: La casa está rodeada por los cuatro costados por un hermoso jardín con flores y árboles.
examples.translation: The house is surrounded on all four sides by a beautiful garden with flowers and trees.

examples.sentence: El ejército estableció puestos de control por los cuatro costados para asegurar la zona.
examples.translation: The army set up checkpoints on all four sides to secure the area.

examples.sentence: Durante la excursión, caminamos rodeados por los cuatro costados de un paisaje montañoso impresionante.
examples.translation: During the hike, we walked surrounded on all four sides by an impressive mountainous landscape.

definitions: Completely; in every respect; thoroughly exhibiting a quality or characteristic.

examples.sentence: Ella es una profesional por los cuatro costados, siempre entregando calidad y compromiso.
examples.translation: She is a thorough professional, always delivering quality and commitment.

examples.sentence: Ese equipo mostró ser campeón por los cuatro costados, dominando cada partido sin excepción.
examples.translation: That team showed they were champions in every respect, dominating every match without exception.

examples.sentence: Su honestidad es evidente por los cuatro costados; nunca ha dado motivos para desconfiar.
examples.translation: His honesty is evident in every way; he has never given reasons to distrust.

definitions: From all directions; on every side, especially when describing being surrounded or attacked.

examples.sentence: Durante el asedio, el castillo fue atacado por los cuatro costados sin descanso.
examples.translation: During the siege, the castle was attacked from all directions without rest.

examples.sentence: Nos sentimos rodeados por los cuatro costados cuando llegaron los manifestantes a la plaza.
examples.translation: We felt surrounded from all sides when the protesters arrived at the plaza.

examples.sentence: Los soldados estaban bajo fuego por los cuatro costados y tuvieron que retroceder con cautela.
examples.translation: The soldiers were under fire on all sides and had to retreat cautiously.

definitions: Barely; by a very small margin; narrowly (used to describe an escape, success, or avoidance).

examples.sentence: Llegué al aeropuerto por los pelos y casi pierdo el vuelo.
examples.translation: I barely made it to the airport and almost missed the flight.

examples.sentence: El equipo ganó el partido por los pelos después de un penalti en el último minuto.
examples.translation: The team won the match by a narrow margin after a penalty in the last minute.

examples.sentence: Por los pelos logré entregar el informe antes de la fecha límite.
examples.translation: I barely managed to submit the report before the deadline.

definitions: Tenuous or far-fetched; weakly supported or contrived (used to judge an argument, explanation, or connection).

examples.sentence: Su explicación es por los pelos; no convence a nadie en la reunión.
examples.translation: His explanation is tenuous; it doesn't convince anyone in the meeting.

examples.sentence: Esa justificación está por los pelos, parece un intento de excusa más que una verdad.
examples.translation: That justification is far-fetched; it seems more like an excuse than a truth.

examples.sentence: El argumento que presentó para defender su postura es por los pelos y no tiene base sólida.
examples.translation: The argument he presented to defend his position is weakly supported and lacks a solid basis.

definitions: For ever and ever; for all ages, an emphatic expression of eternal duration commonly used in religious or formal contexts.
idiom: por los siglos de los siglos

examples.sentence: Prometo amarte por los siglos de los siglos, sin importar lo que pase.
examples.translation: I promise to love you forever and ever, no matter what happens.
examples.matched_span: por los siglos de los siglos

examples.sentence: El himno será recordado por los siglos de los siglos como símbolo nacional.
examples.translation: The anthem will be remembered for all ages as a national symbol.
examples.matched_span: por los siglos de los siglos

examples.sentence: Por los siglos de los siglos, las tradiciones de esta comunidad se mantendrán vivas.
examples.translation: For ever and ever, the traditions of this community will remain alive.
examples.matched_span: Por los siglos de los siglos

definitions: On the ground; lying on the floor or at ground level.

examples.sentence: Los niños estaban jugando por los suelos del parque, cubiertos de tierra y hojas.
examples.translation: The children were playing on the ground of the park, covered in dirt and leaves.

examples.sentence: Encontré el anillo perdido por los suelos del salón cuando limpiaba la casa.
examples.translation: I found the lost ring on the floor of the living room when I was cleaning the house.

examples.sentence: Las hojas caídas por los suelos del bosque creaban un hermoso tapiz otoñal.
examples.translation: The fallen leaves on the forest floor created a beautiful autumn carpet.

examples.sentence: Por los suelos de la cocina había restos de comida después de la fiesta.
examples.translation: On the kitchen floor, there were food scraps after the party.

definitions: Extremely low or degraded in quality, value, mood, reputation, or standing; deeply diminished or ruined.

examples.sentence: Las ventas de la empresa están por los suelos tras la crisis económica.
examples.translation: The company's sales are extremely low after the economic crisis.

examples.sentence: Su reputación quedó por los suelos después del escándalo en los medios.
examples.translation: His reputation was deeply diminished after the scandal in the media.

examples.sentence: Mi ánimo estuvo por los suelos cuando me cancelaron el viaje que tanto esperaba.
examples.translation: My mood was very low when the trip I was looking forward to was canceled.

definitions: Moreover; furthermore; used to introduce additional information or an explanatory remark.

examples.sentence: El candidato tiene experiencia en finanzas y, por más señas, también habla tres idiomas.
examples.translation: The candidate has experience in finance and, moreover, also speaks three languages.

examples.sentence: La película fue un éxito de taquilla y, por más señas, ganó varios premios internacionales.
examples.translation: The movie was a box office hit and, furthermore, won several international awards.

examples.sentence: Por más señas, el informe incluye un análisis detallado de los riesgos asociados.
examples.translation: Moreover, the report includes a detailed analysis of the associated risks.

definitions: For identification or clarification purposes; used to give further particulars or a more precise description of a person or thing.

examples.sentence: Juan Pérez, por más señas el gerente de ventas, estará presente en la reunión de mañana.
examples.translation: Juan Pérez, for identification, the sales manager, will be present at tomorrow's meeting.

examples.sentence: La casa está en la calle Mayor, por más señas, la segunda a la derecha después de la iglesia.
examples.translation: The house is on Mayor Street, specifically the second on the right after the church.

examples.sentence: El candidato, por más señas un ingeniero con diez años de experiencia, presentó su propuesta ayer.
examples.translation: The candidate, namely an engineer with ten years of experience, presented his proposal yesterday.

definitions: Literal: for almost nothing; at a very low price or cost.

examples.sentence: Compré estas camisetas por menos de nada en la rebaja de temporada.
examples.translation: I bought these t-shirts for almost nothing in the seasonal sale.

examples.sentence: La bicicleta se vendió por menos de nada porque estaba un poco dañada.
examples.translation: The bicycle sold for almost nothing because it was slightly damaged.

examples.sentence: Encontré un libro raro por menos de nada en el mercadillo del domingo.
examples.translation: I found a rare book for almost nothing at the Sunday market.

examples.sentence: Por menos de nada, conseguirás entradas para el concierto si buscas en línea con tiempo.
examples.translation: You can get tickets for the concert for almost nothing if you look online in time.

definitions: Figurative: because of the slightest thing; at the smallest provocation or for a trivial reason.

examples.sentence: Se enojó por menos de nada y empezó a discutir sin motivo alguno.
examples.translation: He got angry over the slightest thing and started arguing for no reason.

examples.sentence: Por menos de nada, Marta cambia de opinión cuando le conviene.
examples.translation: Marta changes her mind for a trivial reason when it suits her.

examples.sentence: No entiendo por qué peleamos por menos de nada; deberíamos resolverlo hablando tranquilamente.
examples.translation: I don't understand why we fight over trivial things; we should resolve it by talking calmly.

definitions: As for me; from my point of view or in my opinion.

examples.sentence: Por mi parte, creo que esta propuesta es la mejor opción para el proyecto.
examples.translation: As for me, I think this proposal is the best option for the project.

examples.sentence: Si me preguntas, por mi parte no veo inconvenientes en retrasar la entrega una semana.
examples.translation: If you ask me, from my point of view I see no problems in delaying the delivery by a week.

examples.sentence: Por mi parte, estoy dispuesto a colaborar en lo que sea necesario para que todo salga bien.
examples.translation: As for me, I am willing to collaborate in whatever is necessary for everything to go well.

definitions: On my behalf; as provided or given by me (e.g., an action, payment, or gesture coming from the speaker).

examples.sentence: Por mi parte, ya he pagado la parte correspondiente del alquiler este mes.
examples.translation: On my behalf, I have already paid my portion of the rent this month.

examples.sentence: La carta fue enviada por mi parte para confirmar la asistencia al evento.
examples.translation: The letter was sent on my behalf to confirm attendance at the event.

examples.sentence: Por mi parte, entregué toda la documentación requerida en la oficina de recursos humanos.
examples.translation: On my part, I submitted all the required documentation to the human resources office.

examples.sentence: Por mi parte, no hubo ninguna objeción a la propuesta durante la reunión.
examples.translation: On my part, there was no objection to the proposal during the meeting.

definitions: Used to admit fault or express a self-judgment about one's own action (equivalent to "it was ... of me" or "that was foolish of me").

examples.sentence: Por mi parte, fue un error no avisarte antes de tomar esa decisión.
examples.translation: It was foolish of me not to inform you before making that decision.

examples.sentence: Reconozco que por mi parte debí haber sido más cuidadoso con los detalles del contrato.
examples.translation: I admit that it was my fault for not being more careful with the contract details.

examples.sentence: Por mi parte, me arrepiento de no haber pedido ayuda cuando la necesitaba.
examples.translation: From my side, I regret not asking for help when I needed it.

definitions: An emphatic oath or vow meaning "I swear by my dead (ancestors)" used to assert the truth of a statement or the speaker's firm commitment.

examples.sentence: Por mis muertos, te juro que no tengo nada que ver con ese incidente.
examples.translation: I swear by my dead ancestors that I have nothing to do with that incident.

examples.sentence: Por mis muertos, te garantizo que esta vez cumpliremos con el plazo establecido.
examples.translation: I swear by my dead that this time we'll meet the established deadline.

examples.sentence: Por mis muertos, no permitiré que nadie más sufra las consecuencias de este error.
examples.translation: I swear by my dead that I won't allow anyone else to suffer the consequences of this mistake.

definitions: An emphatic threat or promise of violent retaliation used to stress determination or intent (e.g., "I swear I'll do X, no matter what").

examples.sentence: Si vuelves a mentirme, te juro por mis muertos que no quedará impune.
examples.translation: If you lie to me again, I swear I'll make sure you don't get away with it.

examples.sentence: Por mis muertos, haré todo lo posible para que pagues por lo que hiciste.
examples.translation: I swear I'll do everything possible to make you pay for what you did.

examples.sentence: No intentes engañarme otra vez, porque por mis muertos te arrepentirás.
examples.translation: Don't try to deceive me again, because I swear you'll regret it.

definitions: Occasionally; from time to time; at certain moments intermittently.

examples.sentence: Por momentos, la conversación se volvió tensa, pero luego todo volvió a la normalidad.
examples.translation: Occasionally, the conversation became tense, but then everything returned to normal.

examples.sentence: Por momentos, parecía que la tormenta iba a empeorar, pero finalmente pasó rápido.
examples.translation: At certain moments, it seemed the storm would worsen, but it finally passed quickly.

examples.sentence: Por momentos me siento inseguro, pero trato de mantener la confianza en mí mismo.
examples.translation: From time to time, I feel insecure, but I try to keep confidence in myself.

definitions: Progressively or increasingly with the passing of moments; by the minute (used to indicate a change that intensifies over time).

examples.sentence: El dolor aumentaba por momentos, hasta que finalmente decidí ir al médico.
examples.translation: The pain increased progressively until I finally decided to go to the doctor.

examples.sentence: La tensión en la sala crecía por momentos mientras esperábamos la noticia del juez.
examples.translation: The tension in the room grew by the minute as we waited for the judge's news.

examples.sentence: El tráfico empeoraba por momentos, lo que nos hizo llegar tarde a la reunión.
examples.translation: The traffic got worse by the minute, which made us arrive late to the meeting.

definitions: Concessive: no matter how; however much (commonly used with "que" followed by a clause, e.g., "por mucho que...").

examples.sentence: Por mucho que lo intentes, no podrás convencerme de cambiar de opinión.
examples.translation: No matter how much you try, you won't be able to convince me to change my mind.

examples.sentence: Por mucho que estudie, siempre encuentro algo nuevo que aprender en esta materia.
examples.translation: However much I study, I always find something new to learn in this subject.

examples.sentence: Por mucho que llueva, la ceremonia al aire libre no se cancelará.
examples.translation: No matter how much it rains, the outdoor ceremony will not be canceled.

definitions: Temporal: for a long time; for an extended period (typically appearing in phrases such as "por mucho tiempo").

examples.sentence: Vivió en aquella ciudad por mucho tiempo antes de mudarse a otra parte.
examples.translation: He lived in that city for a long time before moving elsewhere.

examples.sentence: Por mucho tiempo, el problema estuvo sin solución, hasta que finalmente se actuó.
examples.translation: For an extended period, the problem remained unresolved until action was finally taken.

examples.sentence: Trabajé en esa empresa por mucho tiempo y aprendí mucho durante esos años.
examples.translation: I worked at that company for a long time and learned a lot during those years.

examples.sentence: Por mucho tiempo, los científicos debatieron sobre esa teoría antes de aceptarla.
examples.translation: For a long time, scientists debated that theory before accepting it.

definitions: Literally, 'for not to speak of'; used to introduce something that has not been mentioned.

examples.sentence: Hablamos sobre la economía, por no hablar de la educación que también está en crisis.
examples.translation: We talked about the economy, not to mention education which is also in crisis.

examples.sentence: El informe cubre los problemas ambientales, por no hablar de los sociales que son igual de importantes.
examples.translation: The report covers environmental problems, not to speak of the social ones which are equally important.

examples.sentence: Por no hablar de los gastos adicionales que surgieron durante la construcción de la casa.
examples.translation: Not to mention the extra expenses that came up during the house's construction.

examples.sentence: En la reunión discutieron la falta de personal, por no hablar de la baja moral del equipo.
examples.translation: In the meeting, they discussed the staff shortage, not to mention the low morale of the team.

definitions: Used to add an often more significant item that has not been mentioned; 'not to mention' or 'let alone'.

examples.sentence: El hotel tiene una piscina increíble, por no hablar de su restaurante con estrella Michelin.
examples.translation: The hotel has an amazing pool, not to mention its Michelin-starred restaurant.

examples.sentence: Me encanta su voz, por no hablar de su talento para escribir canciones.
examples.translation: I love his voice, not to mention his talent for writing songs.

examples.sentence: El viaje fue agotador, por no hablar de que perdimos el equipaje en el aeropuerto.
examples.translation: The trip was exhausting, not to mention that we lost our luggage at the airport.

definitions: Literally, 'by the work of'; used to attribute an event or result to the action of a person or a divine agent.

examples.sentence: Por obra de Ana, el jardín fue transformado en un paraíso lleno de flores.
examples.translation: By the work of Ana, the garden was transformed into a paradise full of flowers.

examples.sentence: La estatua fue restaurada por obra de los expertos en conservación del museo.
examples.translation: The statue was restored by the work of the museum's conservation experts.

examples.sentence: Por obra de la tormenta, varias calles quedaron inundadas y sin electricidad.
examples.translation: By the work of the storm, several streets were flooded and without electricity.

examples.sentence: El milagro ocurrió por obra y gracia del santo patrón del pueblo.
examples.translation: The miracle happened by the work and grace of the town’s patron saint.

definitions: Indicates that something occurred by means of or through the agency or intervention of someone or something; 'as a result of' or 'by the hand of'.

examples.sentence: La empresa cerró el trato por obra de su nuevo director comercial, que es muy persuasivo.
examples.translation: The company closed the deal by the hand of its new sales director, who is very persuasive.

examples.sentence: Por obra de la tecnología moderna, ahora podemos comunicarnos instantáneamente con cualquier parte del mundo.
examples.translation: By means of modern technology, we can now communicate instantly with any part of the world.

examples.sentence: El éxito del proyecto fue por obra de un equipo comprometido y dedicado hasta el final.
examples.translation: The project's success was by virtue of a committed and dedicated team until the end.

definitions: Literally, 'by the work and grace of'; used to attribute an outcome to the work and grace of God or a divine power.

examples.sentence: Por obra y gracia de Dios, la familia sobrevivió al accidente sin heridas graves.
examples.translation: By the work and grace of God, the family survived the accident without serious injuries.

examples.sentence: El pueblo prosperó por obra y gracia de la bendición divina tras años de sequía.
examples.translation: The town prospered by the work and grace of divine blessing after years of drought.

examples.sentence: Por obra y gracia del destino, ambos se encontraron en aquel café por primera vez.
examples.translation: By the work and grace of destiny, they met for the first time in that café.

examples.sentence: La recuperación del enfermo fue posible por obra y gracia del tratamiento milagroso.
examples.translation: The patient's recovery was possible by the work and grace of the miraculous treatment.

definitions: Used to indicate that something happened thanks to or by virtue of the intervention, influence, or agency of a person or thing, often with emphasis or irony ('thanks to').

examples.sentence: Por obra y gracia de Marta, logramos terminar el proyecto a tiempo, a pesar de los obstáculos.
examples.translation: Thanks to Marta, we managed to finish the project on time despite the obstacles.

examples.sentence: El problema se solucionó por obra y gracia del nuevo software que instalamos ayer.
examples.translation: The problem was solved thanks to the new software we installed yesterday.

examples.sentence: Por obra y gracia del azar, encontré el libro que llevaba años buscando en una tienda pequeña.
examples.translation: By virtue of chance, I found the book I had been searching for years in a small store.

definitions: In parts; divided into portions or pieces.

examples.sentence: El pastel fue cortado por partes iguales para que todos pudieran probarlo.
examples.translation: The cake was cut into parts so that everyone could try it.

examples.sentence: Recibimos la herencia por partes durante varios años según lo establecido en el testamento.
examples.translation: We received the inheritance in parts over several years as established in the will.

examples.sentence: El manual explica el proceso por partes para facilitar la comprensión paso a paso.
examples.translation: The manual explains the process in parts to facilitate step-by-step understanding.

examples.sentence: Los documentos llegaron por partes y tuvimos que esperar para tener toda la información.
examples.translation: The documents arrived in parts and we had to wait to have all the information.

definitions: Used to request or indicate that matters should be addressed one at a time; 'let's take it step by step' or 'let's go in order'.

examples.sentence: Vamos a resolver el problema por partes para no confundirnos con tantos detalles a la vez.
examples.translation: Let's solve the problem step by step so we don't get confused with so many details at once.

examples.sentence: Por partes, primero te explico el contexto y luego analizamos las posibles soluciones.
examples.translation: In parts, first I'll explain the context and then we'll analyze possible solutions.

examples.sentence: No podemos abordar todo el proyecto a la vez; mejor ir por partes para asegurar la calidad.
examples.translation: We can't tackle the whole project at once; better to go step by step to ensure quality.

definitions: In equal shares; divided evenly among participants.

examples.sentence: Dividieron las ganancias por partes iguales entre los cuatro socios.
examples.translation: They divided the profits in equal shares among the four partners.

examples.sentence: El premio se entregó por partes, de modo que cada voluntario recibiera lo mismo.
examples.translation: The prize was given in shares so that each volunteer received the same.

examples.sentence: Para evitar conflictos, la herencia se repartió por partes entre los hermanos.
examples.translation: To avoid conflicts, the inheritance was shared equally among the siblings.

definitions: In installments; paid or delivered in separate parts over time.

examples.sentence: Pagué el coche por partes porque no podía cubrir el monto total de una sola vez.
examples.translation: I paid for the car in installments because I couldn’t cover the full amount at once.

examples.sentence: La suscripción se cobra por partes mensuales para facilitar el pago a los usuarios.
examples.translation: The subscription is charged in monthly installments to make payment easier for users.

examples.sentence: Decidió comprar la casa por partes, entregando una parte del dinero cada seis meses.
examples.translation: He decided to buy the house in installments, delivering part of the money every six months.

definitions: Literally, 'by feet'; used in measurements to mean 'per foot' or 'per foot/feet', including compound units (e.g., 'per square foot').

examples.sentence: El precio del terreno es de diez dólares por pies cuadrado.
examples.translation: The price of the land is ten dollars per square foot.

examples.sentence: Calculamos el costo por pies para determinar el presupuesto final de construcción.
examples.translation: We calculated the cost per foot to determine the final construction budget.

examples.sentence: La alfombra mide tres por cinco pies, así que necesitamos medir por pies para comprar la correcta.
examples.translation: The carpet measures three by five feet, so we need to measure by feet to buy the right one.

examples.sentence: El plano indica que cada habitación tiene veinte pies de largo por pies de ancho variable.
examples.translation: The plan indicates each room is twenty feet long by a variable width in feet.

definitions: Used in the phrase 'salir por pies' to mean to leave hurriedly or flee; to make a quick escape.

examples.sentence: Cuando vio a la policía, salió por pies antes de que lo atraparan.
examples.translation: When he saw the police, he fled quickly before they could catch him.

examples.sentence: Si escuchas un ruido extraño, mejor salir por pies y llamar a seguridad.
examples.translation: If you hear a strange noise, better to make a quick escape and call security.

examples.sentence: Los ladrones salieron por pies al notar la alarma activada.
examples.translation: The thieves made a quick getaway as soon as they noticed the alarm was triggered.

definitions: Literally, 'for power' or 'because of (one's) power or ability'; used to indicate cause or motive related to power or capability.

examples.sentence: Por poder de su cargo, el director tomó decisiones importantes para la empresa.
examples.translation: By virtue of his position, the director made important decisions for the company.

examples.sentence: Ella actuó por poder otorgado en el contrato para representar a la compañía legalmente.
examples.translation: She acted by power granted in the contract to legally represent the company.

examples.sentence: Por poder de su habilidad, logró completar el proyecto en tiempo récord.
examples.translation: Because of his ability, he managed to complete the project in record time.

examples.sentence: El general ordenó la movilización por poder militar otorgado por el gobierno.
examples.translation: The general ordered the mobilization by military power granted by the government.

definitions: To be able to; used after verbs of gratitude or celebration to indicate thankfulness for having the ability to do something (e.g., 'I toast for being able to...').

examples.sentence: Brindo por poder compartir momentos así con todos ustedes.
examples.translation: I toast to being able to share moments like this with all of you.

examples.sentence: Estamos agradecidos por poder contar con su apoyo incondicional en estos tiempos difíciles.
examples.translation: We are grateful to be able to count on your unconditional support in these difficult times.

examples.sentence: Cantó con emoción, brindando por poder expresar sus sentimientos a través de la música.
examples.translation: He sang emotionally, toasting to being able to express his feelings through music.

definitions: Would give anything to be able to; used to express strong desire or willingness to do anything in order to have the ability to do a particular action (e.g., 'I would give anything to be able to...').

examples.sentence: Por poder, daría cualquier cosa para viajar por el mundo sin preocupaciones.
examples.translation: I would give anything to be able to travel the world without worries.

examples.sentence: Ella luchó por poder alcanzar sus sueños a pesar de las dificultades.
examples.translation: She fought to be able to reach her dreams despite the difficulties.

examples.sentence: Por poder aprender ese idioma, estudiaría horas todos los días sin descanso.
examples.translation: To be able to learn that language, I would study hours every day without rest.

definitions: Literally, 'through doors' or 'by way of doors'; denotes physical passage via an entrance or exit.

examples.sentence: Entraron por puertas diferentes para evitar la congestión en la entrada principal.
examples.translation: They entered through different doors to avoid congestion at the main entrance.

examples.sentence: La mercancía salió por puertas traseras para no llamar la atención del público.
examples.translation: The merchandise went out through back doors to avoid public attention.

examples.sentence: Los invitados fueron recibidos por puertas laterales para agilizar el acceso al evento.
examples.translation: The guests were received through side doors to speed up access to the event.

examples.sentence: Por puertas del edificio se accede al estacionamiento subterráneo.
examples.translation: Through the building's doors one can access the underground parking lot.

definitions: By unofficial or secret channels; used figuratively to indicate actions carried out through backdoor methods or informal routes rather than by official procedures.

examples.sentence: Consiguieron el contrato por puertas, sin pasar por licitaciones oficiales.
examples.translation: They got the contract through backdoor channels, without going through official bidding.

examples.sentence: La información llegó por puertas y no a través de los canales habituales de la empresa.
examples.translation: The information came through unofficial channels and not through the company’s usual routes.

examples.sentence: Por puertas lograron influir en la decisión sin que nadie lo notara públicamente.
examples.translation: By backdoor means, they managed to influence the decision without anyone noticing publicly.

definitions: For reference; as a point of information or consultation rather than as definitive or binding information (equivalent to 'for reference only').

examples.sentence: Te envío el documento por referencia para que puedas consultarlo cuando quieras.
examples.translation: I am sending you the document for reference so you can consult it whenever you want.

examples.sentence: Este manual es por referencia y no debe usarse como guía definitiva para el proyecto.
examples.translation: This manual is for reference only and should not be used as a definitive guide for the project.

examples.sentence: Guardé los datos por referencia en caso de que necesitemos verificar algo más adelante.
examples.translation: I kept the data for reference in case we need to verify something later.

definitions: By referral or on the recommendation of someone; used when a person or service is engaged because another party recommended or referred them.

examples.sentence: Contrataron al abogado por referencia de un colega que ya había trabajado con él.
examples.translation: They hired the lawyer on the recommendation of a colleague who had worked with him before.

examples.sentence: Llegó al restaurante por referencia de amigos que lo recomendaban mucho.
examples.translation: He came to the restaurant by referral from friends who highly recommended it.

examples.sentence: La empresa seleccionó al consultor por referencia de su red profesional de confianza.
examples.translation: The company selected the consultant by referral from their trusted professional network.

definitions: Separately; individually; apart from others; indicating that items, actions, or people are to be treated or handled one by one or apart from a group.

examples.sentence: Los estudiantes entregaron sus trabajos por separado para evitar confusiones en la corrección.
examples.translation: The students submitted their assignments separately to avoid confusion in grading.

examples.sentence: Por separado, cada departamento presentó su informe anual durante la reunión general.
examples.translation: Separately, each department presented its annual report during the general meeting.

examples.sentence: Las piezas se almacenan por separado para facilitar el ensamblaje final del producto.
examples.translation: The parts are stored separately to facilitate the final assembly of the product.

examples.sentence: Por separado, los candidatos fueron entrevistados para evaluar sus habilidades individuales.
examples.translation: Separately, the candidates were interviewed to assess their individual skills.

definitions: Acting independently of allies or partners; used in political or diplomatic contexts to denote an action taken alone (e.g., 'to sign a separate peace').

examples.sentence: El país decidió firmar el tratado por separado, sin consultar a sus aliados.
examples.translation: The country decided to sign the treaty separately, without consulting its allies.

examples.sentence: Por separado, cada empresa negoció sus propios términos sin coordinarse con el grupo.
examples.translation: Separately, each company negotiated its own terms without coordinating with the group.

examples.sentence: El líder actuó por separado para proteger los intereses de su facción dentro del partido.
examples.translation: The leader acted independently to protect the interests of his faction within the party.

definitions: Literally, 'because of the flies'; a literal reference to flies or to protecting against them (rare in idiomatic use).

examples.sentence: Colocamos mosquiteros en las ventanas por si las moscas entraban durante la noche.
examples.translation: We placed mosquito nets on the windows in case flies came in during the night.

examples.sentence: Limpiaron la cocina por si las moscas, para evitar cualquier contaminación de los alimentos.
examples.translation: They cleaned the kitchen just in case, to avoid any contamination of the food.

examples.sentence: Guardamos la comida en recipientes herméticos por si las moscas, para que no se estropeara.
examples.translation: We stored the food in airtight containers just in case, so it wouldn’t spoil.

examples.sentence: Por si las moscas, cerraron bien las puertas para que ningún insecto entrara durante la fiesta.
examples.translation: Just in case, they closed the doors well so no insects would enter during the party.

definitions: Just in case; as a precautionary measure; used to indicate that something is done to guard against an unlikely but possible event.

examples.sentence: Llevé un paraguas por si las moscas, porque el pronóstico dice que podría llover.
examples.translation: I took an umbrella just in case, because the forecast says it might rain.

examples.sentence: Por si las moscas, guardé una copia de seguridad de todos los archivos importantes.
examples.translation: Just in case, I backed up all the important files.

examples.sentence: Me desperté temprano por si las moscas y así no perder el autobús a tiempo.
examples.translation: I woke up early just in case so I wouldn’t miss the bus.

definitions: As a matter of routine or practice; systematically; habitually, often implying consistency or an automatic behavior.

examples.sentence: Ella revisa los correos por sistema para no dejar ninguno sin respuesta.
examples.translation: She checks emails as a matter of routine so as not to leave any unanswered.

examples.sentence: Por sistema, el equipo realiza una reunión semanal para coordinar las tareas pendientes.
examples.translation: As a routine, the team holds a weekly meeting to coordinate pending tasks.

examples.sentence: Él contesta los mensajes por sistema, sin importar la hora del día o la cantidad recibida.
examples.translation: He replies to messages systematically, regardless of the time of day or the amount received.

definitions: System by system; literally indicating that something is done for or examined each system in turn.

examples.sentence: El técnico revisó por sistema cada componente para detectar fallas posibles.
examples.translation: The technician examined each system to detect possible faults.

examples.sentence: Por sistema, el mantenimiento se realiza en todas las áreas para asegurar el correcto funcionamiento.
examples.translation: System by system, maintenance is carried out in all areas to ensure proper functioning.

examples.sentence: Inspeccionaron por sistema los equipos eléctricos antes de la inauguración de la fábrica.
examples.translation: They inspected the electrical equipment system by system before the factory opening.

examples.sentence: Por sistema, se actualizan los programas para mantener la seguridad informática al día.
examples.translation: System by system, the programs are updated to keep the IT security up to date.

definitions: By the person himself/herself; personally, indicating that an action was performed by the individual rather than by a representative.

examples.sentence: El director visitó la obra por su persona para supervisar los avances personalmente.
examples.translation: The director visited the site himself to personally supervise the progress.

examples.sentence: Por su persona, el embajador entregó la invitación oficial al presidente.
examples.translation: The ambassador himself delivered the official invitation to the president.

examples.sentence: Ella se presentó por su persona a la entrevista, demostrando compromiso y profesionalismo.
examples.translation: She appeared in person to the interview, showing commitment and professionalism.

examples.sentence: El autor firmó los libros por su persona durante la feria literaria el fin de semana pasado.
examples.translation: The author signed the books personally during the literary fair last weekend.

definitions: With regard to the individual's person or character; as a person (often contrasted with regard for possessions, money, or status).

examples.sentence: Por su persona, Carlos siempre ha sido un hombre honesto y respetado en la comunidad.
examples.translation: As a person, Carlos has always been an honest and respected man in the community.

examples.sentence: No me interesa el dinero, sino que me valoren por su persona y no por lo que tengo.
examples.translation: I’m not interested in money, but in being valued as a person and not for what I have.

examples.sentence: Por su persona, Ana es conocida por su generosidad y su dedicación al trabajo social.
examples.translation: As a person, Ana is known for her generosity and dedication to social work.

definitions: Everywhere; in all places; throughout a wide area.

examples.sentence: Los carteles de la campaña aparecieron por todas partes en la ciudad durante la semana pasada.
examples.translation: The campaign posters appeared everywhere in the city during last week.

examples.sentence: Buscamos a nuestro perro perdido por todas partes sin éxito hasta que alguien lo encontró.
examples.translation: We searched for our lost dog everywhere without success until someone found him.

examples.sentence: Las flores del jardín crecieron por todas partes gracias a la lluvia constante de la primavera.
examples.translation: The garden flowers grew everywhere thanks to the constant spring rain.

definitions: Ubiquitously; widely present or distributed, used to indicate pervasive presence in many contexts or locations.

examples.sentence: Las redes sociales están presentes por todas partes en nuestra vida cotidiana.
examples.translation: Social media is ubiquitously present in our daily lives.

examples.sentence: Los anuncios publicitarios aparecen por todas partes, desde las calles hasta las aplicaciones móviles.
examples.translation: Advertisements appear everywhere, from the streets to mobile apps.

examples.sentence: La influencia de la cultura pop se siente por todas partes, incluso en los países más remotos.
examples.translation: The influence of pop culture is felt everywhere, even in the most remote countries.

definitions: In a grand, lavish, or extravagant manner; with great pomp or celebration.

examples.sentence: Celebraron su aniversario de bodas por todo lo alto con una gran fiesta en el castillo.
examples.translation: They celebrated their wedding anniversary in grand style with a big party at the castle.

examples.sentence: Mañana vamos a inaugurar la exposición por todo lo alto, con invitados famosos y un banquete especial.
examples.translation: Tomorrow we will inaugurate the exhibition lavishly, with famous guests and a special banquet.

examples.sentence: No suelen celebrar cumpleaños, pero este año lo hicieron por todo lo alto para sorprender a Marta.
examples.translation: They don't usually celebrate birthdays, but this year they did it in a grand way to surprise Marta.

definitions: At the highest level or to the greatest extent; used to emphasize intensity, rank, or thoroughness.

examples.sentence: El equipo ganó por todo lo alto, demostrando ser el mejor de la temporada.
examples.translation: The team won by the highest margin, proving to be the best of the season.

examples.sentence: Si quieres tener éxito en este negocio, tienes que apostar por todo lo alto y no conformarte con menos.
examples.translation: If you want to succeed in this business, you have to bet at the highest level and not settle for less.

examples.sentence: Ella siempre trabaja por todo lo alto, dedicando esfuerzo y atención a cada detalle del proyecto.
examples.translation: She always works to the greatest extent, dedicating effort and attention to every detail of the project.

definitions: Everywhere; on all sides; in every direction or throughout a place.

examples.sentence: Los globos de colores flotaban por todos lados durante la fiesta del barrio.
examples.translation: The colorful balloons floated everywhere during the neighborhood party.

examples.sentence: Miré por todos lados, pero no pude encontrar mi cartera en la casa.
examples.translation: I looked everywhere, but I couldn't find my wallet in the house.

examples.sentence: Las palomas se posaron por todos lados en la plaza, creando un ambiente muy animado.
examples.translation: The pigeons perched all over the square, creating a very lively atmosphere.

definitions: All over the place; widely present or distributed, often used to indicate pervasiveness across contexts or aspects.

examples.sentence: La influencia de esa moda se ve por todos lados, desde la ropa hasta la música que escuchamos.
examples.translation: The influence of that fashion is seen all over the place, from clothing to the music we listen to.

examples.sentence: Las noticias sobre la crisis económica están por todos lados, en la televisión y en las redes sociales.
examples.translation: News about the economic crisis is everywhere, on television and social media.

examples.sentence: Los prejuicios siguen presentes por todos lados, aunque intentemos avanzar hacia una sociedad más justa.
examples.translation: Prejudices are still widely present all over the place, even though we try to move toward a fairer society.

definitions: Literally, by a hair; indicating a very small physical distance or amount.

examples.sentence: El cirujano separó por un pelo los vasos sanguíneos durante la operación delicada.
examples.translation: The surgeon separated the blood vessels by a hair during the delicate operation.

examples.sentence: La pelota pasó por un pelo la línea de gol, pero el árbitro no la vio.
examples.translation: The ball passed by a hair over the goal line, but the referee didn't see it.

examples.sentence: El gato saltó por un pelo y casi cae del techo, fue un susto enorme.
examples.translation: The cat jumped by a hair and almost fell off the roof; it was a huge scare.

examples.sentence: Por un pelo no derramé el café cuando me tropecé con la mesa esta mañana.
examples.translation: By a hair, I didn't spill the coffee when I bumped into the table this morning.

definitions: Figuratively, narrowly; just barely (used to indicate a very small margin in escaping danger, avoiding harm, or being saved).

examples.sentence: Ganó la carrera por un pelo; el segundo lugar llegó apenas un segundo después.
examples.translation: He won the race by a hair; second place arrived just one second later.

examples.sentence: Por un pelo evitamos el accidente de tráfico gracias a la rápida reacción del conductor.
examples.translation: We narrowly avoided the traffic accident thanks to the driver's quick reaction.

examples.sentence: Ella aprobó el examen por un pelo, pero está contenta de haberlo conseguido al final.
examples.translation: She barely passed the exam, but she's happy to have made it in the end.

definitions: Figuratively, by an extremely small margin (used of competitions, races, decisions, or results, equivalent to 'won/lost by a hair').

examples.sentence: El equipo perdió el campeonato por un pelo en el último minuto del partido.
examples.translation: The team lost the championship by a hair in the last minute of the match.

examples.sentence: La decisión se tomó por un pelo; el juez estuvo indeciso hasta el final.
examples.translation: The decision was made by a hair; the judge was indecisive until the end.

examples.sentence: Por un pelo no gané el concurso de canto, pero me sentí orgulloso de mi actuación.
examples.translation: I narrowly didn't win the singing contest, but I felt proud of my performance.

definitions: Figuratively, on account of a trivial matter; over something insignificant or petty.

examples.sentence: No quiero discutir por un quítame allá que no tiene importancia en la relación.
examples.translation: I don't want to argue over a trivial matter that doesn't matter in the relationship.

examples.sentence: Siempre se pelean por un quítame allá, como si esas cosas fueran tan graves.
examples.translation: They always fight over trivial things, as if those things were so serious.

examples.sentence: No vale la pena enojarse por un quítame allá cuando hay problemas más importantes.
examples.translation: It's not worth getting angry over a petty issue when there are more important problems.

definitions: Figuratively, indicating a brief, improvised scramble or hasty, makeshift action (often part of the fuller phrase implying a quick shove or scramble for position).

examples.sentence: En la reunión hubo un quítame allá para conseguir los mejores asientos antes de empezar.
examples.translation: At the meeting there was a quick scramble to get the best seats before starting.

examples.sentence: Durante el concierto, se formó un quítame allá para entrar al área VIP.
examples.translation: During the concert, there was a hasty scramble to get into the VIP area.

examples.sentence: Cuando abrieron las puertas, todos hicieron un quítame allá para no quedarse fuera del cine.
examples.translation: When they opened the doors, everyone made a quick scramble not to be left outside the cinema.

definitions: Literally, through a tube; by means of a tube or pipe.

examples.sentence: El agua fluye por un tubo desde el depósito hasta el jardín para regar las plantas.
examples.translation: The water flows through a tube from the tank to the garden to water the plants.

examples.sentence: La leche se transporta por un tubo hasta las máquinas en la fábrica para su procesamiento.
examples.translation: The milk is transported through a tube to the machines in the factory for processing.

examples.sentence: Los cables eléctricos pasan por un tubo que protege la instalación en la pared.
examples.translation: The electrical cables go through a tube that protects the installation in the wall.

examples.sentence: La aspiradora succiona el polvo por un tubo largo que llega hasta el rincón del sofá.
examples.translation: The vacuum cleaner sucks up dust through a long tube that reaches the corner of the sofa.

definitions: Figuratively, in great quantity or profusely; a lot, abundantly.

examples.sentence: En esa temporada, ganamos dinero por un tubo gracias a las ventas de verano.
examples.translation: That season, we earned money in abundance thanks to summer sales.

examples.sentence: La gente estaba comprando helados por un tubo durante el día más caluroso del año.
examples.translation: People were buying ice cream by the bucketful during the hottest day of the year.

examples.sentence: Después del concierto, los fanáticos tomaron fotos por un tubo con sus teléfonos móviles.
examples.translation: After the concert, the fans took tons of photos with their mobile phones.

definitions: For one time only; on this single occasion.

examples.sentence: Por una vez, decidí llegar temprano a la oficina y me sorprendió lo tranquilo que estaba todo.
examples.translation: For one time only, I decided to arrive early at the office and was surprised at how quiet everything was.

examples.sentence: Solo por una vez, aceptó quedarse a cenar con nosotros y disfrutó mucho la compañía.
examples.translation: Only for once, he agreed to stay for dinner with us and really enjoyed the company.

examples.sentence: El profesor permitió que los estudiantes usaran calculadora por una vez durante el examen.
examples.translation: The teacher allowed the students to use calculators for one time only during the exam.

examples.sentence: Por una vez, María se tomó un descanso y salió a caminar para despejar la mente.
examples.translation: For one time only, María took a break and went out for a walk to clear her mind.

definitions: Used emphatically to mean 'for once' or 'at long last,' often to contrast this occasion with what usually happens.

examples.sentence: Por una vez, decidí no preocuparme por el trabajo y disfrutar el día libre.
examples.translation: For once, I decided not to worry about work and enjoy the day off.

examples.sentence: Por una vez, escuchó el consejo de su amigo y eso cambió su perspectiva.
examples.translation: For once, he listened to his friend's advice and that changed his perspective.

examples.sentence: Vamos a hacer la excepción por una vez y aceptar la propuesta tal como está.
examples.translation: Let's make the exception for once and accept the proposal as it is.

definitions: Perhaps; possibly (used to express uncertainty or conjecture).

examples.sentence: Por ventura, el paquete llegó antes de lo esperado y pudimos usarlo para la presentación.
examples.translation: Perhaps the package arrived earlier than expected and we could use it for the presentation.

examples.sentence: No sé si por ventura alguien más vendrá a la reunión esta tarde, pero espero que sí.
examples.translation: I don't know if possibly someone else will come to the meeting this afternoon, but I hope so.

examples.sentence: Por ventura, la tormenta no afectará el evento al aire libre que organizamos.
examples.translation: Possibly, the storm won't affect the outdoor event we organized.

definitions: If by chance; used in conditional or hypothetical contexts to indicate an event happening unexpectedly or incidentally.

examples.sentence: Por ventura, si llegas temprano, podremos tomar un café antes de la clase.
examples.translation: If by chance you arrive early, we can have a coffee before class.

examples.sentence: Por ventura que haya un cambio de planes, avísame para organizarme mejor.
examples.translation: If by chance there's a change of plans, let me know so I can organize better.

examples.sentence: Por ventura que necesites ayuda con el proyecto, no dudes en pedírmela.
examples.translation: If by chance you need help with the project, don't hesitate to ask me.

definitions: Literal justification meaning 'because today is the current day', used to state the obvious or to reference the present day as the reason for something.

examples.sentence: Porque hoy es hoy, tenemos que aprovechar la oportunidad antes de que sea tarde.
examples.translation: Because today is today, we have to take advantage of the opportunity before it's too late.

examples.sentence: No puedo posponerlo más, porque hoy es hoy y la fecha límite está cerca.
examples.translation: I can't postpone it any longer because today is today and the deadline is near.

examples.sentence: Porque hoy es hoy, es importante que tomemos una decisión definitiva sobre el proyecto.
examples.translation: Because today is today, it is important that we make a definitive decision about the project.

examples.sentence: No hay excusas para no empezar ahora, porque hoy es hoy y el tiempo no espera.
examples.translation: There are no excuses not to start now, because today is today and time doesn't wait.

definitions: Figurative expression used to justify acting spontaneously, celebrating, or making an exception because the present moment is special or decisive ('today is the day').

examples.sentence: Vamos a celebrar el cumpleaños de Ana por todo lo alto, porque hoy es hoy y hay que disfrutar.
examples.translation: Let's celebrate Ana's birthday in grand style, because today is the day and we must enjoy.

examples.sentence: Porque hoy es hoy, decidí darme un gusto y comprar ese libro que tanto quería.
examples.translation: Because today is the day, I decided to treat myself and buy that book I wanted so much.

examples.sentence: No voy a posponer más el viaje, porque hoy es hoy y es momento de cumplir mis sueños.
examples.translation: I'm not going to postpone the trip anymore, because today is the day and it's time to fulfill my dreams.

definitions: Figurative meaning 'to lead by example', i.e., to demonstrate the behavior, values, or standards one advocates through one’s own actions rather than merely by words.

examples.sentence: El entrenador siempre predica con el ejemplo para motivar a sus jugadores a esforzarse.
examples.translation: The coach always leads by example to motivate his players to make an effort.

examples.sentence: Si quieres que tus empleados sean puntuales, debes predicar con el ejemplo y llegar a tiempo tú primero.
examples.translation: If you want your employees to be punctual, you must lead by example and arrive on time yourself first.

examples.sentence: Los padres predican con el ejemplo cuando muestran respeto y honestidad en su vida diaria.
examples.translation: Parents lead by example when they show respect and honesty in their daily lives.

definitions: Literal sense 'to preach by means of giving examples', referring to supporting a verbal exhortation with concrete instances or actions.

examples.sentence: En su discurso, el profesor predicó con el ejemplo mostrando casos reales de éxito.
examples.translation: In his speech, the teacher preached by means of giving examples showing real cases of success.

examples.sentence: Para explicar el concepto, la maestra predicó con el ejemplo usando ejercicios prácticos en clase.
examples.translation: To explain the concept, the teacher preached by giving examples using practical exercises in class.

examples.sentence: El líder religioso predicaba con el ejemplo, compartiendo historias personales para ilustrar su mensaje.
examples.translation: The religious leader preached by means of giving examples, sharing personal stories to illustrate his message.

examples.sentence: Durante la conferencia, se predicó con el ejemplo mostrando cómo aplicar las teorías en la vida real.
examples.translation: During the conference, they preached by giving examples showing how to apply theories in real life.

definitions: Figurative expression meaning 'to speak or give advice to an audience that does not listen or heed', equivalent to 'preaching to the void' or 'preaching to deaf ears'.

examples.sentence: Siento que estoy predicando en el desierto cuando intento explicar la importancia del reciclaje en esta comunidad.
examples.translation: I feel like I'm preaching to deaf ears when I try to explain the importance of recycling in this community.

examples.sentence: Cada vez que propongo mejoras en el trabajo, parece que predico en el desierto porque nadie escucha.
examples.translation: Every time I propose improvements at work, it feels like preaching to the void because no one listens.

examples.sentence: Es frustrante predicar en el desierto cuando los jóvenes no quieren seguir consejos para su futuro.
examples.translation: It's frustrating to preach to deaf ears when young people don't want to follow advice for their future.

definitions: Literal meaning 'to preach in the desert', referring to delivering a sermon or message in an actual uninhabited place.

examples.sentence: El misionero predicó en el desierto durante semanas, sin que nadie se acercara a escucharlo.
examples.translation: The missionary preached in the desert for weeks, with no one coming close to listen.

examples.sentence: Durante su viaje, el sacerdote predicó en el desierto bajo el sol intenso, alejados de cualquier pueblo.
examples.translation: During his journey, the priest preached in the desert under the intense sun, far from any town.

examples.sentence: La ceremonia comenzó cuando el pastor predicaba en el desierto rodeado solo de arena y rocas.
examples.translation: The ceremony began when the pastor preached in the desert surrounded only by sand and rocks.

examples.sentence: En la película, el protagonista predica en el desierto para motivar a su gente a seguir adelante.
examples.translation: In the movie, the protagonist preaches in the desert to motivate his people to move forward.

definitions: To pay attention; to focus one’s listening or observation on something or someone.

examples.sentence: Por favor, presta atención a las instrucciones antes de comenzar el experimento en el laboratorio.
examples.translation: Please pay attention to the instructions before starting the experiment in the laboratory.

examples.sentence: No estaba prestando atención durante la clase y ahora no entiendo el tema para el examen.
examples.translation: I wasn't paying attention during class and now I don't understand the topic for the exam.

examples.sentence: Cuando hablo contigo, espero que prestes atención para poder explicarte bien el problema.
examples.translation: When I talk to you, I expect you to pay attention so I can explain the problem well.

definitions: To give consideration or heed to an issue, matter, or request; to take something into account.

examples.sentence: Debemos prestar atención a las quejas de los clientes para mejorar nuestro servicio.
examples.translation: We must pay attention to customers' complaints to improve our service.

examples.sentence: El gerente prestó atención a las sugerencias del equipo y realizó los cambios necesarios.
examples.translation: The manager gave consideration to the team's suggestions and made the necessary changes.

examples.sentence: Si prestamos atención a los detalles, evitaremos errores en el proyecto final.
examples.translation: If we pay attention to the details, we will avoid mistakes in the final project.

definitions: A grammatical term for the compound past tense formed with the auxiliary verb haber and a past participle, used to express actions completed within a time frame that includes the present or actions with present relevance.

examples.sentence: He terminado el informe y he usado el pretérito perfecto compuesto para describir las acciones recientes.
examples.translation: I have finished the report and have used the present perfect tense to describe recent actions.

examples.sentence: ¿Has estudiado cómo se forma el pretérito perfecto compuesto en español?
examples.translation: Have you studied how the present perfect tense is formed in Spanish?

examples.sentence: Ella siempre ha preferido el pretérito perfecto compuesto para hablar de eventos que afectan al presente.
examples.translation: She has always preferred the present perfect tense to talk about events that affect the present.

examples.sentence: En la clase de hoy, vamos a practicar el uso del pretérito perfecto compuesto con varios ejemplos.
examples.translation: In today's class, we are going to practice using the present perfect tense with various examples.

definitions: The principal bullfighter of a bullfighting company; the lead matador who performs the most important role in a bullfight.

examples.sentence: Manuel fue el primero espada en la corrida de anoche y recibió una gran ovación.
examples.translation: Manuel was the lead matador in last night's bullfight and received a big ovation.

examples.sentence: El primero espada de la cuadrilla debe tener mucha experiencia y valor para enfrentar al toro.
examples.translation: The lead bullfighter of the company must have a lot of experience and courage to face the bull.

examples.sentence: Ayer, el primero espada sufrió una herida leve durante la faena, pero continuó luchando.
examples.translation: Yesterday, the principal bullfighter suffered a minor injury during the performance but kept fighting.

examples.sentence: La plaza estaba llena cuando salió el primero espada para comenzar la corrida.
examples.translation: The arena was full when the lead matador came out to start the bullfight.

definitions: A leading or foremost person in a group or field; the main performer or champion in a given context.

examples.sentence: Carlos es el primero espada del equipo; siempre lidera en los momentos más difíciles.
examples.translation: Carlos is the leading figure of the team; he always leads in the toughest moments.

examples.sentence: Si quieres ganar el torneo, tienes que ser primero espada y darlo todo en la cancha.
examples.translation: If you want to win the tournament, you have to be the top player and give your all on the field.

examples.sentence: Ella se ha convertido en la primero espada de la compañía gracias a su talento y dedicación.
examples.translation: She has become the foremost person in the company thanks to her talent and dedication.

definitions: A fictional, idealized prince character from fairy tales, typically depicted as a rescuer or romantic hero.

examples.sentence: En los cuentos de hadas, el príncipe azul siempre rescata a la princesa en apuros.
examples.translation: In fairy tales, the prince charming always rescues the princess in distress.

examples.sentence: Mi sobrino dibujó un príncipe azul con capa y corona para su proyecto escolar.
examples.translation: My nephew drew a prince charming with a cape and crown for his school project.

examples.sentence: Durante la obra, el príncipe azul aparece justo cuando la reina está en peligro.
examples.translation: During the play, the prince charming appears just when the queen is in danger.

examples.sentence: El libro describe al príncipe azul como un héroe idealizado que simboliza la esperanza.
examples.translation: The book describes the prince charming as an idealized hero who symbolizes hope.

definitions: An ideal or perfect romantic partner; a 'prince charming' whom someone fantasizes will arrive and solve their romantic problems.

examples.sentence: María aún espera que llegue su príncipe azul y cambie su vida para siempre.
examples.translation: María still waits for her prince charming to arrive and change her life forever.

examples.sentence: No creas que él es el príncipe azul que salvará todos tus problemas amorosos.
examples.translation: Don't think he is the prince charming who will solve all your romantic problems.

examples.sentence: A veces, la gente idealiza tanto a su príncipe azul que se decepciona fácilmente.
examples.translation: Sometimes, people idealize their prince charming so much that they get disappointed easily.

definitions: To smear or stain someone or something with grease, oil, or another sticky substance (literal).

examples.sentence: Mientras cocinaba, accidentalmente pringó la camisa con aceite de oliva.
examples.translation: While cooking, he accidentally smeared his shirt with olive oil.

examples.sentence: No uses ese trapo; está todo pringado de grasa y no limpia nada.
examples.translation: Don't use that rag; it's all smeared with grease and doesn't clean anything.

examples.sentence: El mecánico pringó sus manos con aceite al arreglar el motor del coche.
examples.translation: The mechanic smeared his hands with oil while fixing the car engine.

examples.sentence: Después de trabajar en la barbacoa, mis dedos quedaron pringados de salsa.
examples.translation: After working at the barbecue, my fingers were smeared with sauce.

definitions: To cause someone to suffer inconvenience, trouble, blame, or loss; to set someone up or leave them to deal with the negative consequences (figurative).

examples.sentence: No quiero pringarla con este problema, mejor que se lo explique él a la jefa.
examples.translation: I don't want to get her into trouble with this problem; it's better if he explains it to the boss.

examples.sentence: Si seguimos así, vas a pringarla cuando lleguen las consecuencias.
examples.translation: If we continue like this, you're going to get into trouble when the consequences come.

examples.sentence: Me pringaron para que cargara con la culpa de algo que no hice.
examples.translation: They set me up to take the blame for something I didn't do.

definitions: To take a bite or taste a small amount of food (literal).

examples.sentence: Antes de decidir, probé bocado de cada plato para saber cuál me gustaba más.
examples.translation: Before deciding, I took a bite of each dish to know which one I liked best.

examples.sentence: ¿Quieres probar bocado de este postre? Está delicioso.
examples.translation: Do you want to try a bite of this dessert? It's delicious.

examples.sentence: Durante la cena, ella solo probó bocado porque no tenía mucho apetito.
examples.translation: During dinner, she only took a bite because she didn't have much appetite.

examples.sentence: Nos sentamos a la mesa y probamos bocado mientras charlábamos animadamente.
examples.translation: We sat at the table and took a bite while chatting lively.

definitions: To eat anything at all, often used to indicate inability or refusal to eat because of emotion, illness, or nervousness (figurative).

examples.sentence: Después de la mala noticia, no pude probar bocado en todo el día.
examples.translation: After the bad news, I couldn't eat anything all day.

examples.sentence: Ella estaba tan nerviosa por el examen que no probó bocado esa mañana.
examples.translation: She was so nervous about the exam that she didn't eat a thing that morning.

examples.sentence: Cuando alguien está triste, a veces no quiere probar bocado y prefiere quedarse solo.
examples.translation: When someone is sad, sometimes they don't want to eat anything and prefer to be alone.

definitions: To try using a particular hand or to test the use or condition of a hand (literal).

examples.sentence: El paciente tuvo que probar la mano izquierda para evaluar su movilidad.
examples.translation: The patient had to test the use of his left hand to assess mobility.

examples.sentence: ¿Podrías probar la mano derecha antes de firmar el documento para asegurarte de que no duela?
examples.translation: Could you try using your right hand before signing the document to make sure it doesn't hurt?

examples.sentence: Durante la rehabilitación, probamos la mano varias veces para comprobar la recuperación.
examples.translation: During rehabilitation, we tested the hand several times to check the recovery.

examples.sentence: El médico pidió al niño que probara la mano para ver si sentía algún dolor.
examples.translation: The doctor asked the child to test his hand to see if he felt any pain.

definitions: To test a particular approach, method, or degree of severity (for example, to try out firmness or strict measures) to see its effects (figurative).

examples.sentence: El director decidió probar la mano dura con los empleados para mejorar la productividad.
examples.translation: The director decided to try a strict approach with the employees to improve productivity.

examples.sentence: ¿Crees que deberíamos probar la mano blanda esta vez y luego ser más estrictos?
examples.translation: Do you think we should try a lenient approach this time and then be stricter?

examples.sentence: Para probar la mano del nuevo jefe, esperaron a ver cómo reaccionaba ante un conflicto.
examples.translation: To test the new boss’s approach, they waited to see how he reacted to a conflict.
examples.matched_span: probar la mano del nuevo jefe

definitions: Literal: to test weapons, especially by firing or otherwise operating them to verify their function or performance.

examples.sentence: Antes del desfile, los soldados probaron las armas para asegurarse de que funcionaban bien.
examples.translation: Before the parade, the soldiers tested the weapons to make sure they worked well.

examples.sentence: El técnico pasó horas probando las armas nuevas en el campo de tiro.
examples.translation: The technician spent hours testing the new weapons at the shooting range.

examples.sentence: Durante el entrenamiento, siempre probamos las armas para garantizar la seguridad.
examples.translation: During training, we always test the weapons to guarantee safety.

examples.sentence: Los ingenieros probaron las armas antes de entregarlas al ejército.
examples.translation: The engineers tested the weapons before delivering them to the army.

definitions: Figurative: to carry out a preliminary use of force or a show of arms—e.g., to fire upon or threaten someone or something to gauge effect, capability, or reaction.

examples.sentence: El grupo rebelde decidió probar las armas contra las fuerzas del gobierno para medir su reacción.
examples.translation: The rebel group decided to test the weapons against government forces to gauge their reaction.

examples.sentence: Antes de una posible negociación, el país probó las armas con un disparo de advertencia.
examples.translation: Before a possible negotiation, the country tested the weapons with a warning shot.

examples.sentence: La milicia probó las armas para demostrar su capacidad de defensa ante amenazas externas.
examples.translation: The militia tested the weapons to demonstrate their defense capability against external threats.

definitions: Figurative: to try one's luck; to attempt something whose outcome is uncertain, often in the hope of success.

examples.sentence: Voy a probar suerte en la lotería este fin de semana, aunque sé que es difícil ganar.
examples.translation: I'm going to try my luck in the lottery this weekend, although I know it's hard to win.

examples.sentence: Si no consigues trabajo aquí, prueba suerte en otra ciudad donde hay más ofertas.
examples.translation: If you don't get a job here, try your luck in another city where there are more opportunities.

examples.sentence: Después de muchos intentos fallidos, decidió probar suerte con un nuevo negocio.
examples.translation: After many failed attempts, he decided to try his luck with a new business.

definitions: Literal: to test or experiment with luck (rarely used literally; typically appears only as the idiom meaning 'try one's luck').

examples.sentence: Probamos suerte lanzando una moneda para decidir quién empezaba el juego.
examples.translation: We tried our luck by tossing a coin to decide who would start the game.

examples.sentence: Ella probó suerte comprando un boleto para la rifa que organizaba la escuela.
examples.translation: She tried her luck by buying a ticket for the raffle the school was organizing.

examples.sentence: Aunque el restaurante estaba lleno, decidimos probar suerte y esperar una mesa libre.
examples.translation: Although the restaurant was full, we decided to try our luck and wait for a free table.

examples.sentence: Probé suerte solicitando una beca, aunque sabía que la competencia era fuerte.
examples.translation: I tried my luck applying for a scholarship, although I knew the competition was tough.

definitions: Literal: the oldest profession in the world; a descriptive phrase referring to an occupation believed to have existed since ancient times.

examples.sentence: La agricultura es considerada una de las profesiones más antiguas del mundo por su historia milenaria.
examples.translation: Agriculture is considered one of the oldest professions in the world due to its millenary history.

examples.sentence: Desde tiempos prehistóricos, la caza ha sido una de las profesiones más antiguas del mundo.
examples.translation: Since prehistoric times, hunting has been one of the oldest professions in the world.

examples.sentence: Los arqueólogos estudian las profesiones más antiguas del mundo para entender la evolución humana.
examples.translation: Archaeologists study the oldest professions in the world to understand human evolution.

examples.sentence: La escritura es una de las profesiones más antiguas del mundo que aún se practica.
examples.translation: Writing is one of the oldest professions in the world that is still practiced.

definitions: Figurative: a conventional euphemism for prostitution; used to refer to sex work or the practice of exchanging money for sexual services.

examples.sentence: En la novela, el personaje principal se ve involucrado en la profesión más antigua del mundo.
examples.translation: In the novel, the main character gets involved in the oldest profession in the world.

examples.sentence: La policía está investigando una red relacionada con la profesión más antigua del mundo en la ciudad.
examples.translation: The police are investigating a network related to the oldest profession in the world in the city.

examples.sentence: Ella nunca imaginó que terminaría trabajando en lo que muchos llaman la profesión más antigua del mundo.
examples.translation: She never imagined she would end up working in what many call the oldest profession in the world.

definitions: Modal expression indicating possibility: it may be that; it is possible that; used to express that something might happen or might be true.

examples.sentence: Puede que llueva esta tarde, así que lleva un paraguas por si acaso.
examples.translation: It may rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella just in case.

examples.sentence: Puede que ellos lleguen un poco tarde a la reunión, pero seguro que vendrán.
examples.translation: It is possible that they will arrive a little late to the meeting, but they will surely come.

examples.sentence: No sé si aprobaré el examen, pero puede que sí si estudio bien estos días.
examples.translation: I don't know if I will pass the exam, but it may be that I will if I study well these days.

definitions: Discourse marker used to introduce a conclusion, transition, or summary: 'well then,' 'so,' or 'very well,' often signalling that what follows is a consequence or a decision.

examples.sentence: Pues bien, después de analizar todas las opciones, hemos decidido proceder con la propuesta A.
examples.translation: Well then, after analyzing all the options, we have decided to proceed with proposal A.

examples.sentence: Pues bien, si nadie tiene más preguntas, podemos dar por terminada la reunión.
examples.translation: So, if no one has any more questions, we can conclude the meeting.

examples.sentence: He revisado el contrato y, pues bien, creo que está listo para firmar.
examples.translation: I have reviewed the contract and, well then, I think it is ready to sign.

definitions: Emphatic or conciliatory interjection used to accept, concede, or redirect a conversation: 'all right,' 'very well,' used to close or move on from a topic.

examples.sentence: —No estoy de acuerdo con lo que dices. —Pues bien, respetaré tu opinión.
examples.translation: —I don't agree with what you say. —All right, I will respect your opinion.

examples.sentence: —No podré asistir a la fiesta. —Pues bien, te echaremos de menos.
examples.translation: —I won't be able to attend the party. —Very well, we will miss you.

examples.sentence: —He decidido cambiar de trabajo. —Pues bien, te deseo mucho éxito en tu nueva etapa.
examples.translation: —I have decided to change jobs. —All right, I wish you much success in your new stage.

definitions: Literally, 'in a position to specify': indicating that one is ready or in a position to provide a more precise statement or detail.
